title: 現在簡單式與現在進行式
formula: V(s/es)　／　am・is・are + V-ing
intro: 媽媽問你「你在做什麼？」你回答「我正在寫作業」，這是現在進行式；如果有人問你「你平常幾點起床？」，你說的是習慣，要用現在簡單式。國中你已經會這兩個時態，高中要學會分辨「習慣、事實」和「正在發生」，還要加上狀態動詞不能進行的規則，學測的文法選擇與改錯常常考這一點。
rhyme: 習慣事實 V(s)，此刻進行 be + V-ing

points.t: 現在簡單式表示習慣或經常做的事，常搭配 always, usually, every day, on Sundays 等頻率詞。

ex.en: My brother plays basketball every Saturday.
ex.zh: 我弟弟每週六都打籃球。

points.t: 主詞是第三人稱單數（he, she, it, 單數名詞）時，動詞要加 -s 或 -es，例如 plays, watches, studies。

ex.en: Mia usually rides her bike to school.
ex.zh: 米雅通常騎腳踏車上學。

ex.en: My sister studies English every night.
ex.zh: 我姊姊每天晚上讀英文。

points.t: 現在簡單式也用在永遠成立的事實、自然現象與真理。

ex.en: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.
ex.zh: 水在攝氏一百度沸騰。

points.t: 現在進行式用 am / is / are + V-ing，表示說話當下或這陣子正在進行的動作，常搭配 now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!。

ex.en: Be quiet! The baby is sleeping now.
ex.zh: 小聲點！寶寶現在正在睡覺。

points.t: know, like, want, love, have（擁有）等狀態動詞通常不用進行式，即使句中有 now 也一樣。高中還會延伸出過去進行式與現在完成進行式。

ex.en: I know the answer to this question now.
ex.zh: 我現在知道這個問題的答案。

steps: 步驟 1：先判斷這件事是「習慣、事實」還是「此刻正在發生」。看有沒有 every day, usually 或 now, Listen! 這類線索。
步驟 2：若是習慣或事實，用原形動詞；主詞是 he, she, it 或單數名詞時，動詞加 -s / -es。
步驟 3：若是正在進行，用 am / is / are 配合主詞，再把動詞改成 V-ing；但 know, like, want 這類狀態動詞不能這樣用。
步驟 4：完成例句：My father cooks dinner every day, but he is watching TV now.（我爸爸每天煮晚餐，但他現在正在看電視。）

compare.a: She reads a book every night.
compare.b: She is reading a book now.
compare.note: 前者是固定習慣，後者是此刻正在做的動作。

compare.a: I like this song.
compare.b: I am liking this song.（錯）
compare.note: like 是狀態動詞，不用進行式。

mistakes.wrong: He go to school by bus every day.
mistakes.right: He goes to school by bus every day.
mistakes.why: 主詞 He 是第三人稱單數，go 要變成 goes。

mistakes.wrong: I am wanting a new phone.
mistakes.right: I want a new phone.
mistakes.why: want 是狀態動詞，不能用進行式。

mistakes.wrong: The sun is rising in the east every morning.
mistakes.right: The sun rises in the east every morning.
mistakes.why: 太陽每天從東邊升起是自然事實，又有 every morning 表習慣，用現在簡單式。

qs.s: Mia usually ______ to school by bike.
qs.ex: usually 表習慣，主詞 Mia 是第三人稱單數，動詞用 rides。
qs.hint: 看句中的頻率詞，再看主詞是否為第三人稱單數。

qs.s: Listen! Someone ______ the piano in the music room.
qs.ex: Listen! 提示動作正在進行，用 is playing。
qs.hint: 注意句首的提示語，它告訴你動作此刻是否正在發生。

qs.s: I ______ the answer to this question.
qs.ex: know 是狀態動詞，不用進行式；主詞 I 搭配 know。
qs.hint: 先判斷動詞是動作還是狀態，狀態動詞通常不用進行式。

qs.s: The sun ______ in the east and sets in the west.
qs.ex: 自然現象屬於事實，用現在簡單式，主詞 The sun 為單數，用 rises。
qs.hint: 自然現象屬於永遠成立的事實，用哪個時態？別忘了主詞單複數。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He is go to the library every day.
He going to the library every day.
He goes to the library every day.
He go to the library every day.
qs.ex: every day 表習慣，主詞 He 要用 goes；is go 和 going 都沒有正確的動詞形式，go 少了 -es。
qs.hint: 找出動詞形式不完整或缺少 be 動詞的選項，再看 every day 對應哪個時態。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I am wanting a new bike for my birthday.
I wants a new bike for my birthday.
I am want a new bike for my birthday.
I want a new bike for my birthday.
qs.ex: want 是狀態動詞，不用進行式；主詞 I 時 want 不加 s。
qs.hint: 想想 want 屬於哪一類動詞，再看主詞 I 時動詞要不要變化。

title: 過去式與現在完成式
formula: V-ed（過去）　／　have・has + p.p.
intro: 你說「我昨天看了這部電影」，重點是昨天那個時間點，用過去式；你說「我已經看過這部電影了」，重點是現在你知道劇情，用現在完成式。國中先學兩個時態的基本形，高中要掌握「明確過去時間不能用完成式」，以及 for / since 的差別，學測常考。
rhyme: 有時間點用過去式，連到現在 have + p.p.

points.t: 過去式表示過去某個已經結束的動作，常搭配 yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2020 這類明確的過去時間。

ex.en: We saw the movie yesterday, and it was great.
ex.zh: 我們昨天看了那部電影，很棒。

points.t: 規則動詞加 -ed，不規則動詞要背，例如 go → went, lose → lost, eat → ate。

ex.en: She lost her key last night.
ex.zh: 她昨晚弄丟了鑰匙。

points.t: 現在完成式用 have / has + 過去分詞，表示過去開始、持續到現在的狀態，或過去的經驗、結果和現在有關。

ex.en: Ken has lived in Taipei since he was a baby.
ex.zh: 肯從小嬰兒時期就住在台北。

points.t: for 接一段時間，since 接起點時間（時間點或過去式子句），兩者都搭配現在完成式。

ex.en: I have known Amy for five years.
ex.zh: 我認識艾咪五年了。

ex.en: Tina has studied English since last year.
ex.zh: 蒂娜從去年開始學英文。

points.t: yet 用在否定句與疑問句句尾，already 用在肯定句，表示「已經／還沒」。

ex.en: Tina hasn't finished her homework yet.
ex.zh: 蒂娜還沒寫完她的作業。

steps: 步驟 1：先看句中有沒有明確過去時間（yesterday, last week, in 2019）。有的話用過去式，不用完成式。
步驟 2：如果是「從過去一直到現在」或「到現在為止的經驗、結果」，用 have / has + p.p.。
步驟 3：確認主詞，I, you, we, they 用 have；he, she, it 用 has。再把動詞改成過去分詞，不規則動詞要查字表。
步驟 4：完成例句：My uncle has worked in this bank for ten years.（我叔叔在這家銀行工作十年了。）

compare.a: I lived in Tainan for three years.
compare.b: I have lived in Tainan for three years.
compare.note: 前者現在已不住台南，後者現在仍住在台南。

compare.a: I saw him last week.
compare.b: I have seen him before.
compare.note: 前者有明確過去時間，後者是到現在為止的經驗。

mistakes.wrong: She has lost her key last night.
mistakes.right: She lost her key last night.
mistakes.why: last night 是明確過去時間，不能搭配現在完成式。

mistakes.wrong: I have known Amy since five years.
mistakes.right: I have known Amy for five years.
mistakes.why: five years 是一段時間，要用 for 而不是 since。

mistakes.wrong: How long have you have this phone?
mistakes.right: How long have you had this phone?
mistakes.why: have 後面要接過去分詞 had，不能再用原形。

qs.s: Ken ______ in Taipei since he was a baby.
qs.ex: since 引導「從過去到現在」的持續，主要子句用現在完成式 has lived。
qs.hint: 看 since 引導的時間，想想動作是否從過去持續到現在。

qs.s: We ______ the movie yesterday, and it was great.
qs.ex: yesterday 是明確的過去時間，用過去式 saw。
qs.hint: 句中的時間詞是明確的過去時間，這種情況不用完成式。

qs.s: Tina hasn't finished her homework ______.
qs.ex: 現在完成式的否定句句尾常搭配 yet；其他選項是明確的過去時間。
qs.hint: 現在完成式否定句的句尾常搭配哪一個副詞？其他選項都是過去時間。

qs.s: How long have you ______ this phone?
qs.ex: have + p.p.，have 的過去分詞是 had。
qs.hint: 完成式要接過去分詞，不規則動詞要特別記字形。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She has lost her key last night.
She has lose her key last night.
She lost her key last night.
She losing her key last night.
qs.ex: last night 是明確的過去時間，要用過去式 lost，不能用現在完成式。
qs.hint: 找出明確的過去時間，再判斷哪個時態才能與它搭配。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I have known Amy since five years.
I have known Amy for five years.
I knew Amy for five years now.
I know Amy for five years.
qs.ex: for + 一段時間，搭配現在完成式；since 後面要接起點時間，不是一段時間。
qs.hint: 分辨一段時間與起點時間，兩者搭配的介系詞不同。

title: 未來式 will 與 be going to
formula: will + VR　／　am・is・are going to + VR
intro: 同學拿著很重的袋子，你當場說「我來幫你」，這是臨時決定；如果你說「週末我打算去爬山」，這是事先的計畫。英文裡前者常用 will，後者常用 be going to。高中除了基本形，還會考你對預測、請求的用法，以及 will 後面一定接原形動詞。
rhyme: 臨時決定 will，早有打算 be going to，後面一律接原形

points.t: will + 原形動詞，表示說話當下才決定的事，或單純對未來的預測、承諾。

ex.en: This bag is heavy. Don't worry, I will help you.
ex.zh: 這個袋子很重，別擔心，我來幫你。

points.t: be going to + 原形動詞，表示事先已經有的計畫，或根據眼前跡象做出的預測。be 要隨主詞變成 am, is, are。

ex.en: We are going to have a picnic on Sunday.
ex.zh: 我們星期天打算去野餐。

points.t: will 是助動詞，後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to，也不加 -s 或 -ing；be going to 的 to 後面也接原形。

ex.en: She will go to the party tonight.
ex.zh: 她今晚會去那場派對。

points.t: 否定句是 will not (won't) 或 be not going to；疑問句把 will 或 be 動詞移到句首。

ex.en: Are you going to join the school trip next month?
ex.zh: 你下個月打算參加校外教學嗎？

points.t: 預測天氣、未來狀況時，will 後面接 be 動詞或形容詞。

ex.en: According to the weather report, tomorrow will be a sunny day.
ex.zh: 根據氣象報告，明天會是晴天。

steps: 步驟 1：判斷是臨時決定或單純預測（用 will），還是早已有計畫（用 be going to）。
步驟 2：用 will 時，主詞後面直接放 will，再接原形動詞；用 be going to 時，先依主詞選 am / is / are。
步驟 3：確認後面的動詞是原形，不加 to（will）或只留在 going to 之後。
步驟 4：完成例句：Dad is going to take us to the zoo next Sunday.（爸爸打算下星期天帶我們去動物園。）

compare.a: I will call you tonight.
compare.b: I am going to call you tonight.
compare.note: 前者是當下決定或承諾，後者是早已安排好。

compare.a: It will rain tomorrow.
compare.b: Look at the dark clouds! It is going to rain.
compare.note: 後者是看見眼前跡象做的預測。

mistakes.wrong: She will to go to the party.
mistakes.right: She will go to the party.
mistakes.why: will 是助動詞，後面不加 to。

mistakes.wrong: We going to have a picnic.
mistakes.right: We are going to have a picnic.
mistakes.why: be going to 不能漏掉 be 動詞。

mistakes.wrong: He will goes to school.
mistakes.right: He will go to school.
mistakes.why: will 後面一定用原形動詞，不加 -es。

qs.s: Dad says he ______ us to the zoo next Sunday.
qs.ex: will 與 be going to 後面都接原形動詞；will takes 和 going to takes 都錯了。
qs.hint: 看助動詞或 be going to 後面動詞要用什麼形式，三單的詞尾不會出現。

qs.s: A: This bag is too heavy for me.　B: Don't worry. I ______ help you.
qs.ex: 臨時決定幫忙用 will + 原形；其他選項無法與 help 組成正確的未來式。
qs.hint: 說話者是臨時決定幫忙，這種情況用哪個助動詞最自然？

qs.s: Are you ______ join the school trip next month?
qs.ex: Are you going to + VR 是計畫的問法；will 後面不加 to。
qs.hint: 問句是在問計畫，注意 be 動詞和 to 的位置。

qs.s: According to the weather report, tomorrow ______ a sunny day.
qs.ex: will + be 表預測；going to be 缺少 be 動詞，is going 缺少 to be。
qs.hint: 預測明天會怎樣，後面要接 be，檢查每個選項是否缺少或多出成分。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She will to go to the party tonight.
She will goes to the party tonight.
She will go to the party tonight.
She will going to the party tonight.
qs.ex: will 後面直接接原形動詞 go，不加 to，也不加 -es 或 -ing。
qs.hint: 助動詞後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to，也不加詞尾變化。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: We are going to has a picnic on Sunday.
We going to have a picnic on Sunday.
We will to have a picnic on Sunday.
We are going to have a picnic on Sunday.
qs.ex: be going to 後接原形 have；going to 前面不能漏掉 be 動詞。
qs.hint: 這個結構中 be 動詞不能省略，後面接原形。

title: 被動語態
formula: be + p.p.（+ by + 動作者）
intro: 當你想強調「事情被做了」，而不是「誰做的」，就會用被動語態，例如「教室每天被打掃」。國中學過 be + p.p. 的基本形，高中要進一步會用在各種時態、助動詞後面，並知道不及物動詞沒有被動。學測閱讀與文法題裡被動句出現的比例相當高。
rhyme: 主詞被動作，be + p.p.，必要才加 by

points.t: 被動語態的結構是 be + 過去分詞，主詞是動作的接受者。

ex.en: The windows are cleaned by the students every Friday.
ex.zh: 窗戶每週五由學生擦乾淨。

points.t: be 動詞要依時態和主詞變化：現在用 am / is / are，過去用 was / were。

ex.en: The movie was directed by a famous Taiwanese director.
ex.zh: 這部電影是由一位台灣知名導演執導的。

points.t: 有助動詞時，用 助動詞 + be + p.p.，例如 will be, must be, can be。

ex.en: The homework must be finished before Monday.
ex.zh: 這份作業必須在星期一前完成。

ex.en: The letter will be sent tomorrow.
ex.zh: 這封信明天會被寄出。

points.t: by + 動作者只在需要強調是誰做的時候才加；不重要或不知道時可以省略。

ex.en: The cake was eaten by my brother.
ex.zh: 蛋糕被我弟弟吃掉了。

points.t: 不及物動詞（happen, rise, arrive, die 等）沒有受詞，所以不能用被動語態。

ex.en: A strange thing happened to me on my way home.
ex.zh: 回家路上我遇到一件怪事。

steps: 步驟 1：找出動作的接受者，把它放在句首當主詞。
步驟 2：依時態選 be 動詞（is, are, was, were, will be, must be 等）。
步驟 3：把主要動詞改成過去分詞（p.p.），不規則動詞要特別注意，如 eat → eaten。
步驟 4：需要時才加 by + 動作者。完成例句：The song was written by a high-school student.（這首歌是一位高中生寫的。）

compare.a: The boy broke the window.
compare.b: The window was broken by the boy.
compare.note: 前者主詞做動作，後者強調窗戶被打破。

compare.a: A strange thing happened.
compare.b: A strange thing was happened.（錯）
compare.note: happen 是不及物動詞，不能用被動。

mistakes.wrong: The cake was eat by my brother.
mistakes.right: The cake was eaten by my brother.
mistakes.why: 被動語態要用過去分詞 eaten，不是原形 eat。

mistakes.wrong: The letter will sent tomorrow.
mistakes.right: The letter will be sent tomorrow.
mistakes.why: will 後面要接 be + p.p.，不能漏掉 be。

mistakes.wrong: An accident was happened last night.
mistakes.right: An accident happened last night.
mistakes.why: happen 是不及物動詞，不用被動語態。

qs.s: The windows ______ by the students every Friday.
qs.ex: 窗戶是被清理的對象，用被動語態 are cleaned。
qs.hint: 窗戶是動作的對象，要用被動，並確認 be 動詞形式與時態。

qs.s: The movie ______ by a famous Taiwanese director last year.
qs.ex: last year 表過去，被動語態用 was + 過去分詞 directed。
qs.hint: 句中的過去時間提示，決定 be 動詞的形式與分詞。

qs.s: A strange thing ______ to me on my way home.
qs.ex: happen 是不及物動詞，不能用被動語態，用 happened。
qs.hint: 想想 happen 屬於及物還是不及物動詞，不及物動詞不能用被動。

qs.s: The homework must ______ before Monday.
qs.ex: 助動詞 must 後接被動 be + p.p.，作業是「被完成」。
qs.hint: 助動詞後接被動時，be 要用原形，再接過去分詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The cake was eat by my brother.
The cake was ate by my brother.
The cake was eaten by my brother.
qs.ex: 被動語態要用 be + 過去分詞，eat 的過去分詞是 eaten。
qs.hint: 被動語態需要 be + 過去分詞，注意 eat 的三態變化。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The letter will be sent tomorrow.
The letter will be send tomorrow.
The letter is will be sent tomorrow.
qs.ex: will be + p.p. 是未來被動；其他選項缺 be、用錯分詞或多了 is。
qs.hint: 未來被動式的結構是助動詞 + be + p.p.，檢查有沒有漏掉或多出成分。

title: 比較級與最高級
formula: 比較級 + than　／　the + 最高級 (+ of / in)
intro: 跟朋友比身高、比成績，或選出班上最聰明的同學，都會用到比較級和最高級。國中已經學過 -er / -est 與 more / most，高中要更精準：什麼時候用 than、怎麼加強比較級、最高級要怎麼配合 the 與範圍。學測常考雙重比較、much / very 的選擇。
rhyme: 兩者比較用 than，三者以上 the + 最高級

points.t: 比較兩個人或事物，用 比較級 + than。形容詞短的加 -er，長的用 more。

ex.en: Taipei 101 is taller than any other building in Taiwan.
ex.zh: 台北 101 比台灣任何其他建築都高。

points.t: 三者以上中選最，用 the + 最高級（-est 或 most），後面常接 of / in 表示範圍。

ex.en: Mina is the smartest student in our class.
ex.zh: 米娜是我們班最聰明的學生。

points.t: 多音節形容詞用 more / most，不加 -er / -est；也不可以同時用兩種，如 more taller 是錯的。

ex.en: This is the most interesting book I have ever read.
ex.zh: 這是我讀過最有趣的一本書。

points.t: 要加強比較級，用 much, even, still, far, a lot，不用 very, so, too。

ex.en: This restaurant is much more expensive than that one.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳比那家貴多了。

points.t: get + 比較級表示「越來越…」。good / well 的比較級是 better，最高級是 best。

ex.en: My cooking is getting better every week.
ex.zh: 我的廚藝一週比一週進步。

steps: 步驟 1：先看是「兩者比較」還是「三者以上選最」。有 than 就是兩者。
步驟 2：判斷形容詞長短：一音節加 -er / -est；多音節用 more / most；不規則的如 good → better → best 要背。
步驟 3：比較級後面接 than；最高級前面加 the，後面可加 of / in 的範圍。
步驟 4：完成例句：My brother is taller than I am, but my father is the tallest in our family.（我弟弟比我高，但爸爸是全家最高的。）

compare.a: He is taller than his father.
compare.b: He is more taller than his father.（錯）
compare.note: taller 本身已是比較級，不能再加 more。

compare.a: This test is much harder than the last one.
compare.b: This test is very harder than the last one.（錯）
compare.note: 加強比較級用 much，不用 very。

mistakes.wrong: He is more taller than his father.
mistakes.right: He is taller than his father.
mistakes.why: 比較級不能重複，已有 -er 就不要再加 more。

mistakes.wrong: This is most interesting book I have ever read.
mistakes.right: This is the most interesting book I have ever read.
mistakes.why: 最高級前面要加 the。

mistakes.wrong: She is very smarter than me.
mistakes.right: She is much smarter than I am.
mistakes.why: 加強比較級用 much，不用 very。

qs.s: Taipei 101 is ______ than any other building in Taiwan.
qs.ex: 後面有 than，用比較級 taller。
qs.hint: 看空格後面有沒有 than，再選對應的比較級形式。

qs.s: Mina is the ______ student in our class.
qs.ex: the 加上最高級；smart 是一音節，最高級為 smartest。
qs.hint: 前面有 the，後面要接最高級；注意一音節形容詞的最高級寫法。

qs.s: This restaurant is ______ more expensive than that one.
qs.ex: 加強比較級用 much，不可用 very, so, too。
qs.hint: 要加強比較級，只有某些副詞可以用，very, so, too 不行。

qs.s: My cooking is getting ______. I made a perfect cake today.
qs.ex: get + 比較級表示「越來越…」，good 的比較級是 better。
qs.hint: get 後面接比較級表示越來越…；注意 good 的比較級是不規則變化。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He is more taller than his father.
He is the taller than his father.
He is tall than his father.
He is taller than his father.
qs.ex: than 前面用比較級 taller；more taller 是雙重比較，the 不能和 than 連用。
qs.hint: than 前面用比較級，不能重複使用 more 或加上 the。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: This is the more interesting book I have ever read.
This is the most interesting book I have ever read.
This is most interesting book I have ever read.
This is the interestingest book I have ever read.
qs.ex: 表示「最…」用 the most + 多音節形容詞；interesting 不加 -est。
qs.hint: 最高級前面要有 the，且多音節形容詞要搭配 most，不加 -est。

title: 不定詞 to V 與動名詞 V-ing
formula: enjoy・finish・mind + V-ing　／　want・hope・decide + to V
intro: 當兩個動詞連在一起，第二個動詞要用 to V 還是 V-ing，要看第一個動詞，例如 enjoy 後面接 V-ing，want 後面接 to V。國中先背常見的動詞，高中學測會再考介系詞後接 V-ing、look forward to 等容易混淆的地方。
rhyme: enjoy・finish・mind 接 V-ing，want・hope・decide 接 to V

points.t: enjoy, finish, mind, practice, keep 等動詞後面接動名詞 V-ing。

ex.en: The students practiced singing the song for two hours.
ex.zh: 學生們把這首歌練唱了兩個小時。

ex.en: Would you mind opening the door for me?
ex.zh: 你介意幫我開門嗎？

points.t: want, hope, decide, plan, refuse, learn 等動詞後面接不定詞 to V。

ex.en: Jack hopes to become a doctor in the future.
ex.zh: 傑克希望將來成為醫生。

ex.en: He refused to answer the question.
ex.zh: 他拒絕回答這個問題。

points.t: 介系詞後面一定接 V-ing，不能接 to V，例如 be good at, be interested in, thank you for。

ex.en: She is good at playing tennis.
ex.zh: 她擅長打網球。

points.t: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing 或名詞，不是 to V。

ex.en: I'm looking forward to seeing you again soon.
ex.zh: 我期待很快再見到你。

points.t: 動名詞和不定詞都能當主詞或受詞，例如 Swimming is fun.；高中還會學到 stop, remember, forget 接 V-ing 與 to V 意思不同。

ex.en: Swimming in the sea is a lot of fun.
ex.zh: 在海裡游泳很好玩。

steps: 步驟 1：先找出句中第一個動詞（或介系詞），看它後面要接什麼。
步驟 2：若是 enjoy, finish, mind, practice 或介系詞，後面用 V-ing。
步驟 3：若是 want, hope, decide, plan, refuse，後面用 to V。
步驟 4：完成例句：My sister finished doing her homework and decided to watch a movie.（我姊姊做完功課，決定去看一部電影。）

compare.a: I enjoy reading comic books.
compare.b: I want to read comic books.
compare.note: enjoy 接 V-ing，want 接 to V。

compare.a: I look forward to meeting you.
compare.b: I want to meet you.
compare.note: 前者 to 是介系詞，後者 to 是不定詞符號。

mistakes.wrong: She is good at to play tennis.
mistakes.right: She is good at playing tennis.
mistakes.why: 介系詞 at 後面要接 V-ing。

mistakes.wrong: He refused answering the question.
mistakes.right: He refused to answer the question.
mistakes.why: refuse 後面接 to V，不接 V-ing。

mistakes.wrong: Would you mind to open the door?
mistakes.right: Would you mind opening the door?
mistakes.why: mind 後面接動名詞 V-ing。

qs.s: Would you mind ______ the door for me?
qs.ex: mind 後面接動名詞，用 opening。
qs.hint: 先看 mind 這類動詞後面應接動名詞還是不定詞。

qs.s: Jack hopes ______ a doctor in the future.
qs.ex: hope 後面接不定詞 to + VR。
qs.hint: hope 後面接哪一種形式？想想它表示未來的期望。

qs.s: The students practiced ______ the song for two hours.
qs.ex: practice 後面接動名詞 singing。
qs.hint: practice 屬於接動名詞的動詞。

qs.s: I'm looking forward to ______ you again soon.
qs.ex: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing。
qs.hint: look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面接什麼形式？

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He refused to answer the question.
qs.ex: refuse 後面接不定詞 to V。
qs.hint: refuse 後面接不定詞，其他選項的動詞形式都不對。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She is good at to play tennis.
She is good at play tennis.
She is good at playing tennis.
She is good at played tennis.
qs.ex: be good at 的 at 是介系詞，後面接 V-ing。
qs.hint: be good at 的 at 是介系詞，後面要用動名詞。

title: 使役動詞 make / let / have
formula: make・let・have + O + VR
intro: 「老師叫我們寫作業」「媽媽不讓妹妹吃太多糖」，這類「叫某人做某事」的句子，英文常用 make, let, have。這三個動詞後面接的受詞，後面的動詞要用原形，不加 to，也不加 -ing。高中學測的文法題很愛考這個「該不該加 to」的陷阱。
rhyme: 使役 make・let・have，受詞後面原形（不加 to）

points.t: make + O + VR：強迫或使某人做某事，也可表示使人產生某種情緒反應。

ex.en: The sad movie made everyone cry.
ex.zh: 那部悲傷的電影讓每個人都哭了。

points.t: let + O + VR：讓、允許某人做某事。

ex.en: Mom doesn't let my little sister eat too much candy.
ex.zh: 媽媽不讓我妹妹吃太多糖果。

points.t: have + O + VR：請、叫某人做某事，語氣較中性，常用在工作或服務情境。

ex.en: I'll have the waiter bring you a menu.
ex.zh: 我會請服務生拿菜單給你。

points.t: 使役動詞後面的原形動詞不能加 to，也不能用 -ing 或過去式。

ex.en: My boss made him work late.
ex.zh: 老闆讓他留下來加班。

points.t: let 用在請求或提議時很常見，後面同樣接原形動詞。（高中進階：make 改成被動時，原形動詞要補回 to。）

ex.en: Please let me help you with the bags.
ex.zh: 請讓我幫你拿袋子。

steps: 步驟 1：先決定要表達「強迫（make）」「允許（let）」「請託（have）」哪一種意思。
步驟 2：寫出 主詞 + make / let / have + 受詞。
步驟 3：受詞後面直接接原形動詞，不加 to，也不加 -s / -ing。
步驟 4：完成例句：The teacher let us leave early because of the typhoon.（因為颱風，老師讓我們提早離開。）

compare.a: My boss made him work late.
compare.b: My boss asked him to work late.
compare.note: make 後接原形，ask 後接 to V。

compare.a: She let me go.
compare.b: She wanted me to go.
compare.note: let 後接原形，want 後接 to V。

mistakes.wrong: The teacher let us to leave early.
mistakes.right: The teacher let us leave early.
mistakes.why: let 後面的動詞要用原形，不加 to。

mistakes.wrong: My boss made him working late.
mistakes.right: My boss made him work late.
mistakes.why: make 後面接原形，不用 -ing。

mistakes.wrong: Mom made me cleaned my room.
mistakes.right: Mom made me clean my room.
mistakes.why: make 後面用原形，不用過去式。

qs.s: The sad movie made everyone ______.
qs.ex: make + O + VR，用原形 cry。
qs.hint: 使役動詞 make 後面的動詞要用哪一種形式？不加 to。

qs.s: Mom doesn't let my little sister ______ too much candy.
qs.ex: let + O + VR，所以用 eat。
qs.hint: let 後面的受詞再接原形動詞，題目有否定詞也一樣。

qs.s: I'll have the waiter ______ you a menu.
qs.ex: have + O + VR，用原形 bring。
qs.hint: have + 受詞 + 原形動詞，注意主詞是 I'll。

qs.s: Please let me ______ you with the bags.
qs.ex: let + O + VR，用原形 help。
qs.hint: let 屬於使役動詞，後面直接接原形。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: My boss made him to work late.
My boss made him work late.
My boss made him working late.
My boss made him worked late.
qs.ex: make + O + VR，work 前不加 to，也不用 -ing 或過去式。
qs.hint: 使役動詞後面的動詞不加 to，也不用 -ing 或過去式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The teacher let us to leave early.
The teacher let us leaving early.
The teacher let us left early.
The teacher let us leave early.
qs.ex: let + O + VR，用原形 leave。
qs.hint: let 後面接受詞與原形動詞，其他形式都不正確。

title: 感官動詞與連綴動詞
formula: see・hear・watch・feel + O + VR / V-ing　；　look・sound・smell + adj.
intro: 你看到鳥飛過天空，可以說「我看到鳥飛」（整個動作）或「我看到鳥正在飛」（動作進行中）。另外 sound, smell, look 這類動詞，後面要接形容詞，描述事物的感覺。高中學測常在這裡設陷阱：接形容詞還是副詞、接原形還是 V-ing。
rhyme: 感官接受詞 + 原形／V-ing，連綴 look・sound 接形容詞

points.t: see, hear, watch, feel + O + VR：表示感覺到動作的全部過程。

ex.en: Tom watched the birds fly in the sky.
ex.zh: 湯姆看著鳥在天空中飛。

points.t: see, hear, watch, feel + O + V-ing：表示動作正在進行中的片段。

ex.en: We heard the old man telling a story to the children.
ex.zh: 我們聽到老先生正在對孩子們說故事。

points.t: 感官動詞後面的受詞要用受格（her, him, me），不能用主格 she, he。

ex.en: I saw her enter the room.
ex.zh: 我看到她走進房間。

points.t: look, sound, smell, taste, feel 是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞，不接副詞。

ex.en: The cake smells sweet.
ex.zh: 這個蛋糕聞起來很甜。

points.t: 連綴動詞 sound 也一樣，描述聽起來的感覺用形容詞。

ex.en: The music sounds good.
ex.zh: 這首音樂聽起來很棒。

steps: 步驟 1：先判斷動詞是「感覺到某個動作」（感官動詞）還是「描述感覺或性質」（連綴動詞）。
步驟 2：感官動詞：寫出 主詞 + see/hear/watch/feel + 受格受詞，再接原形（完整動作）或 V-ing（正在進行）。
步驟 3：連綴動詞：寫出 主詞 + look/sound/smell + 形容詞，不能用 -ly 副詞。
步驟 4：完成例句：I felt something crawling up my arm, so I jumped.（我感覺有東西正沿著我的手臂爬上來，所以我跳了起來。）

compare.a: I saw him cross the street.
compare.b: I saw him crossing the street.
compare.note: 前者看到整個過程，後者看到過馬路的一部分。

compare.a: The soup smells good.
compare.b: The soup smells well.（錯）
compare.note: 連綴動詞後面接形容詞 good，不是副詞 well。

mistakes.wrong: I saw her to enter the room.
mistakes.right: I saw her enter the room.
mistakes.why: 感官動詞後面的原形動詞不加 to。

mistakes.wrong: The music sounds well.
mistakes.right: The music sounds good.
mistakes.why: sound 是連綴動詞，後面要接形容詞。

mistakes.wrong: I saw she enter the room.
mistakes.right: I saw her enter the room.
mistakes.why: 感官動詞後的受詞要用受格 her。

qs.s: Tom watched the birds ______ in the sky.
qs.ex: watch + O + VR，用原形 fly。
qs.hint: watch 後面接受詞再接原形動詞，表示看到整個動作。

qs.s: I felt something ______ up my arm, so I jumped.
qs.ex: 感官動詞 + O + V-ing 表動作正在進行，用 crawling。
qs.hint: 感覺到動作正在進行中，動詞要用哪種形式？

qs.s: The cake smells ______.
qs.ex: smell 是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞 sweet。
qs.hint: smell 是連綴動詞，後面接的詞性是形容詞還是副詞？

qs.s: We heard the old man ______ a story to the children.
qs.ex: hear + O + V-ing，聽到他正在說故事。
qs.hint: 聽到某人正在做某事，動詞要用進行中的形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I saw her to enter the room.
I saw she enter the room.
I saw her entered the room.
I saw her enter the room.
qs.ex: see + 受格 + 原形動詞；不加 to，受詞要用 her，也不用過去式。
qs.hint: see 後面接受格代名詞，再接原形動詞，不加 to。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
qs.ex: sound 是連綴動詞，後面接形容詞 good，不接副詞。
qs.hint: sound 是連綴動詞，要接形容詞，不接副詞或名詞。

title: 關係代名詞（限定用法）
formula: N + who / which / that + V
intro: 想形容「那個站在那裡的男生」「我爺爺送我的那支筆」，可以用關係代名詞把兩個句子合在一起，讓句子更精簡。國中先學 who, which, that，高中要知道關代同時當連接詞與代名詞，所以後面不能重複代名詞，這是學測改錯題的重點。
rhyme: 人用 who，物用 which，that 通用，關代自己是代名詞

points.t: 先行詞是人，關代當主詞用 who（或 that）。

ex.en: The boy who is standing there is my classmate.
ex.zh: 站在那裡的男生是我的同學。

points.t: 先行詞是物，關代用 which（或 that）。

ex.en: A dictionary is a book that tells you the meaning of words.
ex.zh: 字典是告訴你字義的一本書。

points.t: 關代也可以當受詞，這時可省略；先行詞是物用 which / that。

ex.en: I lost the pen that my grandfather gave me.
ex.zh: 我弄丟了爺爺送我的那支筆。

points.t: 關代已經取代代名詞，所以子句裡不能再重複 he, she, it 等。

ex.en: The woman who teaches us English is very kind.
ex.zh: 教我們英文的那位女士非常親切。

points.t: 關代子句的動詞要和先行詞的單複數一致。

ex.en: The students who study hard usually get good grades.
ex.zh: 用功讀書的學生通常成績不錯。

steps: 步驟 1：找出兩個句子裡重複的名詞，這個就是先行詞。
步驟 2：判斷先行詞是人還是物，選 who / which / that。
步驟 3：把第二個句子中重複的代名詞換成關代，放在先行詞後面，不要保留原來的代名詞。
步驟 4：完成例句：I have a friend who plays the piano very well.（我有一位鋼琴彈得很好的朋友。）

compare.a: The boy who is standing there is Tom.
compare.b: The boy which is standing there is Tom.（錯）
compare.note: 先行詞是人用 who，不用 which。

compare.a: This is the cake that my mom made.
compare.b: This is the cake what my mom made.（錯）
compare.note: what 不能當關係代名詞接在先行詞（the cake）後面，要用 that 或 which。

mistakes.wrong: The woman who teaches us English she is kind.
mistakes.right: The woman who teaches us English is kind.
mistakes.why: who 已經當主詞，不能再重複 she。

mistakes.wrong: This is the cake who my mom made.
mistakes.right: This is the cake that my mom made.
mistakes.why: 先行詞是物，不能用 who。

mistakes.wrong: The students who studies hard get good grades.
mistakes.right: The students who study hard get good grades.
mistakes.why: 動詞要和複數先行詞 students 一致。

qs.s: The boy ______ is standing there is my classmate.
qs.ex: 先行詞是人，關代當主詞，用 who。
qs.hint: 先行詞是人，關代又要當主詞，選指人的關代。

qs.s: I lost the pen ______ my grandfather gave me.
qs.ex: 先行詞是物，用 that（或 which）引導形容詞子句。
qs.hint: 先行詞是物，哪個關代可以通用？

qs.s: The students ______ study hard usually get good grades.
qs.ex: 先行詞是 students（人），主詞關代用 who。
qs.hint: 先行詞是複數的人，主詞關代要選哪一個？

qs.s: A dictionary is a book ______ tells you the meaning of words.
qs.ex: 先行詞是物，關代當主詞用 that；who 指人，it 不是關代。
qs.hint: 先行詞是物，關代同時當主詞；注意有些選項不是關代。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The woman who teaches us English she is very kind.
The woman who teaches us English is very kind.
The woman which teaches us English is very kind.
The woman who teach us English is very kind.
qs.ex: 先行詞是人用 who；who 已是主詞，不重複 she，動詞 teaches 也要與單數 woman 一致。
qs.hint: 關代已經當主詞，檢查子句中是否多出重複的代名詞，並注意動詞與先行詞一致。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: This is the cake who my mom made.
This is the cake what my mom made.
This is the cake that my mom made.
This is the cake it my mom made.
qs.ex: 先行詞是物，用 that 或 which；who 指人，what 不能修飾名詞，it 不是關代。
qs.hint: 先行詞是物，注意指人的關代、what 與代名詞的用法是否正確。

title: 連接詞 because / although / so / but
formula: because ... / although ... / so ... / so + adj + that ...
intro: 「雖然很用功，卻考不好」「因為下雨，所以取消」，這種表達原因、轉折和結果的句子，需要正確的連接詞。國中先學 because, so, but, although，高中要知道 because 與 so、although 與 but 不能同時用，還要會 so...that 與 such...that 的分別。這些常出現在學測的選擇與改錯題。
rhyme: Because 不加 so，Although 不加 but，so + adj、such + N

points.t: because 引導原因子句，後面接完整的句子；because of 後面接名詞或名詞片語。

ex.en: We couldn't go hiking because of the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 因為大雨，我們不能去健行。

points.t: so 表示結果，前面接原因；because 與 so 不可以同時出現在同一個句子。

ex.en: Because he was sick, he stayed in bed.
ex.zh: 因為他生病了，所以他待在床上。

points.t: although 表示「雖然」，引導讓步子句；although 與 but 不能同時使用。

ex.en: Although Ella studied hard, she failed the test.
ex.zh: 雖然艾拉很用功，她還是考不及格。

points.t: so + adj / adv + that 表示「如此…以致於」。

ex.en: I was so tired that I fell asleep on the bus.
ex.zh: 我累到在公車上睡著了。

points.t: such + (a/an) + adj + N + that 也表示「如此…以致於」，後面是名詞片語。

ex.en: It was such a good movie that we watched it twice.
ex.zh: 那是一部非常好看的電影，我們看了兩遍。

steps: 步驟 1：先判斷兩個句子的關係：原因（because）、結果（so）、轉折（although / but）。
步驟 2：選擇對應連接詞，記得 because 和 so 只能用一個，although 和 but 只能用一個。
步驟 3：判斷後面是子句還是名詞片語：子句用 because，名詞用 because of；形容詞用 so，名詞片語用 such。
步驟 4：完成例句：Although it was raining, we still played basketball.（雖然在下雨，我們還是去打籃球。）

compare.a: I was so tired that I fell asleep.
compare.b: It was such a tiring day that I fell asleep.
compare.note: so 後面接形容詞，such 後面接名詞片語。

compare.a: Because it rained, we stayed home.
compare.b: Because of the rain, we stayed home.
compare.note: because 接句子，because of 接名詞。

mistakes.wrong: Because he was sick, so he stayed in bed.
mistakes.right: Because he was sick, he stayed in bed.
mistakes.why: because 和 so 不能同時使用。

mistakes.wrong: Although the test was hard, but I passed it.
mistakes.right: Although the test was hard, I passed it.
mistakes.why: although 和 but 不能同時使用。

mistakes.wrong: Because of he was sick, he stayed in bed.
mistakes.right: Because he was sick, he stayed in bed.
mistakes.why: because of 後面不能接完整子句。

qs.s: ______ Ella studied hard, she failed the test.
qs.ex: 前後語意相反，用 Although 表「雖然」。
qs.hint: 前後句意思相反，應該用表示轉折的連接詞。

qs.s: I was ______ tired that I fell asleep on the bus.
qs.ex: so + adj + that 表「如此…以致於」；such 後面要接名詞。
qs.hint: 空格後面是形容詞，不是名詞片語，想想用哪個程度副詞。

qs.s: We couldn't go hiking ______ the heavy rain.
qs.ex: 後面是名詞片語 the heavy rain，要用 because of。
qs.hint: 空格後面是名詞片語，不是完整句子，要用接名詞的片語。

qs.s: It was ______ a good movie that we watched it twice.
qs.ex: a good movie 是名詞片語，用 such a + adj + N + that。
qs.hint: a good movie 是名詞片語，要搭配接名詞片語的程度詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Because he was sick, so he stayed in bed.
Because of he was sick, he stayed in bed.
Because he was sick, but he stayed in bed.
Because he was sick, he stayed in bed.
qs.ex: Because 與 so 不能同時使用；because of 後面接名詞，不接子句；原因與結果不是轉折，不用 but。
qs.hint: 原因與結果的連接詞不能並用；也要注意接名詞的片語後面不能接子句。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Although the test was hard, but I passed it.
Although the test was hard, so I passed it.
Although the test hard, I passed it.
Although the test was hard, I passed it.
qs.ex: Although 不與 but 或 so 連用；子句也需要 was。
qs.hint: 表示讓步的連接詞不與表示轉折或結果的詞連用，子句也要有 be 動詞。

title: 附加問句
formula: 肯定句, 否定附加問句？　／　否定句, 肯定附加問句？
intro: 聊天時想確認對方是不是同意，就在句尾補一個小問句，像中文的「對不對？」「好嗎？」。例如你說「你喜歡披薩，對不對？」。高中的對話題與綜合測驗常考助動詞的選擇和特殊形式。
rhyme: 前肯後否、前否後肯，助動詞照抄、主詞變代名詞

points.t: 前面是肯定句，附加問句用「否定縮寫」，通常寫成 n't。

ex.en: You like pizza, don't you?
ex.zh: 你喜歡披薩，對不對？

ex.en: Mia plays the piano well, doesn't she?
ex.zh: 蜜雅鋼琴彈得很好，對吧？

points.t: 前面是否定句，附加問句改用「肯定」，不要再重複否定。

ex.en: Your sister can't swim, can she?
ex.zh: 你姊姊不會游泳，對嗎？

ex.en: They aren't ready yet, are they?
ex.zh: 他們還沒準備好，對吧？

points.t: 附加問句的動詞要依前句決定：be 動詞、助動詞照抄；一般動詞依時態用 do / does / did；主詞一律換成代名詞。

ex.en: Tom finished his homework, didn't he?
ex.zh: 湯姆寫完功課了，不是嗎？

ex.en: Your parents are at home, aren't they?
ex.zh: 你的父母在家，對吧？

points.t: 兩個特殊形式：I am 的附加問句是 aren't I；Let's 的附加問句是 shall we。

ex.en: I am late again, aren't I?
ex.zh: 我又遲到了，是不是？

ex.en: Let's go to the park, shall we?
ex.zh: 我們去公園好嗎？

points.t: 祈使句（命令、請求）的附加問句用 will you，語氣變得比較客氣。

ex.en: Close the window, will you?
ex.zh: 把窗戶關上，好嗎？

ex.en: Don't forget your umbrella, will you?
ex.zh: 別忘了帶傘，好嗎？

steps: 先看前句是肯定還是否定，附加問句取相反。
找前句的動詞：be 動詞或助動詞照抄；一般動詞依時態改成 do / does / did。
把前句的主詞換成代名詞，否定時用縮寫 n't，最後加逗號與問號。完成：The students passed the test, didn't they?

compare.a: She is smart, isn't she?
compare.b: She is smart, doesn't she?
compare.note: 前句動詞是 be 動詞，附加問句就要用 be 動詞，不能亂換成 do。

compare.a: You don't like fish, do you?
compare.b: You don't like fish, don't you?
compare.note: 前句已經是否定，後面要用肯定，不可以兩邊都否定。

mistakes.wrong: She can swim, doesn't she?
mistakes.right: She can swim, can't she?
mistakes.why: 前句有助動詞 can，附加問句要沿用 can，不能換成 does。

mistakes.wrong: They don't like math, don't they?
mistakes.right: They don't like math, do they?
mistakes.why: 前句是否定，附加問句要用肯定。

mistakes.wrong: Let's go home, will we?
mistakes.right: Let's go home, shall we?
mistakes.why: Let's 開頭的句子固定用 shall we。

qs.s: Tom finished his homework, ______?
qs.ex: 前句是肯定的過去式，附加問句用否定 didn't he。
qs.hint: 先判斷前句是肯定還是否定，再看動詞的時態與助動詞。

qs.s: You aren't busy now, ______?
qs.ex: 前句是否定，附加問句用肯定；動詞是 be，所以用 are you。
qs.hint: 前句是否定，動詞是 be 動詞，附加問句取相反並沿用同一個動詞。

qs.s: Open the window, ______?
qs.ex: 祈使句的附加問句用 will you。
qs.hint: 這是命令句型，附加問句有固定搭配，不需要沿用動詞。

qs.s: I am your best friend, ______?
qs.ex: I am 的附加問句特殊，用 aren't I。
qs.hint: 第一人稱搭配 be 動詞的特殊形式，不能照一般方式縮寫。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
qs.ex: 前句是肯定，後面用否定；助動詞 can 要保留，用 can't she。
qs.hint: 前句肯定且有助動詞，後面取否定並沿用該助動詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: They don't like math, don't they?
They don't like math, are they?
They don't like math, did they?
They don't like math, do they?
qs.ex: 前句是否定現在式，附加問句用肯定 do they。
qs.hint: 前句是否定的現在式，附加問句取相反，並注意助動詞與主詞 they 的搭配。

title: 間接問句
formula: wh- + S + V（不倒裝）
intro: 當你想禮貌地問路，會說「請問你知道郵局在哪裡嗎？」，這時問句被放進另一個句子裡，語序就要改變。國中學過 Where is he? 這種直接問句，高中要學會把問句變成句子的一部分。學測會考語序、時態還原，以及 if / whether 的選擇。
rhyme: 問句藏進句子裡，疑問詞後面照直述句走

points.t: 問句放進另一個句子，要改成直述句語序：疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞，不再倒裝。

ex.en: I don't know where she bought this bag.
ex.zh: 我不知道她在哪裡買這個包包。

ex.en: Can you tell me what time the movie starts?
ex.zh: 你可以告訴我電影幾點開始嗎？

points.t: 不再使用 do / does / did；動詞形式要隨主詞與時態調整。

ex.en: I know where he lives.
ex.zh: 我知道他住在哪裡。

ex.en: Tell me what she wants for lunch.
ex.zh: 告訴我她午餐想吃什麼。

points.t: yes / no 問句沒有疑問詞，要改用 if 或 whether 引導。

ex.en: Do you know if the library is open today?
ex.zh: 你知道圖書館今天有沒有開嗎？

ex.en: I wonder whether it will rain tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我不知道明天會不會下雨。

points.t: 疑問詞本身當主詞時，語序本來就是「疑問詞 + 動詞」，不用調整。

ex.en: Do you know who broke the window?
ex.zh: 你知道是誰打破窗戶的嗎？

ex.en: I wonder what happened to him.
ex.zh: 我不知道他發生了什麼事。

points.t: 高中會延伸到 wh- 名詞子句當主詞、受詞、補語，語序規則完全相同。

ex.en: What he said surprised me.
ex.zh: 他說的話讓我很驚訝。

ex.en: The question is where we should meet.
ex.zh: 問題是我們該在哪裡碰面。

steps: 先寫出原本的問句，例如 Where does he live?
把問句改成直述句語序：疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞，拿掉 do / does / did，動詞依主詞與時態變化。
前面接上 I know / Do you know / Could you tell me 等開頭。完成：Could you tell me where he lives?

compare.a: I know where he lives.
compare.b: Where does he live?
compare.note: 左邊是句子中的間接問句，不倒裝；右邊是獨立的直接問句，要倒裝並用 does。

compare.a: Do you know if she is at home?
compare.b: Do you know is she at home?
compare.note: yes / no 問句放進句子裡一定要加 if 或 whether。

mistakes.wrong: I don't know where is he.
mistakes.right: I don't know where he is.
mistakes.why: 間接問句不倒裝，主詞 he 要放在 be 動詞前面。

mistakes.wrong: Do you know when does the bus come?
mistakes.right: Do you know when the bus comes?
mistakes.why: 間接問句不加 does，動詞要變成 comes。

mistakes.wrong: I wonder what did she buy.
mistakes.right: I wonder what she bought.
mistakes.why: 拿掉 did 以後，動詞要還原成過去式 bought。

qs.s: Could you tell me where ______?
qs.ex: 間接問句不倒裝，語序是 where + 主詞 + 動詞。
qs.hint: 句中已經有 tell me，後面的問句被放進去了，注意疑問詞後的語序。

qs.s: I wonder what ______ for lunch.
qs.ex: 間接問句用直述句語序，主詞 she 後接 wants，不加 does。
qs.hint: 間接問句用直述句語序，要注意主詞對應的動詞形式。

qs.s: I can't tell ______ it will rain tomorrow or not.
qs.ex: yes / no 的間接問句用 whether（或 if）；其他疑問詞語意不合。
qs.hint: 原問句是 yes / no 問句，沒有疑問詞，要找表示「是否」的連接詞。

qs.s: Do you remember how many students ______ in your class?
qs.ex: 間接問句不倒裝，用 there are，不用 are there。
qs.hint: 間接問句不倒裝，注意 there 與 be 動詞誰在前面。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I don't know what is her name.
I don't know what her name is.
I don't know what does her name is.
I don't know what her name.
qs.ex: 間接問句的語序是 what + 主詞 + 動詞：what her name is。
qs.hint: 間接問句不倒裝也不加助動詞，比較每個選項中 be 動詞與主詞的位置。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Do you know when does the bus come?
Do you know when the bus does come?
Do you know when the bus comes?
Do you know when the bus coming?
qs.ex: 間接問句中不能再加 does，動詞用 comes。
qs.hint: 間接問句不能再加助動詞，動詞要配合主詞變化。

title: 情緒形容詞 -ing 與 -ed
formula: V-ing（令人…的）　／　V-ed（感到…的）
intro: 看完一部電影你說「好無聊」，到底是電影很無聊，還是你覺得無聊？英文用 -ing 與 -ed 來分辨。國中背過 interesting 與 interested，高中會用在分詞片語與閱讀題，一旦搞混意思就完全相反。
rhyme: 事物 -ing 令人…，人 -ed 感到…

points.t: -ing 形容詞描述事物的特性，表示「令人感到…的」，常用來形容電影、書、活動。

ex.en: The movie was so boring that I almost fell asleep.
ex.zh: 那部電影太無聊了，我差點睡著。

ex.en: This puzzle is really confusing.
ex.zh: 這個謎題真的很令人困惑。

points.t: -ed 形容詞描述人的感受，表示「感到…的」。

ex.en: I am interested in space travel.
ex.zh: 我對太空旅行很有興趣。

ex.en: My father was tired after work.
ex.zh: 我爸爸下班後覺得很累。

points.t: -ed 形容詞常搭配固定介系詞：interested in、surprised at、excited about、worried about。

ex.en: Lily is excited about the school trip.
ex.zh: 莉莉對校外教學感到很興奮。

ex.en: We were surprised at the result.
ex.zh: 我們對結果感到驚訝。

points.t: 放在名詞前面修飾時，也是依「名詞是人還是事物」來選：-ed 修飾人，-ing 修飾事物。

ex.en: The surprised students looked at the strange box.
ex.zh: 驚訝的學生們看著那個奇怪的盒子。

ex.en: The exciting game made everyone cheer.
ex.zh: 那場刺激的比賽讓大家歡呼。

points.t: 高中會延伸到分詞片語：主詞是人時，常用 -ed 開頭的分詞片語表示感受。

ex.en: Excited by the news, she jumped for joy.
ex.zh: 聽到消息很興奮，她高興得跳起來。

ex.en: Tired from the long walk, we sat down to rest.
ex.zh: 走了長路很累，我們坐下來休息。

steps: 先看要描述的主詞是人還是事物。
事物（令人…）用 V-ing 形容詞，人（感到…）用 V-ed 形容詞。
-ed 形容詞要接原因時，搭配介系詞 in / at / about / by。完成：The students were surprised at the test result.

compare.a: I am bored.
compare.b: I am boring.
compare.note: 左邊是「我覺得無聊」，右邊是「我這個人很無聊」，意思完全不同。

compare.a: The news was surprising.
compare.b: The news was surprised.
compare.note: 新聞是事物，只能令人驚訝，不會「感到」驚訝。

mistakes.wrong: I am very interesting in this book.
mistakes.right: I am very interested in this book.
mistakes.why: 人感到有興趣用 interested，且搭配 in。

mistakes.wrong: The long trip was tired.
mistakes.right: The long trip was tiring.
mistakes.why: 旅程是事物，要用 -ing 表示「令人疲累的」。

mistakes.wrong: She was confusing by the map.
mistakes.right: She was confused by the map.
mistakes.why: 她是人，感到困惑用 confused。

qs.s: The roller coaster was really ______.
qs.ex: 主詞是事物，表「令人興奮的」，用 exciting。
qs.hint: 先看主詞是人還是事物，再決定詞尾。

qs.s: Lily felt ______ about the trip.
qs.ex: 主詞是人，表「感到興奮」，用 excited。
qs.hint: 主詞是人，描述的是她自己的感受。

qs.s: The science show was ______, so all the kids watched it carefully.
qs.ex: 節目讓人感興趣，用 interesting。
qs.hint: 節目是引發興趣的來源，描述的是事物的特性。

qs.s: I was ______ by the difficult math problem.
qs.ex: 人感到困惑，用 confused。
qs.hint: 這裡是人受到影響而產生的狀態，要選形容詞並注意詞尾。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: My father was tiring after work.
My father was tired after work.
My father was tire after work.
My father was tiredly after work.
qs.ex: 人感到疲倦，用 tired；tiring 表「使人疲累的」。
qs.hint: 主詞是人，且空格要填形容詞，先排除不是形容詞的選項。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I am very interesting in this book.
qs.ex: 書是令人感興趣的，用 interesting；人才用 interested，且要說 be interested in。
qs.hint: 書是事物，另外檢查 be 與形容詞後面的介系詞用法與詞形。

title: 可數與不可數名詞及數量詞
formula: many / a few / few + 複數　；　much / a little / little + 不可數
intro: 點飲料時你會說「一杯水」、「幾張椅子」，中文量詞不同，英文也要分清楚可數與不可數。a few 和 a little 差一個字，意思就不同。學測的綜合測驗常考數量詞與名詞單複數的搭配。
rhyme: 可數用 many / few，不可數用 much / little

points.t: 可數名詞有單複數；不可數名詞（water, milk, money, advice, homework, news）不加 -s，也不加 a / an，動詞用單數。

ex.en: Water is important for all living things.
ex.zh: 水對所有生物都很重要。

ex.en: She drinks a lot of milk every morning.
ex.zh: 她每天早上都喝很多牛奶。

points.t: many, a few, few 接可數複數；much, a little, little 接不可數；a lot of 兩者皆可。

ex.en: Many students ride bikes to school.
ex.zh: 很多學生騎腳踏車上學。

ex.en: I don't have much time this afternoon.
ex.zh: 我今天下午沒有很多時間。

points.t: a few / a little 表「有一些」，語氣肯定；few / little 表「幾乎沒有」，語氣偏否定。

ex.en: There are a few chairs in the room.
ex.zh: 房間裡有幾張椅子。

ex.en: There is little water in the river, so the fish are in trouble.
ex.zh: 河裡幾乎沒有水，魚有麻煩了。

points.t: 不可數名詞要數量時，用 a piece of、a cup of、a bottle of 等單位詞來計算。

ex.en: She gave me a piece of useful advice.
ex.zh: 她給了我一個有用的建議。

ex.en: He drank a glass of milk before bed.
ex.zh: 他睡前喝了一杯牛奶。

points.t: 有些名詞看起來像複數，其實是不可數，要當單數動詞：news, homework, furniture。

ex.en: The news is very surprising.
ex.zh: 這個消息很令人驚訝。

ex.en: Your homework is on the desk.
ex.zh: 你的功課在桌上。

steps: 先判斷名詞是可數還是不可數（能不能直接數 one, two, three）。
選數量詞：可數複數用 many / a few / few，不可數用 much / a little / little。
想表達「有一些」用 a few / a little，想表達「幾乎沒有」用 few / little。完成：There is a little juice in the bottle.

compare.a: a few friends
compare.b: few friends
compare.note: 左邊是「有幾個朋友」，右邊是「幾乎沒有朋友」，語氣差很多。

compare.a: I have a little money.
compare.b: I have little money.
compare.note: 左邊表示有一點錢，右邊表示沒什麼錢，幾乎不夠用。

compare.a: much water
compare.b: many water
compare.note: water 是不可數，不能用 many。

mistakes.wrong: She gave me many good advices.
mistakes.right: She gave me a lot of good advice.
mistakes.why: advice 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不能用 many。

mistakes.wrong: There is a few water in the bottle.
mistakes.right: There is a little water in the bottle.
mistakes.why: water 不可數，要用 a little，不用 a few。

mistakes.wrong: The news are very surprising.
mistakes.right: The news is very surprising.
mistakes.why: news 是不可數名詞，動詞用單數。

qs.s: How ______ money do you need for the trip?
qs.ex: money 是不可數名詞，問數量用 how much。
qs.hint: 先判斷 money 是可數還是不可數，再決定怎麼問數量。

qs.s: There are ______ students in the library, so it is quiet.
qs.ex: students 是可數複數，few 表「幾乎沒有」，符合很安靜的語意。
qs.hint: 名詞是可數複數，且「很安靜」暗示人幾乎沒有。

qs.s: The teacher gave us a lot of ______ today.
qs.ex: homework 是不可數名詞，不加 s，也不加 a。
qs.hint: 這個名詞是不可數，檢查有沒有不該加的字尾或冠詞。

qs.s: Could I have ______ milk in my tea, please?
qs.ex: milk 不可數，「一點點」用 a little。
qs.hint: 名詞不可數，且語氣是肯定的「有一點」。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She gave me many good advices.
She gave me a lot of good advice.
She gave me a good advices.
She gave me much good advices.
qs.ex: advice 是不可數名詞，不加 s，可用 a lot of 修飾。
qs.hint: advice 不可數，檢查選項有沒有誤加字尾或誤用數量詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: There is a few water in the bottle.
I need a little help with this problem.
How many time do you have?
qs.ex: help 是不可數，a little help 正確；news 視為單數，water 用 a little，time 不可數要用 how much。
qs.hint: 逐一檢查每個選項的名詞可不可數與動詞單複數，只有一個完全正確。

title: if 條件句（真實條件）
formula: If + 現在式, S + will + VR
intro: 「如果明天下雨，我們就待在家。」這種說的是未來有可能發生的事，英文用 if 條件句。國中已經學過，高中要更精準：if 子句不用 will，並認識 unless。學測常考時態選擇與 unless 的用法。
rhyme: if 現在、主句 will，if 裡面不放 will

points.t: 表示未來可能發生的事：if 子句用現在簡單式，不可用 will。

ex.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home.
ex.zh: 如果明天下雨，我們就待在家。

ex.en: If the weather is nice tomorrow, we will go hiking.
ex.zh: 如果明天天氣好，我們就去健行。

points.t: 主要子句常用 will + VR，也可用 can、may，或直接用祈使句。

ex.en: If you study hard, you can pass the exam.
ex.zh: 如果你用功讀書，就能通過考試。

ex.en: If you see Tom, tell him to call me.
ex.zh: 如果你看到湯姆，叫他打給我。

points.t: if 子句的主詞是第三人稱單數時，動詞要加 s，不要因為是未來就加 will。

ex.en: If Sam comes late again, the teacher will be angry.
ex.zh: 如果山姆又遲到，老師會生氣。

ex.en: If she gets up early, she will catch the bus.
ex.zh: 如果她早起，就趕得上公車。

points.t: unless = if ... not，意思是「除非」；unless 已含否定，後面不再加 not。

ex.en: You will be late unless you hurry up.
ex.zh: 你如果不快點就會遲到。

ex.en: We will not go out unless the rain stops.
ex.zh: 除非雨停，否則我們不出門。

points.t: if 子句可放前面或後面；放前面時，中間要加逗號。

ex.en: We will have a picnic if it is sunny.
ex.zh: 如果天晴，我們就去野餐。

ex.en: If it is sunny, we will have a picnic.
ex.zh: 如果天晴，我們就去野餐。

steps: 先確認是「未來可能發生」的事。
寫 if 子句：If + 主詞 + 現在式動詞（注意第三人稱單數加 s），不放 will。
寫主要子句：will + 原形動詞（或 can / may / 祈使句），兩個子句中間用逗號。完成：If you leave now, you will catch the bus.

compare.a: If it rains, we will stay home.
compare.b: If it rained, we would stay home.
compare.note: 左邊是未來有可能發生；右邊是與現在事實相反的假設，高中才學。

compare.a: Unless you hurry, you will be late.
compare.b: If you don't hurry, you will be late.
compare.note: 兩句意思相同，unless 已含否定，不能再加 not。

mistakes.wrong: If it will rain tomorrow, we will stay home.
mistakes.right: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay home.
mistakes.why: if 子句表未來也要用現在式，不用 will。

mistakes.wrong: Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
mistakes.right: Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
mistakes.why: unless 本身是「如果不」，後面不再加 not。

mistakes.wrong: If you leave now, you catch the bus.
mistakes.right: If you leave now, you will catch the bus.
mistakes.why: 主要子句表未來，要用 will + 原形動詞。

qs.s: If the weather ______ good tomorrow, we will go camping.
qs.ex: if 子句表未來，用現在式 is，不用 will be。
qs.hint: if 子句表示未來，動詞要用什麼時態？

qs.s: If you ______ me your email, I will send you the photos.
qs.ex: if 子句用現在簡單式 tell。
qs.hint: if 子句不放助動詞，主詞是第二人稱，直接用現在式動詞。

qs.s: You won't pass the test ______ you study harder.
qs.ex: unless 表「除非」，等於 if you don't study harder。
qs.hint: 語意是「除非」，且空格後面沒有否定字。

qs.s: If Sam ______ late again, the teacher will be angry.
qs.ex: if 子句用現在式，Sam 是第三人稱單數，用 comes。
qs.hint: if 子句用現在式，注意主詞 Sam 是第三人稱單數。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If I will have time, I will help you.
If I have time, I will help you.
If I have time, I help will you.
If I had time, I will help you.
qs.ex: if 子句不用 will，主要子句用 will + VR；其餘選項時態或語序有誤。
qs.hint: 檢查每個選項 if 子句有沒有誤用助動詞，以及主要子句的語序。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If it is sunny tomorrow, we going to the beach.
Unless you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
If you will help me, I will be happy.
If you leave now, you will catch the bus.
qs.ex: if 子句用現在式，主要句用 will；其他選項分別缺少助動詞、unless 後多了 not、if 子句用 will。
qs.hint: 逐一檢查 if 子句與主要子句的時態，只有一個選項兩邊都正確。

title: too ... to 與 enough to
formula: too + adj + to V　／　adj + enough + to V
intro: 「這個箱子太重，我搬不動。」「她夠大了，可以自己出門。」這兩種句型分別是 too ... to 與 enough to。國中學過基本型，高中會把它和 so ... that 互相改寫。學測常考 enough 的位置、for 加受詞，以及不能重複否定。
rhyme: too 在前表太過，enough 在後表足夠

points.t: too + adj + to V 表示「太…而不能…」，本身已有否定的意思。

ex.en: It was too late to catch the last train.
ex.zh: 太晚了，趕不上末班車。

ex.en: The soup is too hot to drink.
ex.zh: 這碗湯太燙，不能喝。

points.t: 要說出做事的人時，在 to V 前加 for + 受詞。

ex.en: The box is too heavy for me to carry.
ex.zh: 這個箱子太重，我搬不動。
hl: too heavy for me to carry

ex.en: The question was too difficult for us to answer.
ex.zh: 這個問題太難，我們答不出來。

points.t: adj / adv + enough + to V 表示「夠…可以…」，enough 放在形容詞或副詞的後面。

ex.en: She is old enough to travel by herself.
ex.zh: 她夠大了，可以自己旅行。

ex.en: Mark is tall enough to reach the top shelf.
ex.zh: 馬克夠高，可以拿到最上層的架子。

points.t: enough 修飾名詞時放在名詞前面；放在形容詞或副詞後面時才是 adj + enough。

ex.en: We don't have enough money to buy a new car.
ex.zh: 我們的錢不夠買新車。

ex.en: He didn't run fast enough to win the race.
ex.zh: 他跑得不夠快，沒贏得比賽。

points.t: too ... to 可以改寫成 so ... that 句型，語意相同；高中常考這兩種改寫。

ex.en: The tea is too hot to drink.
ex.zh: 茶太燙，不能喝。

ex.en: The tea is so hot that I can't drink it.
ex.zh: 茶燙到我不能喝。
hl: so hot that I can't drink it

steps: 先決定是「太…而不能」（too）還是「夠…可以」（enough）。
too 放在形容詞前面；enough 放在形容詞或副詞後面，修飾名詞時放名詞前面。
要指出做事的人，在 to 前加 for + 受格；to 後面接原形動詞，不加 not。完成：The bag is too heavy for her to carry.

compare.a: He is too tired to walk.
compare.b: He is so tired that he can't walk.
compare.note: 兩句意思相同，右邊的 that 子句要有否定。

compare.a: He is old enough to drive.
compare.b: He is too old to drive.
compare.note: 左邊是夠大可以開車，右邊是太老不能開車，意思相反。

mistakes.wrong: He is too young to not drive a car.
mistakes.right: He is too young to drive a car.
mistakes.why: too ... to 已含否定，不能再加 not。

mistakes.wrong: The room is enough big to hold fifty people.
mistakes.right: The room is big enough to hold fifty people.
mistakes.why: enough 修飾形容詞時要放在形容詞後面。

mistakes.wrong: The question was too hard for I to answer.
mistakes.right: The question was too hard for me to answer.
mistakes.why: for 後面要用受格 me，不可用主格 I。

qs.s: The soup is ______ hot to drink right now.
qs.ex: too + adj + to V 表「太…而不能」；其他選項無法搭配 to drink。
qs.hint: 語意是太燙而不能喝，找出表示「太…而不能」的字。

qs.s: Mark is tall ______ to reach the top shelf.
qs.ex: adj + enough + to V 表「夠…可以」，enough 放在形容詞 tall 後面。
qs.hint: 語意是夠高可以拿到，注意這個字要放在形容詞的哪一邊。

qs.s: The question was too difficult ______ answer.
qs.ex: too + adj + for + 受格 + to V；受格是 me，且前面要有 for。
qs.hint: 動作執行者要用受格，而且前面要有介系詞。

qs.s: We don't have ______ money to buy a new car.
qs.ex: enough + 名詞 + to V 表「足夠的…可以…」。
qs.hint: 空格放在名詞前面，表示「足夠的」。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He is too young to not drive a car.
He is too young for drive a car.
He is too young to drive a car.
He is young too to drive a car.
qs.ex: too ... to V 本身已含否定，不加 not，to 後直接接原形動詞，too 放在形容詞前。
qs.hint: too 本身已有否定意味，不需要另外加否定，並看後面動詞的形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The room is enough big to hold fifty people.
The room is big enough to hold fifty people.
The room is big enough holding fifty people.
The room is big enough hold fifty people.
qs.ex: enough 放在形容詞後面，後接 to + 原形動詞。
qs.hint: enough 修飾形容詞時的位置要放後面，後面再接原形動詞。

title: that 引導的名詞子句
formula: S + V + that + S + V
intro: 你想轉述別人說的話，或表達自己的想法，像「老師說我們應該多讀書」、「我很高興你能來」，就會用 that 名詞子句，把一整件事放進另一個句子裡。高中的閱讀與綜合測驗幾乎每篇都有，常考 that 與 what 的分辨。
rhyme: that 之後完整句，缺主詞受詞才用 what

points.t: that 引導名詞子句，在句中當 think、know、find、realize 等動詞的受詞。

ex.en: My teacher says that we should read more English stories.
ex.zh: 我的老師說我們應該多讀英文故事。
hl: that we should read more English stories

ex.en: We soon found that the lake was too cold for swimming.
ex.zh: 我們很快發現湖水冷得不能游泳。
hl: that the lake was too cold for swimming

points.t: 形容詞（glad, sure, afraid, worried）後面也可接 that 子句，說明情緒或判斷的內容。

ex.en: I am glad that you can join our school trip.
ex.zh: 你能參加我們的校外教學，我很高興。
hl: that you can join our school trip

ex.en: She is sure that her team will win.
ex.zh: 她確定她的隊伍會贏。

points.t: that 本身沒有意義，也不是子句的成分；that 之後必須是完整的「主詞 + 動詞」。

ex.en: I know that he wants it.
ex.zh: 我知道他想要它。

ex.en: He knows that the bus has left.
ex.zh: 他知道公車已經開走了。

points.t: 作受詞時，that 常可省略，但保留會讓句子結構更清楚。

ex.en: I think that English is useful.
ex.zh: 我覺得英文很有用。

ex.en: Tom said he was too tired to join us.
ex.zh: 湯姆說他太累了，不能加入我們。

points.t: 高中會延伸到 that 子句當真主詞（搭配虛主詞 It）或補語。

ex.en: It is clear that the team needs more time to practice.
ex.zh: 很明顯這個隊伍需要更多時間練習。
hl: that the team needs more time to practice

ex.en: The fact is that I forgot my keys.
ex.zh: 事實是我忘了帶鑰匙。

steps: 先寫出主要句：主詞 + 動詞或 be + 形容詞，如 I am glad / She said。
在後面加 that，引導要說明的內容。
that 後面接完整的「主詞 + 動詞」子句，不能少主詞或受詞。完成：I am sure that she will arrive on time.

compare.a: I know that he wants it.
compare.b: I know what he wants.
compare.note: 左邊子句本身完整，用 that；右邊 wants 缺受詞，要用 what。

compare.a: I'm afraid that I will be late.
compare.b: I'm afraid of being late.
compare.note: afraid 後接子句時直接加 that，不加 of；接 of 時後面要接名詞或動名詞。

mistakes.wrong: I'm afraid of that I will be late.
mistakes.right: I'm afraid that I will be late.
mistakes.why: that 子句前面不加介系詞 of。

mistakes.wrong: She hopes what her son will pass the exam.
mistakes.right: She hopes that her son will pass the exam.
mistakes.why: 子句已完整，要用 that 而不是 what。

mistakes.wrong: I am sure that to win the game.
mistakes.right: I am sure that we will win the game.
mistakes.why: that 後面要接完整子句，不能接不定詞。

qs.s: Mia was surprised ______ her brother had cooked dinner for the whole family.
qs.ex: surprised 後接完整子句說明驚訝的內容，用 that 引導；what、which、where 都不適合連接這個完整子句。
qs.hint: 空格後面是完整的子句，要選能連接完整子句的連接詞，而不是疑問代名詞。

qs.s: The doctor told us ______ we should drink more water in hot weather.
qs.ex: told us 後面要接完整的名詞子句，用 that 引導；子句內 drink 已有受詞 water，不能用 what。
qs.hint: 後面接名詞子句，子句內的動詞已有受詞。

qs.s: I believe ______ honesty is the best policy in any friendship.
qs.ex: believe 後接 that 名詞子句；honesty is the best policy 是完整句，不需要 what 或 how。
qs.hint: 後面的內容是完整的句子，沒有缺主詞或受詞。

qs.s: It is clear ______ the team needs more time to practice before the contest.
qs.ex: 形容詞 clear 後面的內容是完整子句，用 that 引導。
qs.hint: 形容詞後面接的是完整子句，找出沒有意義、只作連接用的字。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She hopes what her son will pass the exam.
He said that he was too tired to join us.
I am sure that to win the game.
It is true what he can sing well.
qs.ex: B 的 that 後面接完整子句。A 不能用 what；C 的 that 後面不能接不定詞；D 應該用 that 而不是 what。
qs.hint: 逐一檢查連接詞用法，並注意連接詞之後是不是完整子句。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I'm afraid of that I will be late.
I'm afraid that will I be late.
I'm afraid what I will be late.
I'm afraid that I will be late.
qs.ex: 名詞子句不倒裝，且 afraid 後直接接 that，不加 of；what 也不能引導完整子句。
qs.hint: 形容詞後面直接接子句，不加介系詞，也不倒裝。

title: 虛主詞 It 與不定詞片語
formula: It + be + adj + (for/of + O) + to V
intro: 「早起很難」可以說 To get up early is hard，但這樣主詞太長，英文習慣用虛主詞 It 放句首，真正的主詞放句尾。要說出做事的人時，到底用 for 還是 of？這是學測與段考的熱門陷阱。
rhyme: 形容事用 for，稱讚人用 of，It 開頭 to 殿後

points.t: 主詞是一長串不定詞片語時，用虛主詞 it 放句首，真正的主詞 to V 放句尾。

ex.en: It is not easy to learn a new language in a month.
ex.zh: 一個月內學會一種新語言並不容易。
hl: It is not easy to learn

ex.en: It is fun to cook with my family.
ex.zh: 和家人一起煮菜很有趣。

points.t: for + 受詞 表示動作的執行者，放在形容詞與 to V 之間。

ex.en: It is important for students to get enough sleep.
ex.zh: 學生獲得足夠的睡眠很重要。
hl: It is important for students to get

ex.en: It is necessary for us to wear helmets.
ex.zh: 我們有必要戴安全帽。

points.t: 形容詞若描述人的個性或品行（kind, nice, rude, polite, careless），要用 of，而不是 for。

ex.en: It was kind of the stranger to show us the way.
ex.zh: 那位陌生人好心地為我們指路。
hl: It was kind of the stranger to show

ex.en: It is nice of you to bring me lunch.
ex.zh: 你真好心，幫我帶午餐。

points.t: 判斷方法：把 of 句改成「人 + be + adj」，句子通順就用 of。

ex.en: It is rude of him to talk loudly in class.
ex.zh: 他在課堂上大聲說話很沒禮貌。

ex.en: It is hard for him to wake up early.
ex.zh: 他要早起很困難。
hl: hard for him to wake up

points.t: 虛主詞句可以改寫成不定詞當主詞，意思不變，但日常用法較少，高中閱讀要認得。

ex.en: It is hard to keep a diary every day.
ex.zh: 每天寫日記很難。

ex.en: To keep a diary every day is hard.
ex.zh: 每天寫日記很難。
hl: To keep a diary every day

steps: 先寫 It is + 形容詞。
看形容詞：描述事情（easy, hard, necessary, important）用 for + 受詞；描述人品行（kind, nice, polite）用 of + 受詞。
最後接 to + 原形動詞，to 不能省略。完成：It is hard for me to wake up early.

compare.a: It is kind of you to help.
compare.b: It is easy for you to help.
compare.note: kind 描述人的品行用 of；easy 描述事情難易用 for。

compare.a: It is important to sleep well.
compare.b: To sleep well is important.
compare.note: 兩句同義，左邊用虛主詞，較自然也較常見。

mistakes.wrong: It is kind for you to help me.
mistakes.right: It is kind of you to help me.
mistakes.why: kind 是形容人品行的字，要用 of。

mistakes.wrong: It is hard for me understand this poem.
mistakes.right: It is hard for me to understand this poem.
mistakes.why: 虛主詞句的真主詞是 to V，to 不能省略。

mistakes.wrong: Is necessary to wear helmets.
mistakes.right: It is necessary to wear helmets.
mistakes.why: 句首缺少虛主詞 It。

qs.s: It is not easy ______ a good habit in just one week.
qs.ex: It is + adj + to V，真主詞用不定詞 to build。
qs.hint: 虛主詞對應的真主詞要用什麼形式？

qs.s: It is necessary ______ all students to wear helmets when riding bikes.
qs.ex: necessary 描述事情的必要性，動作執行者前用 for。
qs.hint: necessary 描述的是事情的必要性，不是人的品格。

qs.s: It was very polite ______ Tom to give his seat to the old lady.
qs.ex: polite 是描述人品行的形容詞，故用 of Tom。
qs.hint: polite 是描述人的品行的形容詞。

qs.s: ______ is difficult for me to wake up before six o'clock.
qs.ex: 空格要放虛主詞 it，真主詞是後面的 to wake up。
qs.hint: 句首要放虛主詞，代替後面真正的主詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It is hard for me understand this poem.
Is hard for me to understand this poem.
It is hard for me to understand this poem.
It is hard of me to understand this poem.
qs.ex: A 缺少 to；B 缺少虛主詞 It；D 的 hard 描述事情難易，應用 for 而非 of。
qs.hint: 檢查不定詞符號有沒有缺少、句首有沒有虛主詞，以及介系詞是否符合形容詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It is nice for you bring me lunch.
It is nice of you bring me lunch.
It is nice you of to bring me lunch.
It is nice of you to bring me lunch.
qs.ex: 稱讚人的形容詞（nice、kind）用 It is + adj. + of + 人 + to V；to 不可省略，for 也不能用在這裡。
qs.hint: 稱讚人的品格的形容詞有固定搭配的介系詞，而且不定詞符號不能省略。

title: 間接問句
formula: S + V + wh-word + S + V
intro: 問路時我們說「請問你知道圖書館在哪裡嗎？」，原本的問句 Where is the library? 被放進句子裡，語序要重新排。這是名詞子句的一種，常作 know、tell、ask 的受詞。高中的閱讀與寫作題常考不倒裝、時態還原。
rhyme: 疑問詞後不倒裝，did 一拿掉、動詞回過去

points.t: 把疑問句放進另一個句子，就成為間接問句，在句中當名詞子句（常作受詞）。

ex.en: Do you know where the school library is?
ex.zh: 你知道學校圖書館在哪裡嗎？

ex.en: Let me ask him how many books he returned.
ex.zh: 讓我問他還了幾本書。

points.t: 要用「疑問詞 + 主詞 + 動詞」的肯定句語序，不倒裝，也不加 do / does / did。

ex.en: I can't remember what time the movie starts.
ex.zh: 我不記得電影幾點開始。

ex.en: I wonder how much this jacket costs.
ex.zh: 我不知道這件外套多少錢。

points.t: 沒有疑問詞的 Yes / No 問句，改用 if 或 whether 引導。

ex.en: Please tell me whether you will come to the party.
ex.zh: 請告訴我你是否會來派對。

ex.en: She asked if I had finished my homework.
ex.zh: 她問我功課寫完了沒。

points.t: 原本的 did 拿掉後，動詞要還原成過去式：What did he say? → I know what he said.

ex.en: Can you tell me what he said?
ex.zh: 你可以告訴我他說了什麼嗎？

ex.en: She asked me where I had bought the bag.
ex.zh: 她問我在哪裡買的包包。
hl: where I had bought the bag

points.t: 高中會延伸：whether 可接 or not，也可以放在句首當主詞；if 不能放句首當主詞。

ex.en: Whether he will join us is still unknown.
ex.zh: 他會不會加入我們還不知道。

ex.en: I am not sure whether or not it will rain.
ex.zh: 我不確定會不會下雨。
hl: whether or not it will rain

steps: 先寫出原本的疑問句，找出疑問詞（Yes / No 問句則沒有）。
把問句改成直述句語序：主詞 + 動詞，拿掉 do / does / did，動詞依時態還原。
前面加上 Do you know / I wonder / Could you tell me，沒有疑問詞時用 if / whether 連接。完成：Could you tell me when the train leaves?

compare.a: I know where he lives.
compare.b: Where does he live?
compare.note: 左邊是間接問句不倒裝；右邊是直接問句，要倒裝並加 does。

compare.a: Whether he comes is unknown.
compare.b: If he comes is unknown.
compare.note: 放在句首當主詞時只能用 whether，不能用 if。

mistakes.wrong: I don't know where is the post office.
mistakes.right: I don't know where the post office is.
mistakes.why: 間接問句不倒裝，主詞放在動詞前面。

mistakes.wrong: Do you know what did he say?
mistakes.right: Do you know what he said?
mistakes.why: 間接問句不加 did，動詞要還原成過去式 said。

mistakes.wrong: Tell me what do you want for lunch.
mistakes.right: Tell me what you want for lunch.
mistakes.why: 間接問句不加 do，直接用「主詞 + 動詞」。

qs.s: Can you tell me ______ the nearest bookstore is?
qs.ex: 間接問句語序為「疑問詞＋主詞＋動詞」，所以是 where the nearest bookstore is。
qs.hint: 後面已有主詞與動詞，疑問詞之後不要倒裝。

qs.s: Nobody knows why ______ the meeting yesterday.
qs.ex: 間接問句不加助動詞 did，動詞改回過去式 missed。
qs.hint: 間接問句不加助動詞，動詞要依時態還原。

qs.s: Do you know ______ the museum opens on Mondays?
qs.ex: 原問句是 Yes/No 問句，應用 whether 引導，意思是「是否」。
qs.hint: 原問句是 Yes / No 問句，找出表示「是否」的連接詞。

qs.s: Let me ask him how many books ______ to the library.
qs.ex: how many books 之後接主詞＋動詞，用過去式 he returned，不倒裝。
qs.hint: 疑問詞後面接主詞與動詞，時態是過去式，不倒裝。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I wonder how much does this jacket cost.
Tell me what do you want for lunch.
She asked me where I had bought the bag.
Do you know who is that girl?
qs.ex: C 語序正確。A、B、D 都把疑問句的倒裝或助動詞帶進了名詞子句。
qs.hint: 逐項找出把倒裝或助動詞帶進名詞子句的選項。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Could you tell me when does the train leave?
Could you tell me when the train leaves?
Could you tell me when did the train leave?
Could you tell me when leaves the train?
qs.ex: 間接問句要把 the train leaves 放在 when 之後，不倒裝、不用 does/did。
qs.hint: 疑問詞後面要接「主詞 + 動詞」，不加助動詞。

title: 關係代名詞與形容詞子句
formula: N + who/which/that + V；N, who/which + V
intro: 想描述「坐在我旁邊的那個男孩」或「我昨天看的那部電影」，就需要關係代名詞，把兩個句子合成一個。高中作文與閱讀測驗常用形容詞子句讓句子更豐富，段考最愛考關代的選擇與有逗號的非限定用法。
rhyme: 人 who、物 which、that 通用，逗號後不用 that

points.t: 關係代名詞引導形容詞子句修飾前面的名詞（先行詞）：人用 who / that，物用 which / that。

ex.en: The boy who sits next to me is good at math.
ex.zh: 坐在我旁邊的那個男孩數學很好。

ex.en: The book that I borrowed from the library is very funny.
ex.zh: 我從圖書館借來的那本書很好笑。
hl: that I borrowed from the library

points.t: 所有格用 whose，後面直接接名詞，表示「…的…」。

ex.en: I have a friend whose father is a famous chef.
ex.zh: 我有一個朋友，他的爸爸是名廚。
hl: whose father is a famous chef

ex.en: I know a girl whose dog can dance.
ex.zh: 我認識一個女孩，她的狗會跳舞。

points.t: 限定用法（不加逗號）用來指出是哪一個人或物，沒有它句意就不完整。

ex.en: The students who study hard usually do well.
ex.zh: 用功的學生通常表現很好。

ex.en: The girl who won the singing contest is my cousin.
ex.zh: 贏得歌唱比賽的女孩是我表妹。

points.t: 非限定用法（加逗號）只是補充說明，不可用 that，受格關代也不可省略。

ex.en: My grandmother, who lives in Tainan, makes delicious rice cakes.
ex.zh: 我住在台南的外婆會做美味的年糕。

ex.en: My dog, which is only two years old, loves swimming.
ex.zh: 我的狗才兩歲，很愛游泳。
hl: which is only two years old

points.t: 關代在子句中已代替了名詞，不可再重複主詞或受詞；限定用法中，當受詞的關代可省略。

ex.en: The pen which I bought is blue.
ex.zh: 我買的那支筆是藍色的。

ex.en: The movie we watched yesterday was great.
ex.zh: 我們昨天看的電影很棒。

steps: 先找出兩個句子中重複的名詞，例如 The boy is my cousin. / He sits next to me.
把第二句的重複名詞換成關代：人用 who，物用 which，所有格用 whose；限定用法可用 that。
把子句放在先行詞後面；補充說明時前後加逗號，且不可用 that。完成：The boy who sits next to me is my cousin.

compare.a: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
compare.b: The man, who lives next door, is a doctor.
compare.note: 沒有逗號是指出哪位先生；有逗號只是補充說明，這個人已是特定的。

compare.a: The book that I like is on the desk.
compare.b: My book, which I like, is on the desk.
compare.note: 非限定用法（有逗號）不可用 that。

mistakes.wrong: The man who he sits there is my uncle.
mistakes.right: The man who sits there is my uncle.
mistakes.why: who 已經代替了 he，不能再重複主詞。

mistakes.wrong: My bike, that is red, is new.
mistakes.right: My bike, which is red, is new.
mistakes.why: 有逗號的非限定用法不可用 that。

mistakes.wrong: The pen which I bought it is blue.
mistakes.right: The pen which I bought is blue.
mistakes.why: which 已代替受詞 it，不可重複。

qs.s: The girl ______ won the singing contest is my cousin.
qs.ex: 先行詞是人且在子句中作主詞，用 who。
qs.hint: 先行詞是人，且在子句中作主詞。

qs.s: I lost the umbrella ______ my aunt gave me last week.
qs.ex: 先行詞是物，關代作 gave 的受詞，用 that。
qs.hint: 先行詞是物，在子句中作受詞，找出限定用法可用的關代。

qs.s: Mr. Lin, ______ teaches us history, is very funny.
qs.ex: 有逗號的非限定用法不能用 that；先行詞是人，用 who。
qs.hint: 有逗號是非限定用法，要選不是 that 的關代。

qs.s: I have a friend ______ father is a famous chef.
qs.ex: 空格後的 father 是「朋友的爸爸」，需要所有格 whose。
qs.hint: 空格後面的名詞是「朋友的…」，屬於前面的人。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The man who he sits there is my uncle.
The pen which I bought it is blue.
The movie that we watched yesterday was great.
The student whose he lost the bag is crying.
qs.ex: C 正確。A、B、D 在關代之後又重複了代名詞，重複了子句中的主詞或受詞。
qs.hint: 逐項檢查關代後面有沒有重複主詞或受詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: My dog, that is only two years old, loves swimming.
My dog, what is only two years old, loves swimming.
My dog which, is only two years old, loves swimming.
My dog, which is only two years old, loves swimming.
qs.ex: 補充說明用有逗號的 which；that 與 what 都不能用在非限定用法，逗號位置也要在 which 之前。
qs.hint: 注意逗號位置與非限定用法可用的關代。

title: 使役動詞 have / make
formula: have/make + O + V（原形）
intro: 想說「老師叫我們排隊」「弟弟逗得我哈哈大笑」，主詞不是自己動手，而是讓別人去做事，這時就用使役動詞 have 和 make。這個句型後面的動詞很容易加錯 to 或 -ing，所以是學測文法選擇題的常客。
rhyme: have 請你做、make 逼你做，受詞後面接原形，to 不要來！

points.t: have + 人 + 原形動詞：表示請託或安排某人去做事，語氣平和。

ex.en: The teacher had us line up outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 老師請我們在教室外排隊。

ex.en: The manager had the waiter bring a menu to our table.
ex.zh: 經理請服務生把菜單拿到我們桌上。

points.t: make + 人 + 原形動詞：帶有強迫或「使某人產生某種反應」的意味。

ex.en: Mom made Ken clean his room before dinner.
ex.zh: 媽媽要肯在晚餐前打掃房間。

ex.en: My little brother always makes me laugh.
ex.zh: 我的弟弟總是讓我發笑。

points.t: 受詞後面的動詞要用「原形」，不加 to，也不改成 V-ing 或過去式；時態只改變 have / make 本身。

ex.en: Dad made me wash the dishes after I broke the cup.
ex.zh: 我打破杯子後，爸爸要我洗碗。

points.t: make 變成被動語態時，原本省略的 to 要補回來。

ex.en: We were made to clean the room after the party ended.
ex.zh: 派對結束後，我們被要求打掃房間。

steps: 先決定語氣：只是請對方做事用 have；要求、強迫或造成某種結果用 make。
寫出主詞 + have / make，並依時間調整時態（had、made、makes…）。
接上「做動作的人」當受詞，例如 us、the players。
最後接原形動詞與其他內容，不加 to。例句：My mom made me finish my homework before dinner.

compare.a: The teacher made us clean the room.
compare.b: We were made to clean the room.
compare.note: 主動語態不加 to，改成被動語態後 to 要補回來。

compare.a: Mom had me wash the car.
compare.b: Mom made me wash the car.
compare.note: have 語氣平和（請我洗），make 帶強迫意味（逼我洗）。

compare.a: The teacher had us line up.
compare.b: The teacher asked us to line up.
compare.note: have 後面接原形，ask 後面要接 to V，兩者結構不同。

mistakes.wrong: The teacher made us to clean the room.
mistakes.right: The teacher made us clean the room.
mistakes.why: 主動語態的使役動詞後面不能加 to。

mistakes.wrong: My mom made me finishing my homework.
mistakes.right: My mom made me finish my homework.
mistakes.why: 受詞後面要用原形動詞，不用 V-ing。

mistakes.wrong: The coach had the players ran ten laps.
mistakes.right: The coach had the players run ten laps.
mistakes.why: 使役動詞後接原形，不隨時態變成過去式。

qs.s: Our English teacher had us ______ a short speech every Friday.
qs.ex: have + O + 原形動詞，空格要填 give。
qs.hint: have 是使役動詞，受詞 us 後面的動詞要用什麼形態？記得不加 to。

qs.s: The sad movie made several students ______ in the theater.
qs.ex: make + O + 原形動詞，不加 to。
qs.hint: 看 made 與 several students 之後的動詞：使役動詞後不加 to，也不變化詞形。

qs.s: Dad made me ______ the dishes after I broke the cup.
qs.ex: make me 之後接原形動詞 wash。
qs.hint: made me 之後的動詞用什麼形式？回想 make 的句型公式。

qs.s: Please have the waiter ______ some more water to our table.
qs.ex: have + O + 原形，waiter 與 bring 是主動關係。
qs.hint: waiter 與動作之間是主動關係，have 的受詞後面該接哪一種動詞形式？

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: My mom made me to finish my homework.
My mom made me finishing my homework.
My mom made me finish my homework.
My mom made me finished my homework.
qs.ex: made me 之後接原形動詞 finish；A 多了 to，B 用了 V-ing，D 用了過去式。
qs.hint: 逐項檢查 made me 之後的動詞：有沒有多餘的 to、-ing 或過去式？

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The coach had the players to run ten laps.
The coach had the players run ten laps.
The coach had the players ran ten laps.
The coach had the players runs ten laps.
qs.ex: have + O + 原形，不加 to，也不加動詞變化。
qs.hint: have the players 後面的動詞不加 to，也不變化詞形，請逐項檢查。

title: 強調句型 It is ... that
formula: It is/was + 被強調部分 + that + ...
intro: 當你想說「打破窗戶的『就是』艾咪」「我『是在圖書館』寫作業的」，就是要把某一個重點特別拉出來強調。英文用 It is/was ... that 把重點夾在中間，其他資訊放在 that 後面。學測常考連接詞選擇、be 動詞時態與句型判斷。
rhyme: It is/was 夾重點，that 後面接剩下，時態跟著原句走！

points.t: 強調主詞：把主詞放在 It was 與 that 之間，that 後面直接接原句的動詞。

ex.en: It was Amy that broke the window yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天打破窗戶的是艾咪。

ex.en: It was my brother that borrowed my bike without asking.
ex.zh: 沒問就借走我腳踏車的是我哥哥。
hl: It was my brother that borrowed

points.t: 強調受詞：原句 I wanted to buy the red hat. 要強調 the red hat，就把它搬到 It was 之後。

ex.en: It was the red hat that I wanted to buy.
ex.zh: 我想買的就是那頂紅帽子。
hl: It was the red hat that

points.t: 強調時間或地點副詞：副詞（片語）也能夾在中間，連接詞仍然用 that。

ex.en: It is in the library that I do my homework every day.
ex.zh: 我每天是在圖書館寫作業的。
hl: It is in the library that

ex.en: It was last Sunday that we went hiking.
ex.zh: 我們是上週日去健行的。

points.t: It is / It was 的時態要配合原句：原句是過去的事就用 was，現在習慣或事實用 is。

ex.en: It was Lisa that won the first prize in last year's contest.
ex.zh: 去年比賽拿到第一名的是莉莎。

ex.en: It is in the morning that I feel most energetic.
ex.zh: 我是在早上覺得最有精神。
hl: It is in the morning that

points.t: 強調的是「人」時，that 可以換成 who；強調時間、地點則一律用 that。

ex.en: It was Tom who broke the vase last week.
ex.zh: 上週打破花瓶的是湯姆。

steps: 先寫出完整原句，例如：We cleaned the classroom yesterday.
選出要強調的成分（主詞、受詞或時間地點），例如 yesterday。
寫 It was（依原句時態）+ 被強調成分 + that。
把原句剩下的部分照原順序接在 that 後面。完成：It was yesterday that we cleaned the classroom.

compare.a: It was Tom that left early.
compare.b: It was a pity that he left early.
compare.note: 前者拿掉 It was ... that 後仍是完整句（強調句）；後者是形式主詞，that 子句才是真正的主詞。

compare.a: It was the red hat that I wanted to buy.
compare.b: The red hat is what I wanted to buy.
compare.note: 前者是強調句型，後者用 what 名詞子句當補語，結構與用法不同。

mistakes.wrong: It was the red hat what I wanted to buy.
mistakes.right: It was the red hat that I wanted to buy.
mistakes.why: 強調句的連接詞用 that，不能用 what。

mistakes.wrong: It is Tom that broke the vase last week.
mistakes.right: It was Tom that broke the vase last week.
mistakes.why: 原句是過去的事，be 動詞要用 was。

mistakes.wrong: It was yesterday we that cleaned the classroom.
mistakes.right: It was yesterday that we cleaned the classroom.
mistakes.why: that 要緊接在被強調的成分後面，語序不能亂。

qs.s: It was my brother ______ borrowed my bike without asking.
qs.ex: 強調句型 It was ... that，強調的是主詞 my brother。
qs.hint: 這是強調句型，It was 與空格之間夾著被強調的成分，空格要填這個句型固定使用的連接詞。

qs.s: It is in the morning ______ I feel most energetic.
qs.ex: 強調時間副詞 in the morning，用 that 連接。
qs.hint: 被強調的是時間副詞 in the morning，這種情況要選哪個通用的連接詞？

qs.s: ______ was at the school gate that we met our new teacher.
qs.ex: 強調句的句首要用 It。
qs.hint: 強調句型的固定開頭是什麼字？注意空格在句首，後面接 was。

qs.s: It ______ Lisa that won the first prize in last year's contest.
qs.ex: 原句時間是 last year，所以 be 動詞要用過去式 was。
qs.hint: 原句的時間點是 last year，想想 be 動詞要配合過去還是現在。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It was the red hat what I wanted to buy.
It was the red hat that I wanted to buy.
It the red hat was that I wanted to buy.
Was it the red hat that wanted I to buy.
qs.ex: B 正確。A 用了 what；C 與 D 的語序混亂。
qs.hint: 比較各項在 red hat 後面接的連接詞，以及語序是否仍然正常。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It is yesterday that we cleaned the classroom.
It was yesterday we that cleaned the classroom.
It was yesterday that we cleaned the classroom.
It was yesterday that cleaned we the classroom.
qs.ex: C 正確。A 的 is 與 yesterday 時態不符；B 的 we 放在 that 前面，語序錯誤；D 的 cleaned we 語序錯誤。
qs.hint: 看 yesterday 與 be 動詞的時態是否一致，並檢查連接詞後面的主詞與動詞語序。

title: 使役動詞 have + O + p.p.
formula: have + O + p.p.
intro: 剪頭髮、修腳踏車、拍證件照，這些事我們通常不是自己動手，而是請別人完成；有時也會不幸遇到手機被偷。這種「東西被處理」的意思，英文用 have + 物 + p.p. 表示。學測常考你能不能辨別該用原形還是過去分詞。
rhyme: 東西被處理，have + 物 + p.p.；人去做事，have + 人 + 原形。

points.t: 表示「請別人（或花錢）讓某件事被完成」，受詞是事物，與動詞是被動關係，所以用過去分詞。

ex.en: I had my bike repaired at the shop near school.
ex.zh: 我請學校附近的店把腳踏車修好了。

ex.en: Rita had her hair dyed at a new salon last weekend.
ex.zh: 芮塔上週末在一家新髮廊把頭髮染了。

points.t: 受詞與動詞是「被動關係」才用 p.p.：東西是被拍、被修、被剪的，不是自己做動作。

ex.en: Ella will have her photo taken for the school ID card.
ex.zh: 艾拉會去拍學生證用的照片。

points.t: 也可以表示遭遇不好的事（被偷、被弄壞），語氣是「某事發生在我身上」。

ex.en: Tom had his phone stolen on the crowded bus.
ex.zh: 湯姆在擁擠的公車上被偷了手機。

ex.en: Ben had his bag stolen while he was shopping.
ex.zh: 班在逛街時包包被偷了。

points.t: 如果受詞是「會主動做動作的人」，就改用 have + 人 + 原形動詞，不用 p.p.。

ex.en: I had Tom fix my bike after school.
ex.zh: 我放學後請湯姆修我的腳踏車。

points.t: have 可以依時態變化，p.p. 的位置不變。

ex.en: Sam is having his teeth checked this afternoon.
ex.zh: 山姆今天下午要去檢查牙齒。

steps: 先想：這件事是請別人做，或是遭遇的狀況嗎？受詞是物（被處理）還是人（會做動作）？
寫出主詞 + have（依時間改為 had、has、will have、having）。
接上被處理的事物當受詞，例如 my hair、my bike。
把動詞改成過去分詞放在最後。完成：I had my hair cut yesterday.

compare.a: I had my bike repaired.
compare.b: I repaired my bike.
compare.note: 前者是請人修（或發生在我身上），後者是我自己動手修。

compare.a: I had my essay checked.
compare.b: I had Tom check my essay.
compare.note: 受詞是事物用 p.p.；受詞是人用原形動詞。

compare.a: She had her bag stolen.
compare.b: She stole a bag.
compare.note: 前者是包包被偷，後者是她偷了東西，意思完全相反。

mistakes.wrong: I had my essay check by my teacher.
mistakes.right: I had my essay checked by my teacher.
mistakes.why: essay 是被檢查的，動詞要用過去分詞。

mistakes.wrong: She had her picture taking at the park.
mistakes.right: She had her picture taken at the park.
mistakes.why: 受詞與動詞是被動關係，不能用 V-ing。

mistakes.wrong: I had my bike to repair at the shop.
mistakes.right: I had my bike repaired at the shop.
mistakes.why: have + O + p.p. 不接 to V。

qs.s: I'm going to have my broken watch ______ tomorrow.
qs.ex: watch 是被修理的對象，用被動意義的過去分詞 fixed。
qs.hint: watch 是被處理的對象，受詞和動詞是主動還是被動關係？

qs.s: Rita had her hair ______ at a new salon last weekend.
qs.ex: hair 被染，是被動關係，用 p.p. dyed。
qs.hint: hair 與動作之間是被動關係，選擇表示被動的動詞形態，注意別選過去式。

qs.s: We had the classroom ______ by the cleaners during the winter break.
qs.ex: classroom 是被油漆的對象，要用 painted。
qs.hint: classroom 是被處理的對象，而不是自己做動作，要用被動的動詞形式。

qs.s: Mr. Chen had his car ______ while he was shopping in the mall.
qs.ex: car 被偷，用 p.p. stolen；stole 是過去式，不可用在這個位置。
qs.hint: 車子是「被偷」，要選過去分詞，不是過去式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I had my essay check by my teacher.
I had my essay checked by my teacher.
I had my essay checking by my teacher.
I had my essay to check by my teacher.
qs.ex: essay 與 check 是被動關係，需用過去分詞 checked。
qs.hint: 看 had my essay 之後的動詞：essay 是被檢查的，要用哪種動詞形式？

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She had her picture take at the park.
She had her picture taking at the park.
She had her picture to take at the park.
She had her picture taken at the park.
qs.ex: have + O + p.p.，picture 是被拍的對象，用 taken。
qs.hint: 逐項檢查 her picture 之後的動詞：picture 是被拍的對象，哪一項是過去分詞？

title: 愈…愈…（比較級句型）
formula: The + 比較級 + S + V, the + 比較級 + S + V
intro: 「練習愈多，彈得愈好」「愈早出門，愈不塞車」，這種兩件事一起變化的說法，英文用 The + 比較級 ..., the + 比較級 ... 表達。句型像兩個對稱的零件，學測常考你有沒有漏掉 the 或寫成原級。
rhyme: The 比較級，the 比較級，兩個 the 一個都不能少！

points.t: 基本結構：前後各有一個「the + 比較級」，中間用逗號隔開，意思是「愈…就愈…」。

ex.en: The more you practice, the better you play.
ex.zh: 你練習得愈多，就彈得愈好。
hl: The more you practice, the better you play

points.t: 前後兩個子句各有主詞與動詞：前半是條件或原因，後半是結果。

ex.en: The earlier we leave, the less traffic we will meet.
ex.zh: 我們愈早出發，就會遇到愈少車潮。
hl: The earlier we leave, the less traffic we will meet

ex.en: The longer I waited, the more nervous I felt.
ex.zh: 我等得愈久，就愈緊張。
hl: The longer I waited, the more nervous I felt

points.t: 比較級要依規則變化：短的字加 -er（high → higher），較長的字加 more。

ex.en: The higher we climbed, the colder the air became.
ex.zh: 我們爬得愈高，空氣就變得愈冷。
hl: The higher we climbed, the colder the air became

ex.en: The more carefully you read, the fewer mistakes you will make.
ex.zh: 你讀得愈仔細，犯的錯就愈少。
hl: The more carefully you read, the fewer mistakes you will make

points.t: 口語中常省略主詞與動詞，變成簡短的固定說法。

ex.en: Can I send you the file now? The sooner, the better.
ex.zh: 我現在可以把檔案寄給你嗎？愈快愈好。

steps: 先想好兩件互相影響的事，例如「努力」與「成績」。
為兩邊各找出比較級：harder、better。
在兩個比較級前面各加 the。
各接主詞與動詞，中間用逗號。完成：The harder you study, the better grades you will get.

compare.a: It gets colder and colder.
compare.b: The colder it gets, the more people stay home.
compare.note: more and more 表示一件事「愈來愈…」；The + 比較級 句型表示兩件事「一個愈…另一個就愈…」。

compare.a: The higher we climbed, the colder the air became.
compare.b: The air became colder as we climbed higher.
compare.note: 兩句意思相同，as 句型不需要 the。

mistakes.wrong: The more you read, more you learn.
mistakes.right: The more you read, the more you learn.
mistakes.why: 後半句也要有 the。

mistakes.wrong: The hard you work, the better results you get.
mistakes.right: The harder you work, the better results you get.
mistakes.why: 前半句要用比較級 harder，不能用原級。

mistakes.wrong: The more you eat, the most you gain.
mistakes.right: The more you eat, the more you gain.
mistakes.why: 此句型用比較級，不能用最高級 most。

qs.s: The ______ you study, the better grades you will get.
qs.ex: 此句型要用比較級 harder，並且前面有 the。
qs.hint: 這是「愈…愈…」句型，空格要放什麼等級的形容詞？注意前面已經有定冠詞。

qs.s: The more water you drink, ______ you will feel.
qs.ex: 後半句也要有 the + 比較級，所以是 the healthier。
qs.hint: 前半句有 The more，後半句要對應什麼結構？兩半句前面都要有定冠詞。

qs.s: The faster he ran, ______ his heart beat.
qs.ex: 後半句要是 the + 比較級，不可省略 the。
qs.hint: 前半句已經是比較級結構，後半句需要同樣的對稱結構（定冠詞 + 比較級副詞）。

qs.s: ______ you practice the piano, the more smoothly you will play.
qs.ex: 前半句也要用 the + 比較級，所以是 The more often。
qs.hint: 前半句也要用「the + 比較級」放在句首；often 的比較級是加 more。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The more you eat, more you gain.
The more you eat, the more you gain.
More you eat, the more you gain.
The more you eat, the most you gain.
qs.ex: 兩個比較級前都要有 the，且不能用最高級 most。
qs.hint: 逐項檢查兩個比較級前面是否都有定冠詞，並注意有沒有用到最高級。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The higher we climbed, the cold the air became.
The high we climbed, the colder the air became.
The higher we climbed, colder the air became.
The higher we climbed, the colder the air became.
qs.ex: 前後都要用 the + 比較級；A 的 cold 是原級，B 的 high 是原級，C 缺少 the。
qs.hint: 逐項檢查前後兩半是否都是「定冠詞 + 比較級」，有沒有留下原級或漏掉定冠詞。

title: 分詞構句（表連續或附帶動作）
formula: S + V, V-ing / p.p. ...
intro: 寫作文或閱讀文章時，常看到 He fell, breaking his leg. 這種逗號後面直接接 V-ing 的句子，是把兩個動作寫得更簡潔的方法。學測會考你分詞該用 V-ing 還是 p.p.，以及能不能再加 and。
rhyme: 同主詞、省連接詞，主動用 V-ing，被動情緒用 p.p.！

points.t: 兩個動作的主詞相同時，可以省略連接詞和後面的主詞，把動詞改成分詞，放在逗號後面。

ex.en: Lily opened the window, letting fresh air into the room.
ex.zh: 莉莉打開窗戶，讓新鮮空氣進到房間。
hl: letting fresh air into the room

points.t: 放在句尾的 V-ing 可表示「接續發生的動作」，也可以表示前面動作造成的「結果」。

ex.en: The bus broke down on the highway, making us late for the concert.
ex.zh: 公車在公路上拋錨，害我們趕不上音樂會。
hl: making us late for the concert

points.t: 分詞的意義上的主詞必須和主要子句的主詞相同。

ex.en: Tim slipped on the wet floor, hurting his back.
ex.zh: 提姆在濕地板上滑倒，傷到了背。

points.t: 主詞與分詞是被動關係，或表示人「感到」的情緒，用過去分詞 p.p.（amazed、bored、scared）。

ex.en: The boy sat alone in the corner, scared by the loud noise.
ex.zh: 那男孩獨自坐在角落，被巨大的聲響嚇到了。

ex.en: Tom sat on the sofa, bored by the long movie.
ex.zh: 湯姆坐在沙發上，被冗長的電影弄得很無聊。

points.t: 分詞前面不用 and，也不重複主詞，否則就變成錯誤的句子。

ex.en: He opened the door, walking into the room.
ex.zh: 他打開門，走進房間。

steps: 先寫出兩個主詞相同的動作，例如：Mary closed the book, and she felt proud.
保留主要動作當主要子句。
刪掉 and 與第二個主詞。
把第二個動詞改成分詞：主動用 V-ing，被動或感受情緒用 p.p.。完成：Mary closed the book, feeling proud of herself.

compare.a: Tim slipped on the floor, hurting his back.
compare.b: Tim slipped on the floor and hurt his back.
compare.note: 兩句意思相近，前者用分詞構句較簡潔，後者用 and 連接。

compare.a: The movie was boring.
compare.b: Tom was bored.
compare.note: -ing 形容「令人覺得…」的事物，-ed 形容「感到…」的人。

mistakes.wrong: He fell, and breaking his leg.
mistakes.right: He fell, breaking his leg.
mistakes.why: 分詞構句不可再與 and 連用。

mistakes.wrong: Tom sat on the sofa, boring by the long movie.
mistakes.right: Tom sat on the sofa, bored by the long movie.
mistakes.why: 湯姆是感到無聊的人，要用 p.p. bored。

mistakes.wrong: Opening the door, the room was dark.
mistakes.right: Opening the door, I found the room dark.
mistakes.why: 分詞的動作要由主要子句的主詞完成，主詞必須相同。

qs.s: The little girl dropped her ice cream, ______ loudly.
qs.ex: 女孩與 cry 是主動關係，且接續發生，用 crying。
qs.hint: girl 與哭的動作是主動關係，又是接續發生的附帶動作，分詞形態選哪一種？

qs.s: Jack stood on the bridge, ______ by the beautiful sunset.
qs.ex: Jack 是被夕陽「驚艷」的人，用 p.p. amazed。
qs.hint: Jack 是被夕陽「驚艷」的人，是主動還是被動（情緒感受）？看 by 帶出的施動者。

qs.s: The bus broke down on the highway, ______ us late for the concert.
qs.ex: 前面整件事造成結果，用 V-ing 表示結果，making us late。
qs.hint: 前面整件事造成後面的結果，要用主動的分詞形態來連接。

qs.s: Mary closed the book, ______ proud of herself.
qs.ex: 主詞相同、動作同時發生，用 V-ing feeling；不可再用 feel 或 felt 與前句連接。
qs.hint: 主詞 Mary 與感覺是主動關係，兩個動作同時發生，用現在分詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He opened the door, and walking into the room.
He opened the door, walking into the room.
He opened the door, walked into the room.
He opened the door, to walk into the room.
qs.ex: 分詞構句直接用 V-ing，不加 and；C 與 D 的動詞形式皆不符。
qs.hint: 分詞構句直接用分詞，不加連接詞；逐項檢查有沒有 and 或其他動詞形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Tom sat on the sofa, boring by the long movie.
Tom sat on the sofa, bore by the long movie.
Tom sat on the sofa, bored by the long movie.
Tom sat on the sofa, being bore by the long movie.
qs.ex: Tom 是感到無聊的人，用 p.p. bored，而不是 boring。
qs.hint: Tom 是「感到」無聊的人，分詞要表示情緒感受，且不能多加 being。

title: 感官動詞＋受詞＋補語
formula: S + see/hear/feel/watch/notice + O + VR/V-ing/p.p.
intro: 「我聽到有人在唱歌」「我看到工人在粉刷」，這種感官動詞後面的補語有三種可能：原形、V-ing、p.p.。看到或聽到的畫面不同，用的形態也不同。學測很愛考你是否誤加 to，以及選對分詞形態。
rhyme: 看到聽到完整用原形，進行中用 V-ing，被動用 p.p.，to 不要加！

points.t: 感官動詞（see、hear、watch、feel、notice）後面可接「受詞 + 補語」，描述感受到的畫面或聲音。

ex.en: I heard my neighbor sing in the hallway this morning.
ex.zh: 我今天早上聽到鄰居在走廊上唱歌。

points.t: 補語用原形動詞：強調看到或聽到動作的「完整過程」，從頭到尾。

ex.en: We watched the plane take off from the runway.
ex.zh: 我們看著飛機從跑道起飛。

points.t: 補語用 V-ing：強調動作「正在進行」，只感受到其中一部分。

ex.en: We watched the workers painting the school gate.
ex.zh: 我們看著工人們正在粉刷學校大門。

ex.en: Mia felt her phone vibrating in her pocket.
ex.zh: 米亞感覺到口袋裡的手機在震動。

points.t: 補語用 p.p.：受詞是動作的承受者，兩者是被動關係。

ex.en: Tom heard his name called from the back of the room.
ex.zh: 湯姆聽到教室後面有人叫他的名字。

ex.en: Jack felt his shoulder touched by someone in the crowd.
ex.zh: 傑克感覺到肩膀被人群中的某人碰了一下。

points.t: 主動語態中，感官動詞後面的原形動詞不加 to；但變成被動語態時 to 要補回來。

ex.en: The guard was seen to enter the room by two students.
ex.zh: 兩個學生看到警衛走進了那個房間。

steps: 選出感官動詞（see、hear、watch、feel、notice），並依時態變化。
接上感受到的對象當受詞，例如 her mother。
判斷補語：看完整過程用原形；強調進行中用 V-ing；受詞是被動承受者用 p.p.。
其餘內容接在後面。完成：Lisa heard her mother calling her from the kitchen.

compare.a: I saw him cross the street.
compare.b: I saw him crossing the street.
compare.note: 前者看到整個過程，後者只看到過馬路的一部分，正在進行。

compare.a: I heard someone call my name.
compare.b: I heard my name called.
compare.note: 受詞是做動作的人用原形；受詞是被叫的名字用 p.p.。

mistakes.wrong: I saw him to enter the room.
mistakes.right: I saw him enter the room.
mistakes.why: 主動語態的感官動詞後面不加 to。

mistakes.wrong: I heard my name calling by someone in the hall.
mistakes.right: I heard my name called by someone in the hall.
mistakes.why: 名字是被叫的，要用過去分詞。

mistakes.wrong: Tom heard his name to call from the back of the room.
mistakes.right: Tom heard his name called from the back of the room.
mistakes.why: 感官動詞後不接 to V，且名字與動詞是被動關係。

qs.s: Last night I heard someone ______ outside my window.
qs.ex: hear 後接受詞再接原形動詞，不可加 to；sung 是過去分詞，語意為被唱，不合；sang 是過去式，不能直接放在受詞後。
qs.hint: hear 後面接受詞與動詞，空格表示聽到完整的動作，要用何種形態？注意不加 to。

qs.s: Mia felt her phone ______ in her pocket, so she took it out.
qs.ex: phone 與 vibrate 為主動關係，用 V-ing 或原形；feel 後不可接 to V，也不可用過去式或 be V-ing。
qs.hint: feel 後的手機與震動是主動關係，進行中的感覺，且不能加 to 或 be 動詞。

qs.s: Tom heard his name ______ from the back of the room.
qs.ex: 名字是「被叫」，受詞與動詞為被動關係，應用過去分詞 called。
qs.hint: 名字與「叫」是被動關係，要選過去分詞。

qs.s: We watched the sun ______ slowly behind the mountains.
qs.ex: watch 後接受詞與原形動詞（或 V-ing），不可用 to set、第三人稱單數 sets 或帶 be 動詞的 was setting。
qs.hint: watch 後面接受詞再接動詞，不加 to，也不加 be 動詞或詞尾 s。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Lisa heard her mother calling her from the kitchen.
Lisa heard her mother to call her from the kitchen.
Lisa heard her name call from the kitchen.
Lisa heard her mother called her from the kitchen.
qs.ex: 感官動詞後用 V-ing 或原形動詞。to call 與 called 都不合；her name 與 call 是被動關係，需用 called。
qs.hint: 逐項檢查：her mother 與 call 是主動還是被動？有沒有誤加 to 或用錯過去式？

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I heard my name calling by someone in the hall.
I heard my name called by someone in the hall.
I heard my name to call by someone in the hall.
I heard my name to be call by someone in the hall.
qs.ex: 名字是「被叫」，受詞 my name 與補語是被動關係，用過去分詞 called；感官動詞後不接 to V。
qs.hint: my name 與動詞是被動關係，要用過去分詞；感官動詞後不接 to V。

title: 關係副詞 where／when
formula: …N(,) + where/when + S + V…
intro: 當你想說「我們常打羽毛球的那座公園」「我永遠忘不了的那個夏天」時，要在地點或時間名詞後面補充說明，就會用到關係副詞 where 與 when。學測常考你判斷該用 where、when，還是 which。
rhyme: 地點用 where，時間用 when，後面一定接完整句！

points.t: 先行詞是地點（place、city、café、park）時，用 where 引導形容詞子句。

ex.en: The park where we play badminton is near my home.
ex.zh: 我們打羽毛球的那座公園離我家很近。

points.t: 先行詞是時間（day、year、night、summer）時，用 when。

ex.en: I will never forget the summer when I learned to swim.
ex.zh: 我永遠不會忘記我學會游泳的那個夏天。

points.t: where、when 已含有介系詞的意思，等於「介系詞 + which」，所以後面要接完整的子句（有主詞和動詞）。

ex.en: This is the café where my friends and I often study after school.
ex.zh: 這是我和朋友放學後常去讀書的咖啡館。

ex.en: This is the café in which my friends and I often study.
ex.zh: 這是我和朋友常去讀書的咖啡館。

points.t: 如果子句裡缺主詞或受詞，要用關係代名詞 which 或 that，不用關係副詞。

ex.en: The library where I do my homework closes at nine.
ex.zh: 我寫功課的那間圖書館九點關門。

ex.en: The library which I like closes at nine.
ex.zh: 我喜歡的那間圖書館九點關門。

points.t: where、when 前面加逗號是「非限定用法」，只補充說明先行詞；此時不能改用 that。

ex.en: We visited Kaohsiung, where my aunt runs a small shop.
ex.zh: 我們去了高雄，我阿姨在那裡經營一間小店。

steps: 找出要修飾的名詞（先行詞），例如 the café、the day。
判斷它是地點還是時間。
檢查後面的子句是否完整：完整就用 where（地點）或 when（時間）；缺主詞或受詞則用 which 或 that。
把子句接在名詞後面。完成：Saturday is the day when most students can sleep late.

compare.a: the café where we study
compare.b: the café which we like
compare.note: where 後面的子句完整；which 在子句中當 like 的受詞，所以後面不可再有受詞。

compare.a: the day when I won the contest
compare.b: the place where I won the contest
compare.note: 先行詞是時間用 when，地點用 where。

compare.a: We visited Tainan, where the food is famous.
