compare.b: We visited the city where the food is famous.
compare.note: 有逗號是補充說明，沒有逗號是限定先行詞。

mistakes.wrong: The library when I do my homework closes at nine.
mistakes.right: The library where I do my homework closes at nine.
mistakes.why: library 是地點，要用 where。

mistakes.wrong: I still remember the night where the whole city lost power.
mistakes.right: I still remember the night when the whole city lost power.
mistakes.why: night 是時間，要用 when。

mistakes.wrong: This is the place where I like.
mistakes.right: This is the place where I often study.
mistakes.why: where 後面要接完整子句，不能缺受詞。

qs.s: This is the café ______ my friends and I often study after school.
qs.ex: 先行詞 café 是地點，後面子句完整，所以用關係副詞 where。
qs.hint: 先行詞 café 是什麼類型的名詞？後面子句有主詞也有動詞，屬於完整子句。

qs.s: I will never forget the day ______ I won the speech contest.
qs.ex: 先行詞 day 是時間，後面子句完整，用 when。
qs.hint: 先行詞 day 是時間名詞，後面的子句完整，選對應時間的關係詞。

qs.s: We visited Tainan, ______ the street food is famous all over the country.
qs.ex: Tainan 是地點，前有逗號為非限定用法，需用 where；that 不可用於非限定子句。
qs.hint: Tainan 前面有逗號，補充說明地點；有一個選項不能用在逗號之後。

qs.s: Saturday is the day ______ most students can finally sleep late.
qs.ex: Saturday 是時間，用 when 引導形容詞子句，where 用於地點。
qs.hint: Saturday 屬於時間名詞，子句完整，選對應時間的關係詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The library when I do my homework closes at nine.
The library where I do my homework closes at nine.
The library that I do my homework closes at nine.
The library in where I do my homework closes at nine.
qs.ex: library 是地點，用 where；when 用於時間，that 在此缺少介系詞，in where 則重複使用。
qs.hint: library 是地點名詞，後面子句完整；逐項檢查關係詞是否對應，並注意介系詞有沒有重複。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I still remember the night where the whole city lost power.
I still remember the night which the whole city lost power.
I still remember the night what the whole city lost power.
I still remember the night when the whole city lost power.
qs.ex: night 是時間，且後面子句完整，只能用 when；where 用於地點，which 後缺少成分，what 不能修飾先行詞。
qs.hint: night 是時間名詞，後面子句完整；逐項檢查關係詞是否對應時間，哪些會造成缺成分。

title: 過去完成式
formula: had + p.p.
intro: 「我到車站的時候，火車已經開走了」，火車開走比我到車站更早發生，這種「過去的過去」就要用過去完成式。寫作、閱讀測驗中常用它交代事情發生的先後，學測也會考時態搭配。
rhyme: 過去的過去，had + p.p.；先發生用 had，後發生用過去式！

points.t: 過去完成式表示「在過去某個時間點之前，就已經發生或完成」的動作，比過去式更早。

ex.en: When Ella reached the gym, the class had already begun.
ex.zh: 艾拉到體育館時，課已經開始了。

points.t: 常和過去式一起使用：先發生的用 had + p.p.，後發生的用過去式。間接引述時也常見。

ex.en: He told me that he had lost his keys on the bus.
ex.zh: 他告訴我他的鑰匙掉在公車上了。

points.t: 常見的連接詞或片語有 before、after、by the time、when、until。

ex.en: I had never ridden a horse before I visited the farm.
ex.zh: 在參觀農場之前，我從沒騎過馬。

ex.en: By the time we got home, the soup had become cold.
ex.zh: 等我們回到家，湯已經變冷了。

points.t: 否定是 had not (hadn't) + p.p.，疑問句把 Had 放到句首。

ex.en: She hadn't finished her homework when her friend called.
ex.zh: 她朋友打來時，她還沒寫完功課。

ex.en: Had you ever seen snow before you went to Japan?
ex.zh: 你去日本之前看過雪嗎？

points.t: 如果只是依序敘述事情，不需要特別強調先後，用過去式就可以。

ex.en: She finished her homework and then went to bed.
ex.zh: 她寫完功課後就去睡覺了。

steps: 先找出過去的基準時間點，例如 I arrived、he called。
判斷哪個動作比基準點更早發生。
更早的動作用 had + p.p.，基準點的動作用過去式。
用 before、after、by the time 等連接。完成：After the students had left the classroom, the teacher locked the door.

compare.a: I had finished my homework before Mom came home.
compare.b: I have finished my homework.
compare.note: 過去完成式的基準點在過去，現在完成式的基準點在現在。

compare.a: When I arrived, the bus had left.
compare.b: When I arrived, the bus left.
compare.note: 前者是我到之前車子就已經走了；後者是我到了以後車子才開走。

mistakes.wrong: I had finish my homework before dinner.
mistakes.right: I had finished my homework before dinner.
mistakes.why: had 後面一定要接過去分詞。

mistakes.wrong: By the time I got to the cinema, the movie has started.
mistakes.right: By the time I got to the cinema, the movie had started.
mistakes.why: by the time 搭配過去式，另一句要用 had + p.p.。

mistakes.wrong: I had saw him before the party.
mistakes.right: I had seen him before the party.
mistakes.why: saw 是過去式，had 後要用過去分詞 seen。

qs.s: When we arrived at the station, the train ______ already left.
qs.ex: 到站是過去時間，火車在那之前就已離開，所以用過去完成式 had left。
qs.hint: 到站是過去，火車離開更早發生；助動詞要表示過去的過去，不是現在完成。

qs.s: Lena realized she ______ her wallet at home only after she reached the store.
qs.ex: 發現是過去，忘記帶是更早發生，用 had left；has left 是現在完成式，不合過去情境。
qs.hint: 忘記帶錢包發生在「發現」之前；選出表示過去的過去的完成式形態。

qs.s: I ______ never seen snow until I traveled to Japan last winter.
qs.ex: until 所指的過去時間點之前的經驗，用 had never seen。
qs.hint: until 之前的經驗發生在過去某時間點以前，空格缺少表示過去完成的助動詞。

qs.s: After the students ______ the classroom, the teacher locked the door.
qs.ex: 鎖門是過去的動作，學生離開在此之前，用 had left。
qs.hint: 鎖門是過去的動作，離開發生在鎖門之前；注意 after 後面的時態。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She had finished her homework before her mother came home.
She has finished her homework before her mother came home.
She had finishing her homework before her mother came home.
She had finish her homework before her mother came home.
qs.ex: had 後須接過去分詞 finished；has finished 為現在完成式，與 came home 的過去時間不合。
qs.hint: 逐項檢查助動詞與過去分詞：finished 的前面該用哪個助動詞？時間有沒有搭配？

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: By the time I got to the cinema, the movie has started.
By the time I got to the cinema, the movie have started.
By the time I got to the cinema, the movie had started.
By the time I got to the cinema, the movie will start.
qs.ex: by the time 搭配過去式時，另一子句用過去完成式 had started；has、have 或 will 都和過去時態不合。
qs.hint: by the time 搭配過去式時，另一個子句要用什麼完成式？檢查助動詞。

title: 分詞片語修飾名詞
formula: N(,) + V-ing/p.p. …
intro: 介紹人事物時，常想在名詞後面補一句說明，例如「坐在窗邊的女孩」「媽媽做的蛋糕」。不必用 who、which，直接在名詞後面放分詞片語就可以，句子更簡潔。學測常考主動用 V-ing、被動用 p.p.。
rhyme: 名詞後面接分詞，主動用 V-ing，被動用 p.p.！

points.t: 分詞片語放在名詞後面，相當於省略關係代名詞 + be 的形容詞子句。

ex.en: The girl sitting by the window is my cousin.
ex.zh: 坐在窗邊的女孩是我的表姊。

ex.en: The girl who is sitting by the window is my cousin.
ex.zh: 坐在窗邊的女孩是我的表姊。

points.t: 名詞與動作是主動關係，用現在分詞 V-ing。

ex.en: The boy reading under the tree is my classmate.
ex.zh: 在樹下看書的男孩是我的同學。

ex.en: The man wearing a red cap is waiting at the gate.
ex.zh: 戴著紅色帽子的男人正在門口等待。

points.t: 名詞與動作是被動關係，用過去分詞 p.p.。

ex.en: The cake made by my sister was delicious.
ex.zh: 我姐姐做的蛋糕很好吃。

ex.en: The window broken by the strong wind has been fixed.
ex.zh: 被強風吹壞的窗戶已經修好了。

points.t: 分詞片語前後加逗號，是補充說明（非限定用法），常見於人名或特定事物之後。

ex.en: Ms. Wang, standing near the door, smiled at us.
ex.zh: 王老師站在門邊對我們微笑。

points.t: 分詞片語本身當形容詞使用，不能在名詞後面再放一個有人稱變化的動詞。

ex.en: The photos taken during our trip are on my laptop.
ex.zh: 我們旅行時拍的照片都在我的筆電裡。

steps: 找出要修飾的名詞，例如 the cookies。
判斷名詞和動作是主動還是被動關係。
主動用 V-ing，被動用 p.p.，後面加上相關資訊。
把分詞片語放在名詞後面。完成：The cookies baked by my grandmother taste wonderful.

compare.a: The man wearing a cap is my uncle.
compare.b: The man who wears a cap is my uncle.
compare.note: 兩句意思相同，前者省略了關係代名詞，更為簡潔。

compare.a: the girl sitting by the window
compare.b: the window broken by the wind
compare.note: girl 與 sit 是主動關係用 V-ing；window 與 break 是被動關係用 p.p.。

compare.a: Ms. Wang, standing near the door, smiled.
compare.b: The woman standing near the door smiled.
compare.note: 有逗號是補充說明；沒有逗號是限定說明是哪一位。

mistakes.wrong: The man wore a cap is my uncle.
mistakes.right: The man wearing a cap is my uncle.
mistakes.why: 句中已有 is，名詞後的修飾部分要用分詞，不能再放過去式動詞。

mistakes.wrong: The photos taking during our trip are on my laptop.
mistakes.right: The photos taken during our trip are on my laptop.
mistakes.why: 照片是被拍的，要用過去分詞。

mistakes.wrong: The cookies baking by my grandmother taste wonderful.
mistakes.right: The cookies baked by my grandmother taste wonderful.
mistakes.why: 餅乾是被烤的，被動關係要用過去分詞。

qs.s: The girl ______ by the window is my cousin.
qs.ex: girl 與 sit 是主動關係，用現在分詞 sitting 修飾名詞，不可直接用原形或過去式。
qs.hint: girl 與坐的動作是主動關係，又不能直接放動詞原形，要選現在分詞還是過去分詞？

qs.s: The cookies ______ by my grandmother taste wonderful.
qs.ex: cookies 是被烤的，被動關係，用過去分詞 baked。
qs.hint: 餅乾是被烤出來的，名詞與動作是被動關係。

qs.s: Mr. Lin, ______ English at our school, will retire next month.
qs.ex: Mr. Lin 是教書的人，主動關係，用 teaching；teaches 會使句子出現兩個動詞而缺連接詞。
qs.hint: Mr. Lin 與教書是主動關係；句中已有 will retire，空格不能再放有人稱變化的動詞。

qs.s: The window ______ by the strong wind last night has been fixed.
qs.ex: window 是被風吹壞的，被動關係，用過去分詞 broken。
qs.hint: 窗戶是被風吹壞的，被動關係，且選項中有一個是不規則的過去分詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The man wearing a red cap is waiting at the gate.
The man worn a red cap is waiting at the gate.
The man wore a red cap is waiting at the gate.
The man wear a red cap is waiting at the gate.
qs.ex: man 與 wear 是主動關係，用 wearing 修飾；worn、wore、wear 都不能這樣放在名詞後。
qs.hint: man 與穿的動作是主動關係；逐項檢查哪個選項是現在分詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The photos taking during our trip are on my laptop.
The photos take during our trip are on my laptop.
The photos taken during our trip are on my laptop.
The photos took during our trip are on my laptop.
qs.ex: 照片是被拍的，用過去分詞 taken；taking、take、took 都不合。
qs.hint: 照片是被拍的，被動關係；逐項檢查哪個選項是過去分詞。

title: 強調句型 All／What … is (to) VR
formula: All (that)/What + S + want/need/have to/can/should + do is + (to) VR
intro: 給朋友建議或說明步驟時，常說「你只要確認時間表就好」「我們該做的是先打掃教室」。英文用 All you need to do is ... 或 What we should do is ... 來強調重點。學測常考動詞單複數，以及 is 後面的動詞形態。
rhyme: All / What 子句當主詞，視為單數用 is，後面接 (to) VR！

points.t: All (that) + 主詞 + need/want/have to/can/should + do + is + (to) VR，意思是「所有…要做的就是…」。

ex.en: All you need to do is check the schedule.
ex.zh: 你只需要確認一下時間表。
hl: All you need to do is check

points.t: 也可用 What 引導：What + S + want/need/should + do + is + (to) VR，「…想做的事是…」。

ex.en: What I want to do this weekend is to visit my grandparents.
ex.zh: 我這個週末想做的事是去探望祖父母。
hl: What I want to do this weekend is to visit

points.t: All / What 引導的名詞子句當主詞，視為單數，所以 be 動詞用 is（過去用 was）。

ex.en: All you have to do is press this button.
ex.zh: 你只需要按下這個按鈕。
hl: All you have to do is press

ex.en: What he had to do was apologize to his teammates.
ex.zh: 他必須做的事是向隊友道歉。
hl: What he had to do was apologize

points.t: is / was 後面接 to VR，to 可以省略，但不接 V-ing，也不加 s。

ex.en: What you should do is drink more water every day.
ex.zh: 你應該做的事是每天多喝水。
hl: What you should do is drink more water

points.t: 子句內要用直述句語序（What we should do），不能寫成疑問句語序。

ex.en: What we should do first is to clean the classroom.
ex.zh: 我們首先該做的是打掃教室。
hl: What we should do first is to clean

steps: 先想好要強調的行動，例如「休息一下」。
寫出主詞子句：All you need to do 或 What you should do。
接上單數 be 動詞 is（過去用 was）。
最後接 (to) + 原形動詞。完成：What you should do is take a short rest.

compare.a: What I want to do is (to) sleep.
compare.b: I want to sleep.
compare.note: 前者強調「想做的事」，後者是一般的直述說法。

compare.a: All you need to do is check the schedule.
compare.b: You only need to check the schedule.
compare.note: 兩句意思相近，前者語氣更強調重點。

compare.a: What you need is a rest.
compare.b: What you need to do is (to) rest.
compare.note: 前者 What 子句裡沒有 do，is 後接名詞；後者子句裡有 do，is 後接 (to) VR。

mistakes.wrong: What you should do are to rest.
mistakes.right: What you should do is (to) rest.
mistakes.why: What 子句當主詞視為單數，要用 is。

mistakes.wrong: All you can do is waits for the test results.
mistakes.right: All you can do is wait for the test results.
mistakes.why: is 後面接原形動詞，不加 s。

mistakes.wrong: What should we do first is to clean the classroom.
mistakes.right: What we should do first is to clean the classroom.
mistakes.why: 名詞子句要用直述句語序。

qs.s: All you have to do ______ to press this button.
qs.ex: All you have to do 是單數子句當主詞，動詞用 is。
qs.hint: All 子句當主詞視為單數，選擇現在時態的單數 be 動詞。

qs.s: What I want to do now ______ take a long nap.
qs.ex: What 子句當主詞視為單數，動詞用 is，後面接原形動詞 take。
qs.hint: What 子句視為單數；空格後面接原形動詞，確認空格要填 be 動詞。

qs.s: What you should do is ______ more water every day.
qs.ex: is 後面接 (to) VR，此處省略 to，用原形 drink。
qs.hint: to 在此省略了，空格要填動詞的哪一種形態？

qs.s: ______ you need to do is to check your answers again.
qs.ex: What you need to do 是名詞子句，意思為「你需要做的事」，其他選項不能這樣使用。
qs.hint: 空格引導名詞子句，意思是「…的事」，而 you need to do 後面缺少受詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: All you can do are wait for the test results.
All you can do is wait for the test results.
All you can do wait for the test results.
All you can do is waits for the test results.
qs.ex: 主詞子句為單數，需有 is；is 之後接 (to) VR，不是 are 或第三人稱的 waits。
qs.hint: 主詞子句要視為單數，逐項檢查 be 動詞是否正確，後面的動詞有沒有多加字尾。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: What we should do first are to clean the classroom.
What should we do first is to clean the classroom.
What we should do first is cleaned the classroom.
What we should do first is to clean the classroom.
qs.ex: What 子句保持直述句語序，動詞用 is，後接 to VR；其他選項動詞或語序有誤。
qs.hint: 逐項檢查子句是否為直述句語序、be 動詞是否正確，以及後面的動詞形態。

title: with 的附加狀況
formula: with + O + V-ing/p.p./adj./prep.
intro: 跟朋友描述一個畫面時，常會補一句「他雙手抱胸地坐著」、「她眼睛閉著在聽音樂」，這種「帶著某種狀態」的說法，英文就用 with。這個句型能讓你在一句話裡多塞進一個生動的細節，不必再多寫一個句子。到了高中，它常出現在閱讀裡的場景描寫，也是學測文法選擇題愛考的「主動還是被動」判斷題。
rhyme: with 加受詞，補語看關係：主動 V-ing，被動 p.p.。

points.t: with + 受詞 + 補語，用來補充說明「同時存在的狀態或附帶情況」，中文常翻成「……著」。

ex.en: Ben listened to the teacher with his arms crossed.
ex.zh: 班雙臂交叉聽老師說話。

points.t: 受詞和補語是「主動、正在進行」的關係，補語用 V-ing。例如淚水會自己流下，所以用 rolling。

ex.en: The little girl ran to me with tears rolling down her face.
ex.zh: 小女孩淚水滑落臉龐，跑向我。

points.t: 受詞和補語是「被動、被……」的關係，補語用 p.p.。例如電視是被人打開的，所以用 turned。

ex.en: She fell asleep with the TV turned on.
ex.zh: 她開著電視就睡著了。

ex.en: He sat quietly with his eyes closed.
ex.zh: 他閉著眼睛安靜地坐著。

points.t: 補語也可以是形容詞或介系詞片語，表示受詞本身的狀態或位置，不需要動詞變化。

ex.en: Don't speak with your mouth full of food.
ex.zh: 不要滿嘴食物地說話。
hl: with your mouth full of food

ex.en: He walked in with a book in his hand.
ex.zh: 他手上拿著一本書走進來。
hl: with a book in his hand

points.t: with 結構只是附加說明，不會讓句子多出一個動詞，所以句中仍然只有一個主要動詞。

ex.en: Ken studied with the radio playing softly.
ex.zh: 小肯一邊讀書，收音機一邊輕輕播放著。

steps: 先寫出主要句子，例如 He sat on the bench.（他坐在長椅上）。
想一個同時存在的細節，找出它的「受詞」：他的雙腿（his legs）。
判斷受詞和動作的關係：腿是「被交叉」的，屬於被動，所以用 p.p. crossed；若受詞會自己做動作（如 tears rolling）就用 V-ing；若只是狀態，直接用形容詞或介系詞片語。
組合成 with + 受詞 + 補語，放在句尾：He sat on the bench with his legs crossed.

compare.a: He stood there with his arms folded.
compare.b: He stood there, folding his arms.
compare.note: with 結構的受詞（arms）可以和主詞不同，且表示靜態的狀態；分詞構句的動作者必須是主詞本人。

compare.a: She sat with her eyes closed.
compare.b: She sat with her eyes closing.
compare.note: 眼睛是被閉上的（被動），要用 p.p. closed；closing 會變成「眼睛正在閉上」，語意不同。

mistakes.wrong: The baby slept with the light turning on.
mistakes.right: The baby slept with the light turned on.
mistakes.why: 燈是被打開的，被動關係要用 p.p.，不可用 V-ing。

mistakes.wrong: She talked with her hands to wave.
mistakes.right: She talked with her hands waving.
mistakes.why: with 後的補語不能用 to V，手會自己揮動，用 V-ing。

mistakes.wrong: He ran home with his bag was open.
mistakes.right: He ran home with his bag open.
mistakes.why: with 結構裡不能再放完整動詞 was，補語用形容詞 open 即可。

qs.s: She sat on the sofa with her eyes ______ on the screen.
qs.ex: eyes 是被固定在螢幕上，被動關係，用過去分詞 fixed。
qs.hint: 看 eyes 和 fix 的關係：眼睛是自己固定，還是被固定在螢幕上？被動要選 p.p.。

qs.s: Don't speak with your mouth ______ of food.
qs.ex: with + 受詞 + 形容詞，mouth full of food 表示嘴裡塞滿食物；filled of 並不通。
qs.hint: mouth 後面要補一個形容詞，描述嘴巴的狀態；看後面接的 of food 搭配哪一個字。

qs.s: The baby slept with the light ______ on.
qs.ex: 燈是被打開的，被動關係，用過去分詞 turned。
qs.hint: 燈是自己開的，還是被人打開的？先判斷主被動，再選形式。

qs.s: He stood in the rain with water ______ down his face.
qs.ex: water 與 run 是主動關係，用現在分詞 running。
qs.hint: water 會自己往下流，主動且正在進行，選 V-ing 形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He listened to music with his eyes closed.
He listened to music with his eyes closing.
He listened to music with his eyes close.
He listened to music with his eyes to close.
qs.ex: 眼睛是被閉上的，用 closed；其他補語形式與句意不合。
qs.hint: 先判斷眼睛與閉上的關係是主動還是被動，再檢查補語形式有沒有不合文法的 to V。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The dog ran toward me with its tail wagged.
The dog ran toward me with its tail wagging.
The dog ran toward me with its tail wag.
The dog ran toward me with its tail to wag.
qs.ex: 尾巴會自己搖，主動關係，用 wagging；wagged、wag、to wag 都不正確。
qs.hint: 尾巴會自己搖動，是主動關係；逐一檢查 p.p.、原形、to V 為什麼不適合。

title: keep／leave／find ＋ 受詞 ＋ 補語
formula: S + keep/leave/find + O + V-ing/p.p./adj./prep.
intro: 媽媽說「別讓門開著」、你說「我發現我的腳踏車不見了」，這些句子都在說某個東西「處於某種狀態」。英文用 keep、leave、find 後面接「受詞 + 補語」就能表達。高中會考你補語要用 V-ing、p.p. 還是形容詞，學測文法題和克漏字很常見。
rhyme: keep、leave、find，受詞後面接狀態：主動 V-ing，被動 p.p.，不用 to V。

points.t: keep、leave、find 後面可以接「受詞 + 補語」，表示讓受詞維持某種狀態，或發現受詞處於某種狀態。

ex.en: The noise kept the baby crying all night.
ex.zh: 噪音讓寶寶整晚哭個不停。

points.t: keep + O + V-ing：讓……一直做某事，強調動作持續不斷。

ex.en: Sorry to keep you waiting for so long.
ex.zh: 抱歉讓你等這麼久。

points.t: leave + O + p.p./adj.：讓……保持某種狀態不處理，補語常是形容詞或被動 p.p.。

ex.en: Please leave the window open for some fresh air.
ex.zh: 請讓窗戶開著，透透新鮮空氣。

ex.en: Don't leave your homework unfinished.
ex.zh: 不要讓你的作業沒做完。

points.t: find + O + 補語：發現……是（在）某種情形。補語依主被動選 V-ing 或 p.p.，也可以是形容詞。

ex.en: I found my notebook hidden under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我發現我的筆記本藏在沙發下面。

ex.en: We found the museum crowded with visitors.
ex.zh: 我們發現博物館擠滿了遊客。

points.t: 這三個動詞後面的補語不能用 to V，也不能用原形動詞；要依受詞與補語的主被動關係選 V-ing 或 p.p.。

ex.en: The loud music kept me awake all night.
ex.zh: 大聲的音樂讓我整晚醒著。

steps: 決定要說什麼動作：讓它保持（keep）、放著不管（leave）、還是發現（find）。
寫出「動詞 + 受詞」，例如 found my bike。
判斷受詞和補語的關係：車是「被偷」的，被動，用 p.p. stolen；人「正在做」某事，用 V-ing；單純狀態用形容詞。
完成句子：Lily found her bike stolen when she came out of the library.

compare.a: I found my sister sleeping on the sofa.
compare.b: I found that my sister was sleeping on the sofa.
compare.note: 前者是 find + 受詞 + 補語，較簡潔；後者是 find + that 子句，意思相同但句子較長。

compare.a: The teacher kept us working.
compare.b: The teacher kept working.
compare.note: keep + 受詞 + V-ing 是「讓某人持續做」；keep + V-ing 是「自己持續做」，有沒有受詞差很多。

mistakes.wrong: I found my bag stealing.
mistakes.right: I found my bag stolen.
mistakes.why: 包包是被偷的，被動關係要用 p.p.，不是 V-ing。

mistakes.wrong: The noise kept me to stay awake.
mistakes.right: The noise kept me awake.
mistakes.why: keep 的受詞補語不能用 to V，要用形容詞或 V-ing。

mistakes.wrong: Please leave open the door.
mistakes.right: Please leave the door open.
mistakes.why: 受詞要放在補語前面，語序是 leave + O + 補語。

qs.s: Sorry to keep you ______ so long.
qs.ex: keep + 受詞 + V-ing，表示讓某人一直等著。
qs.hint: keep 的受詞是 you，等待是你主動在做的動作；補語不能用 to V。

qs.s: Please don't leave the door ______ when you go out.
qs.ex: leave + 受詞 + 形容詞，表示讓門保持開著的狀態。
qs.hint: leave 後面補語要描述門的狀態，這裡不是動詞，要用形容詞。

qs.s: I found my sister ______ on the sofa with a book on her face.
qs.ex: find + 受詞 + V-ing，表示發現她正在睡覺，姐姐與睡覺是主動關係。
qs.hint: sister 是主動在睡覺，睡覺這個動作正在進行，補語選進行形式。

qs.s: Lily found her bike ______ when she came out of the library.
qs.ex: 腳踏車是被偷走的，被動關係，用過去分詞 stolen。
qs.hint: 包包是被偷走的，主被動關係是被動，要用 p.p.。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The loud noise kept me to stay awake all night.
The loud noise kept awake me all night.
The loud noise kept me awake all night.
The loud noise kept me stay awake all night.
qs.ex: keep + 受詞 + 形容詞 awake，受詞要放在補語前，且不可加 to 或另接原形動詞。
qs.hint: keep + 受詞 + 補語，補語不能用 to V，也不能用原形；留意受詞要緊跟在動詞後。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: We found the museum crowd with visitors.
We found the museum crowded with visitors.
We found the museum to crowded with visitors.
We found the museum crowds with visitors.
qs.ex: find + 受詞 + p.p./adj.，crowded 表示擠滿人的狀態；其他選項詞性或形式不對。
qs.hint: 找出受詞（museum）和補語的被動關係，並檢查 to 與複數 s 是否多餘。

title: 分詞構句
formula: (Conj.) V-ing/p.p. …, S + V …
intro: 寫文章時，如果兩個動作是同一個人做的，例如「他在等公車，（同時）一直看手機」，不用寫成兩個完整的句子，可以把前半句縮短成 Waiting for the bus, ...。這就是分詞構句，讓文章更精簡流暢。學測閱讀和翻譯都很常見，最常考的陷阱是「動作的人到底是誰」。
rhyme: 同主詞，省連接詞；主動 V-ing，被動 p.p.；否定 not 放前面。

points.t: 兩個子句的主詞相同時，可把從屬子句簡化成分詞片語，放在主要子句前面。

ex.en: Hearing the bell, the students ran to the classroom.
ex.zh: 聽到鐘聲，學生們跑向教室。

points.t: 做法是省略連接詞與主詞，主動語態用 V-ing（主詞做動作），被動語態用 p.p.（主詞被……）。

ex.en: Surprised by the news, Jenny dropped her pen.
ex.zh: 聽到消息很驚訝，珍妮掉了筆。

ex.en: Born in a small village, Tom had never seen a skyscraper.
ex.zh: 生於小村莊的湯姆從沒看過摩天大樓。

points.t: 否定的分詞構句，把 not 直接放在分詞前面。

ex.en: Not wanting to wake the baby, she walked quietly.
ex.zh: 她不想吵醒寶寶，所以安靜地走路。
hl: Not wanting to wake the baby

points.t: 分詞的動作者必須和主要子句的主詞相同，否則會形成錯誤的「懸垂分詞」。

ex.en: Walking home, I heard my phone ring.
ex.zh: 走路回家時，我聽到手機響了。

points.t: 為了讓語意更清楚，可保留連接詞，例如 After、While、When。

ex.en: While waiting for the bus, Ken kept looking at his phone.
ex.zh: 等公車的時候，小肯一直看手機。

steps: 先確認兩個子句的主詞相同，例如 Ken waited for the bus, and Ken kept looking at his phone。
把從屬子句的連接詞和主詞去掉：waited for the bus。
判斷主被動：主詞自己做動作用 V-ing（Waiting），被動用 p.p.；否定時在前面加 not。
把分詞片語放在句首，加逗號，再接主要子句：Waiting for the bus, Ken kept looking at his phone.

compare.a: Walking home, I heard my phone ring.
compare.b: Walking home, my phone rang.
compare.note: 前者動作者是 I，合理；後者變成「手機在走路」，是懸垂分詞，錯誤。

compare.a: Surprised by the news, Jenny dropped her pen.
compare.b: Surprising by the news, Jenny dropped her pen.
compare.note: Jenny 是被消息嚇到，要用被動 p.p.；surprising 是「令人驚訝的」，主詞是 Jenny 時不適用。

mistakes.wrong: Not wanted to be late, she ran to the bus stop.
mistakes.right: Not wanting to be late, she ran to the bus stop.
mistakes.why: she 是主動想要，用 V-ing 的 wanting，不是 p.p.。

mistakes.wrong: Walking home, my phone rang loudly.
mistakes.right: Walking home, I heard my phone ring.
mistakes.why: 分詞的動作者必須是主要子句的主詞，手機不會走路。

mistakes.wrong: Knowing not what to say, Mia stayed silent.
mistakes.right: Not knowing what to say, Mia stayed silent.
mistakes.why: 否定的 not 要放在分詞前面，而不是後面。

qs.s: ______ for the bus, Ken kept looking at his phone.
qs.ex: Ken 是等車的人，主動關係，用 Waiting；其他形式不能作分詞構句。
qs.hint: Ken 是主動在等公車，分詞構句的主詞做動作，用 V-ing。

qs.s: ______ by the loud noise, the baby began to cry.
qs.ex: 寶寶是被嚇到，被動關係，用過去分詞 Frightened。
qs.hint: 嬰兒是被聲音嚇到，被動關係，要用 p.p.。

qs.s: ______ what to say, Mia stayed silent.
qs.ex: 分詞構句的否定把 not 放在分詞前，且 Mia 是主動關係，用 Not knowing。
qs.hint: 否定的分詞構句，not 要放在分詞前面。

qs.s: ______ in a small village, Tom had never seen a skyscraper.
qs.ex: Tom 是被生下來的，被動關係，用過去分詞 Born。
qs.hint: 湯姆是「被生」在小村莊，被動；此動詞的 p.p. 為不規則變化，留意。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Walking home, I met my English teacher.
Walked home, I met my English teacher.
Walk home, I met my English teacher.
Walking home, my phone rang loudly.
qs.ex: 主詞 I 與 walking 是主動關係；其他選項的分詞形式錯誤，或主詞不是走路的人。
qs.hint: 先判斷分詞動作者是誰，與主要子句的主詞要一致，再逐一檢查其他選項的形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Not wanted to be late, she ran to the bus stop.
Not wanting to be late, she ran to the bus stop.
Not want to be late, she ran to the bus stop.
Don't wanting to be late, she ran to the bus stop.
qs.ex: 分詞構句的否定是 Not + V-ing；其他選項動詞形式不合文法。
qs.hint: 否定要用 not 放在分詞前；wanting 的主動關係；檢查其他選項有沒有錯誤的 don't 或原形。

title: It is said that 句型
formula: It is said/believed/reported/… that + S + V …
intro: 新聞常寫「據說這家店的蛋糕超好吃」、「據報導新圖書館五月啟用」。這種不指明是誰說的、帶點客觀口吻的說法，英文就用 It is said that ...。高中的閱讀測驗和翻譯、克漏字裡經常出現，要認得它是被動語態，也要知道 it 只是虛主詞。
rhyme: It is + p.p. + that，據說據報就用它：說的人不重要。

points.t: 用虛主詞 it 開頭，表示「據說、據信、據報導……」，描述的是大家的看法或客觀資訊。

ex.en: It is said that laughing is good for your health.
ex.zh: 據說笑對健康有益。

points.t: that 子句才是真正的內容，通常放在句尾，it 只是形式上的主詞，本身沒有意義。

ex.en: It is believed that carrots are good for your eyes.
ex.zh: 據信胡蘿蔔對眼睛有益。

points.t: 常見動詞有 say、believe、report、think、expect、show 等，必須用被動語態 be + p.p.。

ex.en: It is reported that the new library will open in May.
ex.zh: 據報導新圖書館將於五月啟用。

points.t: 也可用完成式 has been p.p.，表示「研究已經顯示／證實」等有結果的事。

ex.en: It has been shown that sleep helps us remember things.
ex.zh: 研究顯示睡眠有助於我們記住事情。

points.t: 這個句型常出現在新聞和說明文，語氣較客觀、正式，不指明是誰說的。

ex.en: It is expected that the weather will be sunny tomorrow.
ex.zh: 預期明天會是晴天。

steps: 先想好你要說的內容，寫成一個完整句子：Cats can sense danger.
選一個表示「說、認為、報導」的動詞，改成被動：is believed。
最前面放 It，句子變成 It is believed。
最後接 that 加上第一步的句子：It is believed that cats can sense danger.

compare.a: It is said that tea is healthy.
compare.b: Tea is said to be healthy.
compare.note: 兩句意思相同；前者保留 that 子句，後者把主詞移到句首，改用 to V。

compare.a: It is believed that cats can sense danger.
compare.b: They believe that cats can sense danger.
compare.note: 前者是被動、不指明是誰認為；後者主動，是特定的「他們」在相信。

mistakes.wrong: It says that tea is healthy.
mistakes.right: It is said that tea is healthy.
mistakes.why: it 並不能「說話」，要用被動語態 is said。

mistakes.wrong: It is believed cats that can sense danger.
mistakes.right: It is believed that cats can sense danger.
mistakes.why: that 要緊接在 believed 後面，引導整個子句。

mistakes.wrong: There is reported that the festival attracted many visitors.
mistakes.right: It is reported that the festival attracted many visitors.
mistakes.why: 這個句型的虛主詞必須用 it，不能用 there。

qs.s: It ______ that sleeping eight hours helps students learn better.
qs.ex: it 是虛主詞，說法是「被說」，用被動 is said。
qs.hint: 這是「據說」的意思，說的人不重要，動詞要用被動語態。

qs.s: It is ______ that the new bridge will open next spring.
qs.ex: is 後面接過去分詞，用被動語態 reported。
qs.hint: 空格接在 is 後面，是被動語態，要用過去分詞。

qs.s: ______ is believed that carrots are good for your eyes.
qs.ex: 虛主詞用 It，後接 that 子句，其他選項不能這樣使用。
qs.hint: 句首要放虛主詞，不能用指示代名詞或 there。

qs.s: It has been ______ that regular exercise improves memory.
qs.ex: has been 後面接過去分詞，用被動語態 shown。
qs.hint: has been 後面要接過去分詞，注意不規則變化。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It is believed that cats can sense danger.
It believes that cats can sense danger.
It is believed cats that can sense danger.
There is believed that cats can sense danger.
qs.ex: 句型為 It is believed that + 子句；其他選項誤用主動語態、語序或 There。
qs.hint: 被動語態、虛主詞、that 的位置都要檢查；其他選項各有一個錯誤。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It reports that the festival attracted ten thousand visitors.
It is reported that the festival attracted ten thousand visitors.
It is reported the festival that attracted ten thousand visitors.
It is reporting that the festival attracted ten thousand visitors.
qs.ex: 虛主詞 It 搭配被動 is reported，再接 that 子句；其他選項主被動或語序有誤。
qs.hint: 注意動詞必須是被動，且 that 要緊接動詞後；檢查其他選項錯在動詞形式或詞序。

title: 虛受詞 it（find/consider it + 形容詞 + to V）
formula: S + find/consider/think/make + it + adj. + to V / that 子句
intro: 想說「我覺得早起很難」，如果直接寫成 I find to get up early hard，句子會頭重腳輕。英文會先放一個形式上的 it，把真正的內容（to get up early）移到句尾。這就是虛受詞 it，是高中閱讀、翻譯與寫作常見的句型，學測也常考你有沒有漏掉 it。
rhyme: find 後面先放 it，to V 或 that 子句往後移。

points.t: 受詞是很長的不定詞片語或子句時，先用 it 放在動詞後面當形式受詞，真正的內容移到句尾。

ex.en: Most students find it hard to wake up early on Monday mornings.
ex.zh: 多數學生覺得星期一早上很難早起。
hl: find it hard to wake up

points.t: 常見動詞有 find、consider、think、make、feel，後面接形容詞當受詞補語。

ex.en: I consider it important that everyone keeps the classroom clean.
ex.zh: 我認為每個人都保持教室整潔很重要。

points.t: 受詞補語若是名詞，句型為 make/consider it + a + 名詞 + to V。

ex.en: The coach made it a rule to run two kilometers before practice.
ex.zh: 教練規定練習前要先跑兩公里。
hl: made it a rule to run

points.t: it 只是形式上的受詞，沒有實際意義，真正的受詞是句尾的 to V 或 that 子句，所以不能省略 it。

ex.en: Jim finds it a pleasure to help the elderly in his community.
ex.zh: 吉姆覺得幫助社區裡的老人是一種樂趣。
hl: finds it a pleasure to help

steps: 先寫出想表達的內容：to meet people from other countries（認識外國人）。
選動詞與形容詞：find + exciting（覺得很刺激）。
在動詞後面放形式受詞 it，把補語接在後面：find it exciting。
最後接真正的受詞 to V 或 that 子句，完成句子：I find it exciting to meet people from other countries.

compare.a: I find it hard to learn math.
compare.b: To learn math is hard for me.
compare.note: 前者用虛受詞 it，句子平衡自然；後者主詞太長，英文較少這樣說。

compare.a: I think it necessary that we review every day.
compare.b: I think that it is necessary that we review every day.
compare.note: 前者省略 that it is，更簡潔；後者完整但較長，意思相同。

mistakes.wrong: I find hard to learn math.
mistakes.right: I find it hard to learn math.
mistakes.why: find 的受詞不能省略，必須補上虛受詞 it。

mistakes.wrong: The rule makes that impossible for students to enter.
mistakes.right: The rule makes it impossible for students to enter.
mistakes.why: 虛受詞要用 it，不能用 that。

mistakes.wrong: She finds it exciting meeting new friends to.
mistakes.right: She finds it exciting to meet new friends.
mistakes.why: 真正的受詞用 to V，且要放在句尾，不能把 to 放在最後。

qs.s: My brother finds ______ difficult to get up before seven o'clock.
qs.ex: 動詞 find 後面要用虛受詞 it，真正的受詞是後面的 to get up。其他選項不能充當形式受詞。
qs.hint: find 後面的受詞太長，要先放一個形式上的受詞，不是 him 或 that。

qs.s: The teacher thinks ______ necessary for us to review the lesson every day.
qs.ex: think + it + adj. + for sb to V，it 是虛受詞，故選 it。
qs.hint: think 後面有補語 necessary，受詞太長時需要形式受詞。

qs.s: Jim finds it a pleasure ______ the elderly in his community.
qs.ex: 真正的受詞是句尾的不定詞片語，用 to + 原形動詞，所以選 to help。
qs.hint: pleasure 是名詞補語，後面接真正的受詞，要用不定詞。

qs.s: The new rule makes ______ impossible for students to enter the building after nine.
qs.ex: make + it + adj. + (for sb) to V，用 it 作虛受詞。
qs.hint: make 後面要放形式受詞，句尾的 to V 才是真正的內容。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I find exciting to meet people from other countries.
I find it exciting to meet people from other countries.
I find it exciting meeting to people from other countries.
I find that exciting to meet people from other countries.
qs.ex: find 後面必須有虛受詞 it，其餘選項分別漏掉 it、語序錯誤或誤用 that。
qs.hint: find 後面一定要有形式受詞，再接形容詞與 to V；檢查其他選項的詞序與 that 的用法。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Our teacher considers a good habit to take notes in class.
Our teacher considers it a good habit taking notes to in class.
Our teacher considers it a good habit to take notes in class.
Our teacher considers it to be a good habit take notes in class.
qs.ex: consider it + 名詞 + to V 是正確結構，其餘選項漏掉 it 或 to V 的形式有誤。
qs.hint: consider 後面要放形式受詞再加名詞補語，真正受詞用 to V 放句尾；留意其他選項的 to 位置和 be 的多餘。

title: not...until...（直到...才...）
formula: S + (助動詞) + not + V + until + 時間／子句
intro: 中文說「我到十點才吃飯」，英文不是 I eat until ten，而是「我不到十點不吃飯」，也就是 I don't eat until ten。這個「否定 + until」的說法，是中英文習慣差異最大的地方之一。高中會考 until 子句的時態，也會考 not...until... 與強調句型的轉換。
rhyme: 直到才，not...until：until 後面不用 will。

points.t: not...until... 表示「直到某時才做某事」，主句用否定，until 後面接時間點或子句。

ex.en: The shop does not open until ten o'clock on weekends.
ex.zh: 這家店週末要到十點才開門。

points.t: 中文說「到……才」，英文要用「否定 + until」，因為意思是「在那之前都沒有做」。

ex.en: Lisa didn't realize she had lost her keys until she got home.
ex.zh: 莉莎到家才發現鑰匙不見了。

points.t: until 子句表示未來時，用現在式代替未來式，不可使用 will。

ex.en: We won't start dinner until my father comes back.
ex.zh: 我們要等爸爸回來才開始吃晚餐。

points.t: 主句是肯定句時，until 表示動作持續到某時為止，例如 wait until。

ex.en: Please wait here until the bus arrives.
ex.zh: 請在這裡等到公車抵達。

steps: 先想好「什麼時候才做」：我到爸爸回來才吃飯。
把主句改成否定：I won't eat。
接 until，再接時間點或子句：until my father comes back。
檢查 until 子句：未來的事用現在式（comes），不用 will。完成：I won't eat dinner until my father comes back.

compare.a: She didn't leave until noon.
compare.b: She stayed until noon.
compare.note: 前者否定句，表示「中午才離開」；後者肯定句，表示「一直待到中午」。

compare.a: It was not until noon that she left.
compare.b: She didn't leave until noon.
compare.note: 兩句意思相同；前者是強調句型，後者是一般句型。

mistakes.wrong: Don't leave until the rain will stop.
mistakes.right: Don't leave until the rain stops.
mistakes.why: until 子句表示未來，用現在式，不可用 will。

mistakes.wrong: The library opens until nine.
mistakes.right: The library doesn't open until nine.
mistakes.why: 「到……才」要用否定 + until，不是肯定句。

mistakes.wrong: She left not the classroom until everyone finished.
mistakes.right: She did not leave the classroom until everyone finished.
mistakes.why: 否定句要用助動詞 did not 加原形動詞，不能把 not 放在一般動詞後面。

qs.s: The library doesn't close ______ nine o'clock in the evening.
qs.ex: not...until... 表「直到⋯才⋯」：圖書館直到晚上九點才關門；during、for、since 都不能接這個時間點表達此意。
qs.hint: 看語意：圖書館到九點才關門，需要表示「直到」的連接詞。

qs.s: I won't go to sleep until I ______ my homework.
qs.ex: until 子句表示未來時，要用現在式代替未來式，故選 finish。
qs.hint: 未來的事在時間子句中，時態該用哪種？不能出現 will。

qs.s: The children didn't stop playing ______ their mother called them.
qs.ex: 「直到...才停止」用 didn't...until。
qs.hint: 語意是「直到媽媽叫他們，才停止」，需要表示「直到」的連接詞。

qs.s: We ______ leave the park until the rain stopped.
qs.ex: 句意是「直到雨停才離開」，主句需用否定 didn't，與 until 搭配。
qs.hint: 主句要變成否定，時態要與 stopped 一致，選含有否定意味的助動詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She did not leave the classroom until everyone finished the test.
She did not leave the classroom until everyone will finish the test.
She left not the classroom until everyone finished the test.
She did leave the classroom until everyone finished the test.
qs.ex: until 子句不用 will；否定要用 did not；肯定句加 until 語意不符句意。
qs.hint: 主句否定、until 子句用過去式，並檢查 will、位置與助動詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Don't open the gift until your birthday will come.
Don't open the gift until your birthday comes.
Don't open the gift until come your birthday.
Open not the gift until your birthday comes.
qs.ex: until 子句用現在式表未來、語序為主詞加動詞；其餘選項有 will、倒裝或否定位置的錯誤。
qs.hint: 時間子句不可用 will，且要檢查動詞 come 的位置與 not 的位置是否合乎文法。

title: not only...but also...（不但...而且...）
formula: not only A but also B
intro: 想誇一個人時，常常不是只說一個優點，而是「不但很聰明，而且很努力」。英文用 not only...but also... 把兩個優點連在一起。高中很重視「平行結構」：連接的兩個部分詞性、形式要一樣，也會考主詞與動詞的一致和倒裝。
rhyme: not only A but also B：A、B 要對稱，動詞跟 B 走。

points.t: not only A but also B 連接兩個對等的成分，意思是「不但 A 而且 B」，A 與 B 詞性或結構要相同。

ex.en: The park is not only clean but also quiet.
ex.zh: 這座公園不但乾淨而且安靜。
hl: not only clean but also quiet

points.t: 連接兩個主詞時，動詞與靠近的主詞（B）一致。

ex.en: Not only the students but also the teacher was excited about the trip.
ex.zh: 不只學生，連老師也對這次旅行感到興奮。
hl: Not only the students but also the teacher was

points.t: 連接兩個動詞時，not only 放在第一個動詞前面，but also 放在第二個動詞前面。

ex.en: He not only plays the piano but also writes his own songs.
ex.zh: 他不但會彈鋼琴，還自己寫歌。
hl: not only plays the piano but also writes

points.t: not only 放句首時，前半句要倒裝，例如 Not only does she sing, but she also dances.

ex.en: Not only does she play the guitar, but she also sings very well.
ex.zh: 她不但會彈吉他，歌也唱得很好。
hl: Not only does she play the guitar

points.t: also 有時可省略，但 but 不能省略。

ex.en: The restaurant is famous not only for its food but for its friendly staff.
ex.zh: 這家餐廳不但以美食聞名，也以親切的店員聞名。
hl: not only for its food but for its friendly staff

steps: 找出兩件要連接的事，例如：煮菜煮得好、每天打掃。
確認兩邊結構要平行：兩個都用「動詞 + 受詞」。
套入句型：not only A but also B，不要在 only 與 but 之間加多餘字。
完成句子：My sister not only cooks well but also cleans the house every day.

compare.a: She is not only smart but also hardworking.
compare.b: She is not only smart but also works hard.
compare.note: 前者兩邊都是形容詞，結構平行；後者一邊形容詞、一邊動詞，不平行。

compare.a: Not only does she sing, but she also dances.
compare.b: She not only sings but also dances.
compare.note: 兩句意思相同；前者 not only 置首要倒裝，後者不需倒裝。

mistakes.wrong: Not only she plays the guitar, but she also sings.
mistakes.right: Not only does she play the guitar, but she also sings.
mistakes.why: not only 置於句首時，前半句要倒裝。

mistakes.wrong: This book is not only interesting and also useful.
mistakes.right: This book is not only interesting but also useful.
mistakes.why: not only 必須和 but also 搭配，不能用 and also。

mistakes.wrong: Not only the players but also the coach were happy.
mistakes.right: Not only the players but also the coach was happy.
mistakes.why: 動詞要與靠近的主詞（the coach）一致，用單數 was。

qs.s: Tom is not only good at math ______ good at music.
qs.ex: 固定搭配是 not only...but also...。
qs.hint: not only 要和哪個詞組搭配才能構成固定句型？

qs.s: Not only the players but also the coach ______ happy about the result.
qs.ex: 動詞與靠近的主詞 the coach 一致，過去式單數用 was。
qs.hint: 連接兩個主詞時，動詞跟距離較近的主詞一致，注意單複數。

qs.s: The restaurant is famous not only for its food ______ for its friendly staff.
qs.ex: not only A but also B 為固定搭配，其餘選項無法連接兩個對等成分。
qs.hint: not only for 的後面，要接和它搭配的連接詞組，其他組合都不是固定用法。

qs.s: Not only ______ the guitar, but she also sings very well.
qs.ex: not only 置於句首時，前半句要倒裝，用 does she play。
qs.hint: not only 放句首，前半句需要倒裝，注意助動詞的位置。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: My sister not only cooks well but also cleans the house every day.
My sister not only cooks well but also clean the house every day.
My sister not only cooks well but also cleaning the house every day.
My sister not only is cooks well but also cleans the house every day.
qs.ex: 兩個動詞都要用相同的第三人稱單數形，並保持結構平行；其他選項有動詞形式錯誤。
qs.hint: 兩邊的結構要平行；檢查其他選項有沒有多餘的 is 或錯誤的 V-ing。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: This book is not only interesting and also useful for learning English.
This book is not only interesting but also usefully for learning English.
This book is not only interesting but also useful for learning English.
This book is interesting not only but also useful for learning English.
qs.ex: not only 要直接放在對等成分前，並與 but also 搭配，且詞性要平行；其他選項把 but 誤寫成 and，或把形容詞寫成副詞，或把 not only 放錯位置。
qs.hint: but also 後面的詞性要與前面一致（都是形容詞）；but 與 only 的位置不能顛倒。

title: 被動不定詞表「據說／被認為」（be said/believed to V）
formula: S + be said/thought/believed/known to + V（to have p.p.）
intro: 「據說他中了大獎」、「這座古廟據信有五百年歷史」。除了 It is said that ...，英文還有更簡潔的說法：把主角移到句首，寫成 He is said to ...。高中閱讀常常用這種句型介紹傳說或研究結果，學測也愛考 to V 還是 to have p.p.。
rhyme: 主詞 be said to V；發生更早，to have p.p.。

points.t: It is said that + S + V，可改成 S + be said + to V，把子句主詞移到句首，更簡潔。

ex.en: Dolphins are known to be very smart animals.
ex.zh: 眾所周知海豚是很聰明的動物。

points.t: 常見動詞有 say、think、believe、know、report、consider，都用被動語態。

ex.en: The old temple is believed to be over five hundred years old.
ex.zh: 這座古廟據信有五百多年歷史。

points.t: 不定詞表示與主要動詞同一時間或之後，用 to V。

ex.en: This kind of tea is thought to help people stay healthy.
ex.zh: 這種茶被認為有助於保持健康。

points.t: 若不定詞的動作比主要動詞更早發生，用 to have + p.p.。

ex.en: The singer is said to have lost her phone on the train.
ex.zh: 據說那位歌手把手機掉在火車上。

points.t: 不定詞本身若是被動，要用 to have been + p.p.，例如建築物是被建造的。

ex.en: The village is believed to have been founded in the 1800s.
ex.zh: 這個村莊據信創立於一八○○年代。

steps: 先寫出 It is said that 的版本：It is said that the singer lost her phone。
把 that 子句的主詞移到句首：The singer is said。
判斷動作時間：lost 比 is said 更早，用 to have + p.p.；同時或之後用 to V。
完成：The singer is said to have lost her phone on the train.

compare.a: He is said to be rich.
compare.b: He is said to have been rich.
compare.note: 前者表示現在據說他有錢；後者表示據說他過去有錢，時間更早。

compare.a: He is said to be the best player on the team.
compare.b: He is said to have won the prize last year.
compare.note: to V 表示和「據說」同時的狀態；to have p.p. 表示比「據說」更早發生的事。

mistakes.wrong: He is said to win the prize last year.
mistakes.right: He is said to have won the prize last year.
mistakes.why: last year 是更早的時間，要用完成式不定詞 to have won。

mistakes.wrong: Cats say to be able to see in the dark.
mistakes.right: Cats are said to be able to see in the dark.
mistakes.why: 主詞 cats 是被說的對象，要用被動 are said。

mistakes.wrong: The bridge is believed to build by farmers.
mistakes.right: The bridge is believed to have been built by farmers.
mistakes.why: 橋是被建造的，且動作較早，要用 to have been built。

qs.s: This old bridge is believed ______ by farmers many years ago.
qs.ex: 橋是被建造的，且發生在過去，所以用被動完成式不定詞 to have been built。
qs.hint: 橋是被建造的，且時間在更早以前，既要被動也要完成式。

qs.s: The rock star is said ______ very wealthy.
qs.ex: be said to V 表示「據說」，to 後接原形動詞。
qs.hint: 這是「據說他很有錢」，與主要動詞同時，不定詞用簡單式。

qs.s: This kind of tea is thought ______ people stay healthy.
qs.ex: be thought to V，to 後接原形動詞。
qs.hint: 茶是用來幫助人，與主要動詞同時，不定詞後面要接原形動詞。

qs.s: The boy is reported ______ the lost wallet before the police arrived.
qs.ex: 發現錢包在警察抵達之前，是較早的動作，用 to have found。
qs.hint: 動作發生在警察抵達之前，要用完成式不定詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The village is believed to have been founded in the 1800s.
The village is believed to found in the 1800s.
The village is believed to have found in the 1800s.
The village believes to have been founded in the 1800s.
qs.ex: 村莊是被建立的，且是過去的事，用 to have been founded；其他選項被動或完成式有誤。
qs.hint: 被動與完成式一起用，主詞是村莊，注意不定詞的完成被動形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Cats say to be able to see in the dark.
Cats are said being able to see in the dark.
Cats are said to be able to see in the dark.
Cats are said that be able to see in the dark.
qs.ex: be said to V 後面直接接不定詞，不能加 that 或使用動名詞，主詞 cats 也要用被動。
qs.hint: 主詞是貓，要用被動語態；檢查動詞後面的不定詞形式是否正確。

title: 感官動詞的被動（be seen/heard + V-ing）
formula: S + be + seen/heard/watched/noticed + V-ing（主動：see + O + V/V-ing）
intro: 目擊者描述：「有人看到那個男孩翻越圍牆」、「有人聽到他在房間裡大笑」。看到、聽到的事，焦點是「被看到、被聽到的人」，英文就用感官動詞的被動：S + be seen/heard + V-ing。高中寫作和閱讀常見，學測則考你什麼時候要加 to、什麼時候不用。
rhyme: 主動省 to，被動加回 to；進行 V-ing，不變形。

points.t: 感官動詞 see、hear、watch、notice 等，主動時後面可接「受詞 + 原形動詞或 V-ing」。

ex.en: We saw the boy climb over the school fence.
ex.zh: 我們看到那個男孩翻過學校的圍牆。

points.t: 接 V-ing 表示動作正在進行；接原形表示看見整個動作的過程。

ex.en: I heard her sing in the shower this morning.
ex.zh: 我今早聽到她在淋浴間唱歌。

points.t: 改成被動後，V-ing 保持不變：S + be seen/heard + V-ing。

ex.en: The boy was seen climbing over the school fence.
ex.zh: 有人看到那個男孩正在翻越學校的圍牆。

ex.en: The singer was heard practicing in the music room late at night.
ex.zh: 有人聽到那位歌手深夜在音樂教室練習。

points.t: 主動時省略的 to，被動時要加回來：S + be seen/heard + to V。

ex.en: The little girl was seen to cross the street by herself.
ex.zh: 有人看到那個小女孩自己過馬路。

points.t: 被動語態中 by 後面的行為者常省略，重點放在被看到或聽到的事。

ex.en: A stranger was noticed standing outside the gate for an hour.
ex.zh: 有人注意到一個陌生人在大門外站了一個小時。

steps: 先寫出主動句：Someone saw the boy climbing over the fence。
把受詞（the boy）移到句首當主詞：The boy。
動詞改為 be + p.p.：was seen。
保留後面的 V-ing；若原本是原形，要加上 to：The boy was seen climbing over the fence.

compare.a: The boy was seen climbing over the fence.
compare.b: The boy was seen to climb over the fence.
compare.note: 前者強調動作正在進行；後者強調看到整個動作的過程。

compare.a: We saw him leave the room.
compare.b: He was seen to leave the room.
compare.note: 主動時原形動詞省略 to，被動時要把 to 加回來。

mistakes.wrong: He was seen leave the room.
mistakes.right: He was seen to leave the room.
mistakes.why: 被動語態中，原形動詞前要加回 to。

mistakes.wrong: Some boys were heard sing in the hallway.
mistakes.right: Some boys were heard singing in the hallway.
mistakes.why: 感官動詞改成被動後，後面接 V-ing 或 to V，不能接原形動詞 sing。

mistakes.wrong: The cat was seen sleep on the sofa.
mistakes.right: The cat was seen sleeping on the sofa.
mistakes.why: 被動語態的補語不能用原形，要用 V-ing 或 to V。

qs.s: The thief was seen ______ out of the window.
qs.ex: 感官動詞被動後接 V-ing 表示正在進行，jump 要用 jumping。
qs.hint: 小偷會自己跳出窗外，動作進行中，補語用什麼形式？

qs.s: The young man was heard ______ loudly in the next room.
qs.ex: was heard + V-ing，表示聽到某人正在大笑。
qs.hint: 那位男子在隔壁房間大笑，動作正在進行，補語用什麼形式？

qs.s: The little girl was seen ______ across the street by herself.
qs.ex: 感官動詞被動後若接原形動詞，要加 to，故用 to cross。
qs.hint: 女孩是被看到的對象，被動句中，原有的原形動詞要把某個小詞補回來。

qs.s: The students were noticed ______ notes during the exam.
qs.ex: 被動語態後接 V-ing，表示被發現正在做某事。
qs.hint: 學生們傳紙條，動作進行中；並檢查其他選項的 p.p. 與 to 是否合適。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The cat was seen sleep on the sofa.
The cat was seen sleeping on the sofa.
The cat saw sleeping on the sofa.
The cat was seeing sleeping on the sofa.
qs.ex: 被動語態要用 was seen，其後接 V-ing；其他選項把被動誤寫為主動或進行式，或漏掉 to。
qs.hint: 被動句的結構是 be + p.p.，補語不能直接用原形；注意 saw 與 seeing 是否適合。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Some boys heard singing in the hallway.
Some boys were heard to singing in the hallway.
Some boys were heard singing in the hallway.
Some boys were hearing sing in the hallway.
qs.ex: 正確結構為 be heard + V-ing；其他選項缺少 be 動詞，或 to 後誤接 V-ing，或形式混亂。
qs.hint: 男孩們是被聽到的對象，要用被動，且進行式補語不需要加 to。

title: 強調句型 It is not until...that...
formula: It is/was not until + 時間／子句 + that + S + V
intro: 想強調「直到半夜球迷才離開」，除了 The fans didn't leave until midnight，還有更有力的說法：It was not until midnight that the fans left。這種強調句型常出現在閱讀和翻譯中，也是學測愛考的文法重點。重點是 that 後面不再用否定。
rhyme: It was not until + 時間 + that，後面肯定，不再用 not。

points.t: 此句型用來強調「直到某時才……」，把 not until 的部分放在 it is/was 後面。

ex.en: It was not until midnight that the fans left the stadium.
ex.zh: 直到半夜球迷才離開體育場。
hl: It was not until midnight that

points.t: that 後面接一個完整的子句，動詞用肯定形式，不再使用否定。

ex.en: It was not until last week that I learned how to swim.
ex.zh: 直到上週我才學會游泳。
hl: It was not until last week that

points.t: 時態依事件而定：過去的事用 It was not until...that...；現在的通則用 It is not until...that...。

ex.en: It is not until we lose something that we know its value.
ex.zh: 直到失去某樣東西，我們才知道它的價值。
hl: It is not until we lose something that

points.t: 可由 not...until... 改寫：She didn't leave until noon. → It was not until noon that she left.

ex.en: It was not until the sun set that the farmers went home.
ex.zh: 直到太陽下山，農夫們才回家。
hl: It was not until the sun set that

steps: 先寫出一般句：She didn't leave until noon。
把 not until noon 移到前面，前面加 It was：It was not until noon。
接 that，再接主詞與動詞：that she left。
檢查 that 後面的動詞用肯定式，時態配合：It was not until noon that she left.

compare.a: She didn't leave until noon.
compare.b: It was not until noon that she left.
compare.note: 兩句意思相同；後者用強調句型，語氣更強。

compare.a: It was not until ten that she came.
compare.b: It was not until ten that she didn't come.
compare.note: that 後面不能再用否定；not until 已經包含否定意味。

mistakes.wrong: It was not until ten that she didn't come.
mistakes.right: It was not until ten that she came.
mistakes.why: that 後面的動詞用肯定式，不再重複否定。

mistakes.wrong: It not was until yesterday that I heard the news.
mistakes.right: It was not until yesterday that I heard the news.
mistakes.why: not 要放在 be 動詞後面，語序是 It was not until。

mistakes.wrong: It was not until she opened the box when she saw the gift.
mistakes.right: It was not until she opened the box that she saw the gift.
mistakes.why: 強調句型要用 that 連接，不能用 when。

qs.s: It was not until she opened the box ______ she saw the gift.
qs.ex: 強調句型 It was not until...that...，空格填 that。
qs.hint: 強調句型要用固定的連接詞連接，不是 when 也不是 which。

qs.s: It was not until the sun set ______ the farmers went home.
qs.ex: 結構為 It was not until + 子句 + that + 子句。
qs.hint: 要接在 not until 子句之後，連接整句，不能用 so、and、because。

qs.s: It was not until midnight that the storm ______.
qs.ex: that 後面的子句動詞用肯定式，故選 stopped，不能再加 not。
qs.hint: 後半句動詞用肯定，不能再用 not 或否定助動詞，也不能把 not 放在後面。

qs.s: ______ was not until 1990 that the school built a swimming pool.
qs.ex: 強調句型的開頭為虛主詞 It。
qs.hint: 句首要放虛主詞，與 was not until 構成強調句型。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It was not until yesterday that I heard the news.
It was not until yesterday that I didn't hear the news.
It not was until yesterday that I heard the news.
It was until yesterday not that I heard the news.
qs.ex: 正確語序為 It was not until...that...，其他選項多出否定或語序錯誤。
qs.hint: not 要放在 be 動詞之後；後半句的動詞用肯定式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It not is until we get sick that we value our health.
It is not until we get sick that we value our health.
It is not until we get sick we that value our health.
It is not until we get sick that we won't value our health.
qs.ex: that 要放在時間子句後、主要子句前；其他選項語序或否定使用有誤。
qs.hint: 強調句型的語序是 It is not until；後半句不可再用 won't 之類的否定。

title: 同位語子句（the fact that + S + V）
formula: the fact / news / idea / belief / hope + that + S + V
intro: 你想說「他說謊這件事讓我很生氣」，只寫 the fact 並不知道是什麼事，所以要在後面接一個子句說明內容。新聞、想法、信念、希望也都可以這樣補充。學測常考連接詞要選哪一個，以及 Despite the fact that 的搭配。
rhyme: 抽象名詞接 that，that 後面整句完整，不用 what。

points.t: fact、news、idea、belief、hope、rumor 等抽象名詞後面可接 that 子句，用來說明這個名詞的內容，這種子句叫同位語子句。

ex.en: The fact that she speaks four languages surprised her classmates.
ex.zh: 她會說四種語言的事實讓同學們很驚訝。
hl: The fact that she speaks four languages

ex.en: There is a rumor that our school will build a new gym.
ex.zh: 有傳言說我們學校要蓋一座新體育館。
hl: a rumor that our school will build a new gym

points.t: that 後面是一個完整的句子（有主詞和動詞），that 在子句中不當主詞也不當受詞，只負責連接，所以不能換成 what 或 which。

ex.en: We were happy to hear the news that our school team had won.
ex.zh: 聽到我們學校隊伍贏了的消息，我們很高興。
hl: the news that our school team had won

points.t: 同位語 that 和關係代名詞 that 不同：關係子句會缺主詞或受詞，同位語子句則是完整的句子。

ex.en: The idea that we should recycle more is great.
ex.zh: 我們應該多做回收的想法很棒。
hl: The idea that we should recycle more

ex.en: The idea that he suggested is great.
ex.zh: 他提出的那個想法很棒。

points.t: 常見用法有 Despite the fact that...、The news that...、The belief that...。Despite 後面要接名詞片語，所以要加 the fact that 才能接完整句。

ex.en: Despite the fact that it was raining, we still went hiking.
ex.zh: 儘管在下雨，我們還是去健行了。
hl: Despite the fact that it was raining

ex.en: Many people share the belief that hard work leads to success.
ex.zh: 很多人認同努力工作會帶來成功的信念。
hl: the belief that hard work leads to success

steps: 先選一個抽象名詞：fact、news、idea、belief、hope、rumor 等，放在要說明的位置。
在名詞後面加 that，不要用 what 或 which。
that 後面接一個主詞和動詞都完整的句子，說明這個名詞的內容。
完成例句：I heard the rumor that the test would be easier this time.（我聽說這次考試會比較簡單的傳言。）

compare.a: The fact that he lied upset us.
compare.b: The fact what he lied upset us.
compare.note: fact 後面的同位語子句只能用 that，不能用 what。

compare.a: The idea that we should recycle more is great.
compare.b: The idea that he suggested is great.
compare.note: 前句 that 後面完整（同位語）；後句 suggested 缺受詞，that 是關係代名詞。

compare.a: Despite the fact that it rained, we went out.
compare.b: Although it rained, we went out.
compare.note: 意思相近，但 Despite 後面要接名詞片語，Although 才能直接接子句。

mistakes.wrong: The fact what he lied upset us.
mistakes.right: The fact that he lied upset us.
mistakes.why: 同位語子句要用 that，不能用 what。

mistakes.wrong: Despite it was raining, we went hiking.
mistakes.right: Despite the fact that it was raining, we went hiking.
mistakes.why: Despite 是介系詞，後面不能直接接子句，要加 the fact that。

mistakes.wrong: There is no proof that is the story true.
mistakes.right: There is no proof that the story is true.
mistakes.why: that 後面是陳述句，不要倒裝成疑問句語序。

qs.s: The fact ______ he was late again made the teacher angry.
qs.ex: fact 後面的同位語子句用 that 引導，說明事實內容。
qs.hint: 看空格前的名詞 fact 是抽象名詞，空格後是完整句子，想想這種連接詞的固定選擇。

qs.s: I was glad to hear the news ______ my cousin had passed the exam.
qs.ex: news 後接同位語子句，that 引導完整句子。
qs.hint: news 後面接的是完整句子，用來說明消息的內容；請選只負責連接、不當主詞或受詞的字。

qs.s: Do you agree with the idea ______ students should wear uniforms?
qs.ex: idea 的內容是一個完整句子，用 that 引導同位語子句。
qs.hint: idea 的內容是一個完整的句子，不是疑問；排除表示「是否」「什麼」「何時」的字。

qs.s: ______ the fact that it was raining, we still went hiking.
qs.ex: 後面接名詞片語 the fact that...，需用介系詞 Despite。
qs.hint: 空格後面接的是名詞片語而不是子句，要選介系詞，不是連接詞或副詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The fact that he forgot my birthday made me sad.
The fact what he forgot my birthday made me sad.
The fact he forgot that my birthday made me sad.
The fact that forgot my birthday made me sad.
qs.ex: 同位語 that 子句需完整含主詞與動詞；其他選項用錯連接詞或缺少主詞。
qs.hint: 檢查子句是否完整，主詞、動詞都要有，連接詞也要對，語序不能亂。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: There is no proof what the story is true.
There is no proof that is the story true.
There is no proof that the story is true.
There is no proof the story that is true.
qs.ex: proof 後面接 that + 完整子句；其他選項用錯關係詞、倒裝或 that 位置錯誤。
qs.hint: proof 後面要接完整的陳述子句，注意連接詞和子句內語序有沒有被倒裝或移位。

title: 數量詞 + of + 關係代名詞
formula: 名詞, some/many/most/all/both/one of + whom/which + V
intro: 你想介紹「班上有三十個同學，其中大部分住在學校附近」，一句話裡要補充一部分的人，就可以用「數量詞 + of + whom/which」接在逗號後面。寫作和閱讀常見這種長句，學測會考你 whom 和 which 怎麼選。
rhyme: 逗號後面分一部分，人用 of whom，物用 of which。

points.t: 非限定關係子句可用「數量詞 + of + whom/which」補充說明先行詞中的一部分，前面一定有逗號。

ex.en: Our school has fifty clubs, some of which meet on weekends.
ex.zh: 我們學校有五十個社團，其中一些在週末聚會。

points.t: 先行詞是人用 whom，是物用 which。常見的數量詞有 some、many、most、all、both、neither、one、two 等。

ex.en: She invited ten classmates, most of whom brought small gifts.
ex.zh: 她邀請了十位同學，其中大多數人帶了小禮物。

ex.en: The shop sells twenty kinds of tea, many of which are cheap.
ex.zh: 這家店賣二十種茶，其中很多很便宜。

points.t: 關係代名詞前面有介系詞 of，所以指人要用受格 whom，不能用 who。

ex.en: He has three sisters, two of whom are doctors.
ex.zh: 他有三個姊妹，其中兩位是醫生。

points.t: 關係子句中動詞的單複數由前面的數量詞決定，例如 one of which is，both of whom study。

ex.en: My uncle has two cars, one of which is electric.
ex.zh: 我叔叔有兩輛車，其中一輛是電動車。

ex.en: I have two brothers, both of whom study abroad.
ex.zh: 我有兩個哥哥，他們兩個都在國外讀書。

steps: 先寫主要句子，並在句尾加逗號，例如：She has five cousins,
想一想要補充「其中一部分」：選數量詞（some、most、both、one 等）。
判斷先行詞是人還是物：人用 of whom，物用 of which。
接上動詞，並讓動詞符合數量詞。完成例句：The club has twenty members, most of whom are first-year students.（社團有二十位成員，其中大多數是一年級生。）

compare.a: two of whom are doctors
compare.b: two of who are doctors
compare.note: of 後面要用受格 whom，不能用 who。

compare.a: two of which were about space
compare.b: two of them were about space
compare.note: which 能連接兩個子句；them 只是代名詞，不能連接。

compare.a: many of whom were students
compare.b: many of which were students
compare.note: 先行詞是人用 whom，是物才用 which。

mistakes.wrong: He has three sisters, two of who are doctors.
mistakes.right: He has three sisters, two of whom are doctors.
mistakes.why: 介系詞 of 後面要用受格 whom。

mistakes.wrong: She read five books, two of them were about space.
mistakes.right: She read five books, two of which were about space.
mistakes.why: 兩個子句之間需要關係代名詞，them 不能連接。

mistakes.wrong: The store has many breads, some of whom are sweet.
mistakes.right: The store has many kinds of bread, some of which are sweet.
mistakes.why: 先行詞是物，要用 which，不能用 whom。

qs.s: The class has thirty students, most of ______ live near the school.
qs.ex: 先行詞是人，介系詞 of 後面要用受格關係代名詞 whom。
qs.hint: 先行詞 students 是人，空格在介系詞 of 之後，要用受格形式。

qs.s: The store sells many kinds of bread, some of ______ are made without sugar.
qs.ex: 先行詞是物，用 some of which 引導非限定關係子句，them 無法連接兩個子句。
qs.hint: 先行詞是物（麵包），而且要連接兩個子句，不能用代名詞取代關係代名詞。

qs.s: I have two brothers, both of ______ study abroad.
qs.ex: 先行詞是人，用 both of whom。
qs.hint: both of 之後要接人的受格關係代名詞，先看先行詞是人還是物。

qs.s: The museum has hundreds of paintings, ______ are over a century old.
qs.ex: 先行詞是物，用 many of which；them 無法連接子句，whom 用於人。
qs.hint: 要找出能同時連接兩個子句、又指物的組合，字序是數量詞 + of + 關係代名詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She read five books last month, two of which were about space.
She read five books last month, two of them were about space.
She read five books last month, two of whom were about space.
She read five books last month, two of what were about space.
qs.ex: 指物且需連接兩個子句，用 two of which；其他選項用 them 無連接詞、whom 用於人、what 用法錯誤。
qs.hint: 兩個子句之間需要關係代名詞連接，先行詞是書，指的是物。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The tourists, many of who were students, enjoyed the trip.
The tourists, many of whom were students, enjoyed the trip.
The tourists, many of which were students, enjoyed the trip.
The tourists, many of them were students, enjoyed the trip.
qs.ex: 先行詞是人，of 後面要用 whom；其他選項誤用 who、which 或 them。
qs.hint: 先行詞是人，介系詞 of 後面不能用主格，也不能用指物的關係代名詞。

title: 否定副詞置於句首的倒裝
formula: Never / Seldom / Rarely / Hardly / Little + 助動詞 + S + V
intro: 平常我們說 I have never seen such a beautiful sunset，如果想特別強調「從來沒看過」，可以把 Never 搬到句首。這種寫法出現在演講、新聞和大考閱讀裡，看到它就要知道後面主詞和助動詞要對調。
rhyme: 否定詞放句首，助動詞跑到主詞前。

points.t: never、seldom、rarely、hardly、little 等否定副詞放在句首時，是為了強調，後面的句子要倒裝。

ex.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
ex.zh: 我從未見過這麼美的日落。

points.t: 句中已有 be 動詞或助動詞時，直接把它移到主詞前面。

ex.en: Seldom was the library so quiet during exam week.
ex.zh: 考試週時圖書館很少這麼安靜。

points.t: 一般動詞要借用 do、does、did 放到主詞前，主要動詞改成原形。

ex.en: Rarely does my brother eat breakfast at home.
ex.zh: 我哥哥很少在家吃早餐。

ex.en: Little did she know about the surprise party.
ex.zh: 她完全不知道有驚喜派對。

points.t: 完成式把 have、has、had 移到主詞前，過去分詞留在原位。Hardly had... when... 是常見搭配，表示「一...就...」。

ex.en: Hardly had we arrived when it began to rain.
ex.zh: 我們一到就開始下雨了。

steps: 先寫出一般句子，例如：I have never seen such a polite student.
把 never、seldom、rarely 等否定副詞搬到句首。
找出助動詞或 be 動詞，移到主詞前面；一般動詞則加 do/does/did，動詞改原形。
完成例句：Rarely do we find such a polite student in this school.（我們在這所學校很少遇到這麼有禮貌的學生。）

compare.a: Never have I seen such a big fish.
compare.b: I have never seen such a big fish.
compare.note: 前句否定詞在句首要倒裝，語氣較強；後句是一般語序。

compare.a: Rarely does he go out.
compare.b: Rarely he goes out.
compare.note: 否定副詞在句首時要倒裝，不能維持主詞加動詞。

compare.a: Little did she know the truth.
compare.b: She knew little about the truth.
compare.note: 前句倒裝強調；後句 little 是一般副詞，位置不同、不倒裝。

mistakes.wrong: Rarely does he goes out.
mistakes.right: Rarely does he go out.
mistakes.why: 借用 does 後，主要動詞要用原形。

mistakes.wrong: Never I have seen such a beautiful place.
mistakes.right: Never have I seen such a beautiful place.
mistakes.why: Never 在句首時 have 要移到主詞前。

mistakes.wrong: Seldom he comes to school late.
mistakes.right: Seldom does he come to school late.
mistakes.why: 一般動詞要借用 does 倒裝，並用原形動詞。

qs.s: Never ______ so many people in the night market.
qs.ex: 否定副詞 never 置於句首，後面要倒裝，完成式把 have 放在主詞前。
qs.hint: never 在句首，後面主詞與助動詞要倒裝；完成式要把助動詞移到主詞前。

qs.s: Seldom ______ to school late because he lives nearby.
qs.ex: 一般動詞倒裝需借用 does，動詞用原形 come。
qs.hint: 一般動詞倒裝要借助 do 類助動詞，並注意主詞是第三人稱單數，主要動詞要用什麼形態。

qs.s: Little ______ that the surprise party was for her.
qs.ex: little 置於句首表強調，後面用助動詞倒裝 did she know。
qs.hint: little 在句首表示強調，時態是過去，倒裝後動詞要回到原形。

qs.s: Rarely ______ such a polite student in this school.
qs.ex: rarely 置句首須倒裝，助動詞 do 在主詞前，動詞為原形 find。
qs.hint: rarely 在句首，句子是現在式，主詞是 we，要借助助動詞倒裝再接原形。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Hardly had we arrived when it began to rain.
Hardly we had arrived when it began to rain.
Hardly had arrived we when it began to rain.
Hardly did we arrived when it began to rain.
qs.ex: hardly 置句首須倒裝，過去完成式把 had 放在主詞前；其他選項語序或動詞形式錯誤。
qs.hint: hardly 開頭的句子，完成式的助動詞要放在主詞前面。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Never my parents did argue in front of us.
Never did my parents argued in front of us.
Never did my parents argue in front of us.
Never argued my parents in front of us.
qs.ex: never 置句首：did + 主詞 + 原形動詞；其他選項未倒裝、動詞形式錯誤，或一般動詞直接倒裝。
qs.hint: never 在句首，一般動詞倒裝後要用助動詞加原形，過去式不重複出現。

title: 要求、建議類動詞後的 that 子句
formula: S + suggest / insist / demand / recommend + that + S + (should) + V原形
intro: 老師說「我建議你們考前複習」，醫生說「我堅持你要多睡」，這些建議、要求、命令的話後面接 that 子句時，動詞有特別的形態。這個句型是學測常考的「原形動詞」題，也是寫作時顯得成熟的用法。
rhyme: 建議要求 that 子句，動詞一律用原形。

points.t: 表示建議、要求、堅持、命令的動詞（suggest、recommend、insist、demand、require、order、propose）後接 that 子句，子句動詞用 (should) + 原形動詞。

ex.en: Our teacher suggested that we review Lesson 3 before the quiz.
ex.zh: 老師建議我們在小考前複習第三課。

ex.en: The guide recommended that we bring warm clothes to the mountain.
ex.zh: 導遊建議我們帶保暖衣物上山。

points.t: 子句主詞即使是第三人稱單數，動詞也不加 -s；主要動詞是過去式，子句動詞仍用原形。

ex.en: The doctor insists that my brother get more sleep every night.
ex.zh: 醫生堅持我弟弟每晚要多睡一點。

ex.en: Mom demanded that my sister clean her room right away.
ex.zh: 媽媽要求我妹妹馬上整理房間。

points.t: 否定時用 (should) not + 原形，不需要借助 do。

ex.en: The doctor advised that Grandpa not eat any heavy food at night.
ex.zh: 醫生建議爺爺晚上不要吃油膩的食物。

points.t: 注意：insist 如果表示「堅稱某事是事實」，that 子句依事實的時態，不用原形。

ex.en: She insisted that she was at home all evening.
ex.zh: 她堅稱整個晚上她都在家。

ex.en: He insisted that he had never seen the letter before.
ex.zh: 他堅稱自己以前從來沒看過那封信。
hl: insisted that he had never seen

steps: 先選一個建議或要求類的動詞：suggest、insist、demand、recommend、require、order、propose。
接 that，再寫出子句的主詞。
子句動詞用原形（前面可加 should），不加 -s、-ed，也不管主要動詞的時態；否定就在原形前加 not。
完成例句：The coach demanded that every player arrive early.（教練要求每位球員提早到。）

compare.a: The coach demanded that he (should) run faster.
compare.b: The coach demanded that he runs faster.
compare.note: 建議、要求類動詞後的子句用原形，不加 -s。

compare.a: She insisted that I go with her.
compare.b: She insisted that I went with her.
compare.note: 前句是堅持要求，用原形；後句是堅稱事實，依事實用過去式。

compare.a: He suggested that we not wait.
compare.b: He suggested that we do not wait.
compare.note: 否定時用 not + 原形，不借助 do。

mistakes.wrong: The manager suggested that Emily checks the report.
mistakes.right: The manager suggested that Emily check the report.
mistakes.why: suggest 後的子句用原形，不加 -s。

mistakes.wrong: Mom demanded that my sister cleaned her room.
mistakes.right: Mom demanded that my sister clean her room.
mistakes.why: 要求類動詞後不用過去式，用原形。

mistakes.wrong: The guide recommended that we to bring warm clothes.
mistakes.right: The guide recommended that we bring warm clothes.
mistakes.why: that 子句中原形動詞前不加 to。

qs.s: The manager suggested that Emily ______ the report again before sending it.
qs.ex: suggest 後的 that 子句用 (should) + 原形動詞，故用 check，主詞 Emily 雖為單數也不加 -s。
qs.hint: suggest 是建議類動詞，that 子句的動詞不理會主詞的人稱與單複數。

qs.s: My parents insisted that I ______ home before ten o'clock last night.
qs.ex: insist 表示「堅持要求」時，that 子句用原形動詞，be 為正確形式。
qs.hint: insist 在此表示堅持要求，子句動詞用最單純的形態，連表示存在的那個動詞也一樣。

qs.s: The school requires that all visitors ______ in at the front desk.
qs.ex: require 後的 that 子句用 (should) + 原形，故選 sign。
qs.hint: require 是要求類動詞，後面 that 子句的主詞是 all visitors，動詞用最原始的形態。

qs.s: The doctor advised that Grandpa ______ any heavy food at night.
qs.ex: advise 後的 that 子句用 (should) + 原形，否定為 not + 原形，故選 not eat。
qs.hint: advise 是建議類動詞，否定時 not 直接放在原形動詞前，不需借助助動詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The guide recommended that we bring warm clothes to the mountain.
The guide recommended that we brought warm clothes to the mountain.
The guide recommended that we to bring warm clothes to the mountain.
The guide recommended that we bringing warm clothes to the mountain.
qs.ex: recommend 後的 that 子句動詞用原形 bring；其他選項分別誤用過去式、to V 與 V-ing。
qs.hint: recommend 後的 that 子句，動詞要用原形，不加字尾，也不加 to。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Mom demanded that my sister cleans her room right away.
Mom demanded that my sister cleaned her room right away.
Mom demanded that my sister clean her room right away.
Mom demanded that my sister should to clean her room right away.
qs.ex: demand 後的 that 子句用原形動詞 clean；其他選項分別誤加 -s、誤用過去式，或 should 後誤接 to。
qs.hint: demand 是要求類動詞，主詞 my sister 雖是第三人稱單數，動詞仍用原形。

title: 與現在事實相反的假設語氣
formula: If + S + 過去式 (be 用 were), S + would / could / might + V原形
intro: 你想說「如果我有一輛腳踏車，我每天都會騎去學校」，但事實是你現在沒有。這種「現在不是這樣，只是想像」的說法就用假設語氣。學測常考 if 子句和主要子句的動詞要怎麼搭配。
rhyme: 現在假設，if 用過去，主句 would 加原形。

points.t: 與現在事實相反時，if 子句用過去式，主要子句用 would / could / might + 原形動詞。

ex.en: If I had a bike, I would ride to school every day.
ex.zh: 如果我有一輛腳踏車，我每天都會騎去學校。

points.t: if 子句中的 be 動詞，不論主詞是什麼，正式用法都用 were，例如 If I were you。

ex.en: If Tom were taller, he could join the basketball team.
ex.zh: 如果湯姆再高一點，他就能加入籃球隊。

points.t: 主要子句的 would 表示「就會」，could 表示「就能」，might 表示「也許會」，依語意選擇。

ex.en: If we had more time, we could visit the science museum.
ex.zh: 如果我們有更多時間，就能參觀科學博物館。

ex.en: If I had a car, I might drive to the beach.
ex.zh: 如果我有車，我也許會開車去海邊。

points.t: 這類句子表示現在並非如此，只是想像或假想，也常用於提問。

ex.en: What would you do if you won a free trip to Japan?
ex.zh: 如果你贏得一趟免費的日本旅行，你會怎麼做？

steps: 先想清楚現在的事實是什麼，例如：I do not know the answer.（我不知道答案。）
把 if 子句寫成相反的情況，動詞用過去式；be 動詞用 were。
主要子句用 would / could / might + 原形動詞，寫出想像的結果。
完成例句：If I knew the answer, I would tell you.（如果我知道答案，我就告訴你。）

compare.a: If I had time, I would help you.
compare.b: If I would have time, I would help you.
compare.note: if 子句不放 would，用過去式 had。

compare.a: If I were you, I would study harder.
compare.b: If I was you, I would study harder.
compare.note: 假設語氣的 be 動詞正式用 were。

compare.a: If it rained, we would stay home.
compare.b: If it rains, we will stay home.
compare.note: 前句是與現在事實相反的假設；後句是可能發生的真實條件，用現在式加 will。

mistakes.wrong: If I would have time, I would help you.
mistakes.right: If I had time, I would help you.
mistakes.why: if 子句要用過去式，不能放 would。

mistakes.wrong: If Ben was good at math, he would not ask me.
mistakes.right: If Ben were good at math, he would not ask me.
mistakes.why: 假設語氣的 be 動詞用 were。

mistakes.wrong: If it is sunny today, we would play baseball.
mistakes.right: If it were sunny today, we would play baseball.
mistakes.why: 與現在事實相反，if 子句要用過去式，不能用現在式。

qs.s: If I ______ the answer, I would tell you right now.
qs.ex: 與現在事實相反，if 子句用過去式，故選 knew。
qs.hint: 與現在事實相反，if 子句的動詞要往前退一個時態。

qs.s: If Lisa ______ here now, she would help us carry these boxes.
qs.ex: 主要子句用 would help，表示與現在事實相反（Lisa 現在不在），if 子句用 were。
qs.hint: 主要子句有 would，表示與現在事實相反，if 子句的 be 動詞要用假設語氣專用形。

qs.s: If it ______ outside today, we would play baseball after school.
qs.ex: 與現在事實相反的假設，if 子句用過去式，故選 didn't rain。
qs.hint: 與現在事實相反，if 子句用過去式，並注意否定句要借助助動詞。

qs.s: If I ______ you, I would talk to the teacher about the problem.
qs.ex: If I were you 是常見的假設用法，be 動詞用 were。
qs.hint: If I ___ you 是固定的假設說法，be 動詞不分人稱，用同一種形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If we have more time, we could visit the science museum.
If we had more time, we could visit the science museum.
If we would have more time, we could visit the science museum.
If we had more time, we can visit the science museum.
qs.ex: 與現在事實相反，if 子句用過去式 had，主要子句用 could。其他選項時態或助動詞錯誤。
qs.hint: if 子句用過去式、主要子句用 would / could / might 加原形，不要混用 will 或 can。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If Ben was good at math, he will not ask me for help.
If Ben is good at math, he would not ask me for help.
If Ben were good at math, he would not ask me for help.
If Ben would be good at math, he would not ask me for help.
qs.ex: 正確句用 were 搭配 would not + 原形。其他選項混用時態，或在 if 子句中使用 would。
qs.hint: if 子句不放 would，也不用 is 或 will；be 動詞要用假設語氣的專用形。

title: It is + 形容詞 + that 子句（原形動詞）
formula: It is + important / necessary / urgent / essential + that + S + (should) + V原形
intro: 你想說「考試時準時到場很重要」，除了用 to 不定詞，也可以用 It is important that... 接一個完整句子。這個句型裡的 that 子句動詞很特別，不隨時態和人稱變化。學測常把它當原形動詞題考。
rhyme: 重要必要加緊急，that 後原形不用變。

points.t: It is + 重要、必要、緊急等評價形容詞 + that 子句，子句動詞用 (should) + 原形。

ex.en: It is essential that every student arrive on time for the exam.
ex.zh: 每位學生準時到考場是非常重要的。

points.t: 常見形容詞有 important、necessary、essential、crucial、vital、urgent、imperative。

ex.en: It is vital that Mia not be late for her job interview.
ex.zh: 米雅不要在面試遲到是非常關鍵的。

ex.en: It is crucial that he take his medicine on time.
ex.zh: 他準時吃藥是非常重要的。

points.t: 主要子句用 It was 時，that 子句動詞仍用原形，不跟著變成過去式。

ex.en: It was necessary that the team practice every morning.
ex.zh: 球隊當時有必要每天早上練習。

points.t: 否定時用 (should) not + 原形，不需借助 do，主詞是第三人稱單數時也不加 -s。

ex.en: It is important that you not forget your passport.
ex.zh: 你不要忘記帶護照是很重要的。

steps: 以 It is 或 It was 開頭，接一個評價形容詞：important、necessary、essential、vital、urgent 等。
加 that，再寫出子句的主詞。
動詞用原形（前面可加 should），不加 -s、-ed；否定就在原形前加 not。
完成例句：It is urgent that the boys leave the building right now.（男孩們必須馬上離開這棟大樓，這很緊急。）

compare.a: It is vital that she (should) go now.
compare.b: It is vital that she goes now.
compare.note: 評價形容詞後的 that 子句用原形，不加 -s。

compare.a: It was essential that we leave early.
compare.b: It was essential that we left early.
compare.note: 主要子句是過去式，子句動詞仍用原形。

compare.a: It is important that you not forget it.
compare.b: It is important that you do not forget it.
compare.note: 否定用 (should) not + 原形，不借助 do。

mistakes.wrong: It is vital that she goes now.
mistakes.right: It is vital that she go now.
mistakes.why: 評價形容詞後的子句動詞要用原形。

mistakes.wrong: It was essential that we left before the storm.
mistakes.right: It was essential that we leave before the storm.
mistakes.why: 主要子句是過去式，子句動詞仍用原形。

mistakes.wrong: It is vital that Mia isn't late for the interview.
mistakes.right: It is vital that Mia not be late for the interview.
mistakes.why: 否定用 not + 原形，不用 isn't。

qs.s: It is important that every member ______ the safety rules.
qs.ex: important 後的 that 子句用 (should) + 原形，故選 follow。
qs.hint: important 是表示重要性的形容詞，後面 that 子句的動詞用原形，不加 -s。

qs.s: It was necessary that the doctor ______ the patient immediately.
qs.ex: necessary 後的 that 子句用原形動詞，雖然主要子句是過去式也不變。
qs.hint: necessary 後的 that 子句用原形，即使主要子句是過去式，也不要跟著變。

qs.s: It is urgent that the boys ______ out of the building right now.
qs.ex: urgent 後的 that 子句用 (should) + 原形，故選 get。
qs.hint: urgent 之後的 that 子句，動詞要用不加任何字尾的原形。

qs.s: It is vital that Mia ______ late for her job interview tomorrow.
qs.ex: 否定形式為 (should) not + 原形，故選 not be。
qs.hint: 否定時 not 直接放在原形動詞前，不需 do 或縮寫助動詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It is crucial that he take his medicine on time.
It is crucial that he takes his medicine on time.
It is crucial that he took his medicine on time.
It is crucial that he taking his medicine on time.
qs.ex: crucial 後的 that 子句動詞用原形 take，不加 -s；其他選項為 -s、過去式與 V-ing。
qs.hint: crucial 後的 that 子句動詞不加 -s、不變過去式，也不用 V-ing。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: It was essential that we left before the storm came.
It was essential that we leaving before the storm came.
It was essential that we leave before the storm came.
It was essential that we to leave before the storm came.
qs.ex: essential 後的 that 子句用原形 leave，不隨主要子句的過去式變化。其他選項形式錯誤。
qs.hint: essential 後的 that 子句動詞用原形；主要子句是過去式也不影響，原形前不加 to。

title: seem / appear + to V（to have p.p.）
formula: S + seem / appear + to + V原形　／　S + seem / appear + to have + p.p.
intro: 看到街道是濕的，你會說「昨晚似乎下過雨」；看到妹妹笑得很開心，會說「她似乎很喜歡新學校」。這種「似乎」的語氣就用 seem / appear + to V。學測會考你用 to V 還是 to have p.p.，關鍵是時間先後。
rhyme: 同時用 to V，更早用 to have p.p.。

points.t: seem 或 appear 後接 to + 原形動詞，表示「似乎」，所指的事與現在同時。

ex.en: My little sister seems to enjoy her new school.
ex.zh: 我妹妹似乎很喜歡她的新學校。

points.t: to have + p.p. 表示「似乎已經…」，所指的事發生在 seem 之前，比較早。

ex.en: Our neighbors seem to have moved away already.
ex.zh: 我們的鄰居似乎已經搬走了。

ex.en: The streets are wet, so it appears to have rained last night.
ex.zh: 街道是濕的，所以昨晚似乎下過雨。

points.t: He seems to know 可以改寫成 It seems that he knows，兩者意思相同。

ex.en: He seems to know the answer.
ex.zh: 他似乎知道答案。

ex.en: It seems that he knows the answer.
ex.zh: 似乎他知道答案。

points.t: seem 是連綴動詞，通常不用進行式，也不用被動；後面可接 to be + 形容詞。

ex.en: Everyone in the room seems to be interested in the story.
ex.zh: 房間裡的每個人似乎都對這個故事有興趣。

steps: 先寫主詞和 seem / appear，注意主詞單複數與時態，例如：The streets seem
判斷「似乎」的事是與現在同時，還是更早發生的。
同時用 to + 原形；更早用 to have + p.p.。
完成例句：Dad seems to have forgotten the keys at home.（爸爸似乎把鑰匙忘在家裡了。）

compare.a: She seems to know the answer.
compare.b: She seems to have known the answer.
compare.note: 前句是現在知道；後句是以前就已經知道。

compare.a: It appears to have rained last night.
compare.b: It appears to rain last night.
compare.note: last night 是更早的事，要用 to have + p.p.。

compare.a: The test appears to be easy.
compare.b: The test appears easily.
compare.note: appear 後接形容詞或 to be，不接副詞。

mistakes.wrong: Dad seems to has forgotten the keys.
mistakes.right: Dad seems to have forgotten the keys.
mistakes.why: to 後面不能接 has，要用 have 原形。

mistakes.wrong: The test appears to being easy.
mistakes.right: The test appears to be easy.
mistakes.why: to 後面接原形 be，不是 being。

mistakes.wrong: The little boy seems lost his way yesterday.
mistakes.right: The little boy seems to have lost his way.
mistakes.why: seem 後要接不定詞，更早的事用 to have + p.p.。

qs.s: The little boy seems ______ his way in the crowded market.
qs.ex: 表示「似乎已經迷路」，動作發生在 seems 之前，用 to have + p.p.，故選 to have lost。
qs.hint: 小男孩似乎「已經」迷路了，動作比 seems 更早發生，要用表示更早的形式。

qs.s: Everyone in the room seems ______ interested in the new teacher's story.
qs.ex: seem 後接 to + 原形，故選 to be。
qs.hint: 空格表示現在的狀態，seem 後面接 to 加原形。

qs.s: The ground is covered with leaves, so it appears ______ very hard last night.
qs.ex: 昨晚的事發生在說話之前，用 to have + p.p.，故選 to have blown。
qs.hint: last night 表示更早發生的事，要用完成式不定詞。

qs.s: The streets are empty. Everyone seems ______ for the holiday already.
qs.ex: 「似乎已經離開了」用 to have + p.p.；seem 後不能直接接完成式動詞 has left。
qs.hint: already 表示「已經離開」，是更早完成的事；seem 後接不定詞，不能直接接動詞的完成式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Dad seems to has forgotten the keys at home.
Dad seems forgot the keys at home.
Dad seems to have forgotten the keys at home.
Dad seems forgetting the keys at home.
qs.ex: seem 後接 to have + p.p. 表示過去已發生的事，故正確。其他選項動詞形式錯誤。
qs.hint: 動作發生在 seems 之前，注意 to 後面的動詞不隨人稱變化。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The test appears to being easy for most students.
The test appears to be easy for most students.
The test appears be easy for most students.
The test appears easily for most students.
qs.ex: appear 後用 to + 原形 be。其他選項誤用 to being、缺少 to，或誤用副詞 easily。
qs.hint: appear 後面要接不定詞，且 to 後面用原形動詞，不用 -ing。

title: 與過去事實相反的假設語氣
formula: If + S + had + p.p., S + would / could / might + have + p.p.
intro: 考試考砸了，你會想「如果當時我更用功，就通過了」。這種對已經過去的事感到後悔或慶幸的說法，就是與過去事實相反的假設語氣。學測常考時態配對，記得兩邊都往前退一步。
rhyme: 過去相反，had p.p. 配 would have p.p.。

points.t: 與過去事實相反時，if 子句用過去完成式 had + p.p.。

ex.en: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the test.
ex.zh: 如果我當時更用功，我就通過考試了。

points.t: 主要子句用 would / could / might + have + p.p.，表示「當時就會、就能、也許會…」。

ex.en: If the bus had come earlier, we could have caught the train.
ex.zh: 如果公車早點來，我們就趕得上火車了。

ex.en: She might have won the game if she had practiced more.
ex.zh: 如果她多練習，她也許就贏得比賽了。

points.t: 這類句子常用來表達後悔、遺憾或慶幸。

ex.en: If I had known about the test, I would have studied last night.
ex.zh: 如果我早知道有考試，昨晚就會念書了。

ex.en: If it had not rained, we would have gone to the zoo.
ex.zh: 如果沒下雨，我們就會去動物園了。

points.t: if 子句不用過去簡單式或 would，主要子句不用 will；if 子句的 would have 是常見錯誤。

ex.en: If you had told me the truth, I would have forgiven you.
ex.zh: 如果你當時告訴我實話，我就會原諒你了。

steps: 先想過去實際發生什麼，例如：I did not study, so I failed.（我沒念書，所以不及格。）
把 if 子句寫成相反的情況，動詞用 had + p.p.。
主要子句用 would / could / might + have + p.p.，寫出相反的結果。
完成例句：If I had heard the alarm, I would not have been late.（如果我聽到鬧鐘，就不會遲到了。）

compare.a: If I had known, I would have told you.
compare.b: If I would have known, I would have told you.
compare.note: if 子句用 had + p.p.，不能放 would have。

compare.a: If I had studied, I would have passed.
compare.b: If I studied, I would pass.
compare.note: 前句針對過去事實；後句是現在假設。

compare.a: If he had saved money, he could have bought it.
compare.b: If he saved money, he could have bought it.
compare.note: if 子句時態要用過去完成式，才能與主要子句配對。

mistakes.wrong: If he would have saved money, he could have bought the camera.
mistakes.right: If he had saved money, he could have bought the camera.
mistakes.why: if 子句不放 would，要用 had + p.p.。

mistakes.wrong: If you told me the truth, I would have forgiven you.
mistakes.right: If you had told me the truth, I would have forgiven you.
mistakes.why: 與過去相反，if 子句要用過去完成式。

mistakes.wrong: If Anna had asked me, I would help her yesterday.
mistakes.right: If Anna had asked me, I would have helped her.
mistakes.why: 主要子句要用 would have + p.p.，不是原形動詞。

qs.s: If I ______ the alarm, I would not have been late for school.
qs.ex: 與過去事實相反，if 子句用 had + p.p.，故選 had heard。
qs.hint: 與過去事實相反，if 子句要用比過去式更早的時態。

qs.s: If Anna had asked me, I ______ her with the homework.
qs.ex: 主要子句用 would have + p.p. 表示對過去的假設，故選 would have helped。
qs.hint: if 子句是 had asked，主要子句與過去事實相反，要用對應的過去推測形式。

qs.s: We ______ to the zoo yesterday if it had not rained.
qs.ex: if 子句為 had not rained，主要子句用 would have + p.p.，故選 would have gone。
qs.hint: if 子句是 had not rained，主要子句要用過去推測形式，表示當時就會去。

qs.s: If the driver ______ more carefully, the accident might not have happened.
qs.ex: 與過去事實相反，if 子句用 had + p.p.，故選 had driven。
qs.hint: 主要子句是 might not have happened，if 子句要用過去完成式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If he had saved enough money, he could have bought the camera.
If he saved enough money, he could have bought the camera.
If he would have saved enough money, he could have bought the camera.
If he had saved enough money, he could buy the camera yesterday.
qs.ex: 過去假設為 had + p.p. 搭配 could have + p.p.。其他選項時態或助動詞不符。
qs.hint: if 子句用過去完成式，主要子句用 could + have + p.p.；不要在已有 yesterday 的句子中用原形。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If you told me the truth, I would have forgiven you.
If you had told me the truth, I would have forgiven you.
If you had told me the truth, I would forgive you yesterday.
If you would have told me the truth, I would have forgiven you.
qs.ex: if 子句用 had told，主要子句用 would have forgiven。其他選項在時態或 would have 位置上有誤。
qs.hint: 要用 had + p.p. 搭配 would + have + p.p.，且 would have 不能放在 if 子句。

title: Not until 置於句首的倒裝
formula: Not until + 子句／時間詞, + 助動詞／be + S + V…
intro: 「直到鈴響，學生才離開教室」，可以寫成 Not until the bell rang did the students leave. 把「直到…才…」放到句首，語氣更強。學測常考主要子句要怎麼倒裝，記得倒裝的是後面那半句。
rhyme: Not until 放句首，後半句要倒裝。

points.t: not until 引導的子句或時間詞放在句首時，後面的主要子句要倒裝，意思是「直到…才…」。

ex.en: Not until the bell rang did the students leave the classroom.
ex.zh: 直到鈴響，學生才離開教室。

points.t: 倒裝方式：be 動詞或助動詞移到主詞前；一般動詞借助 do / does / did，動詞改為原形。

ex.en: Not until we got home were we able to eat dinner.
ex.zh: 直到到家我們才吃得到晚餐。

points.t: 只有後面的主要子句倒裝，not until 引導的子句本身不倒裝。

ex.en: Not until last year did my uncle learn how to swim.
ex.zh: 直到去年我叔叔才學會游泳。

points.t: 不倒裝的寫法為 S + not + V + until...，兩種寫法意思相同。

ex.en: The students did not leave the classroom until the bell rang.
ex.zh: 學生直到鈴響才離開教室。

ex.en: I did not know the truth until yesterday.
ex.zh: 直到昨天我才知道真相。

steps: 先寫出一般句型：S + not + V + until...，例如：The rain did not stop until noon.
把 Not until + 時間／子句移到句首：Not until noon...
把後面主要子句倒裝：be 動詞或助動詞放主詞前；一般動詞借助 do / does / did，動詞用原形。
完成例句：Not until noon did the rain stop.（直到中午雨才停。）

compare.a: Not until I came home did I call her.
compare.b: Not until I came home I called her.
compare.note: 前句後半句有倒裝；後句沒有倒裝，是錯的。

compare.a: Not until the rain stopped did we go outside.
compare.b: We did not go outside until the rain stopped.
compare.note: 兩句意思相同，前句倒裝強調，後句是一般語序。

compare.a: Not until he apologized was she willing to talk.
compare.b: Not until did he apologize she was willing.
compare.note: 倒裝的是後面的主要子句，不是 not until 子句。

mistakes.wrong: Not until I came home I called her.
mistakes.right: Not until I came home did I call her.
mistakes.why: not until 在句首，主要子句要倒裝。

mistakes.wrong: Not until the rain stopped did we went outside.
mistakes.right: Not until the rain stopped did we go outside.
mistakes.why: 借用 did 之後，主要動詞要用原形。

mistakes.wrong: Not until did the rain stop we went outside.
mistakes.right: Not until the rain stopped did we go outside.
mistakes.why: 不要把 not until 子句倒裝，倒裝的是後面的主要子句。

qs.s: Not until the movie ended ______ the lights come on.
qs.ex: 主要子句是過去式，一般動詞 come 前借助 did 倒裝，故選 did。
qs.hint: not until 子句不倒裝，後面主要子句要倒裝；主要子句是過去式，一般動詞需借助助動詞。

qs.s: Not until midnight ______ the little boy fall asleep.
qs.ex: 倒裝句中一般動詞 fall 需借助助動詞，過去時態用 did。
qs.hint: 主要子句的動詞 fall 是一般動詞，要借助助動詞倒裝，時態為過去。

qs.s: Not until you finish your homework ______ allowed to play games.
qs.ex: 主要子句倒裝，be 動詞 are 放在主詞 you 前，故選 are you。
qs.hint: 主要子句裡 allowed 與 be 動詞構成被動，倒裝時 be 動詞放在主詞前。

qs.s: Not until she arrived at the station ______ that she had left her bag at home.
qs.ex: 主要子句倒裝，助動詞 did 放在主詞前，故為 did she realize。
qs.hint: 主要子句倒裝：助動詞放主詞前，動詞回到原形。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Not until the rain stopped we went outside.
Not until the rain stopped did we went outside.
Not until the rain stopped did we go outside.
Not until did the rain stop we went outside.
qs.ex: 主要子句要倒裝為 did we go；其他選項沒有倒裝、助動詞後仍用過去式，或把 not until 子句誤倒裝。
qs.hint: 倒裝的是後面的主要子句，借助助動詞後動詞要用原形，且 not until 子句不倒裝。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Not until he apologized she was willing to talk to him.
Not until he apologized was willing she to talk to him.
Not until he apologized was she willing to talk to him.
Not until he apologized, willing was she to talk to him.
qs.ex: 主要子句 be 動詞 was 放主詞前，為 was she willing；其他選項未倒裝或倒裝位置錯誤。
qs.hint: 主要子句裡的 be 動詞要放到主詞前，形容詞 willing 留在原位，不跟著倒裝。

title: If it were not for... / If it had not been for...
formula: If it were not for + N, S + would + V　／　If it had not been for + N, S + would have + p.p.
intro: 想感謝某人或某物「如果沒有它，就不會這樣」，可以用 If it were not for... 表示現在，用 If it had not been for... 表示過去。這是假設語氣的變化版，學測常考 were / had been 的選擇與主要子句的配合。
rhyme: 現在 were not for，過去 had not been for，後面都接名詞。

points.t: If it were not for + 名詞，表示「若非有…（現在）」，主要子句用 would / could + 原形。

ex.en: If it were not for the Internet, we would not find information so quickly.
ex.zh: 如果沒有網路，我們不會這麼快找到資料。

points.t: If it had not been for + 名詞，表示「若當時沒有…」，主要子句用 would have + p.p.。

ex.en: If it had not been for your advice, I would have made a big mistake.
ex.zh: 如果沒有你的建議，我就會犯下大錯。
hl: If it had not been for

points.t: for 後面接名詞或名詞片語，不接完整子句；要接子句時要改寫成名詞片語（如 his help）。

ex.en: If it were not for his help, I would fail the class.
ex.zh: 如果沒有他的幫忙，我這堂課會被當。
hl: If it were not for his help

points.t: 也可以用 Without + 名詞 或 But for + 名詞 改寫，意思相近。

ex.en: Without my alarm clock, I would be late for school every day.
ex.zh: 如果沒有鬧鐘，我每天都會遲到。

ex.en: But for your help, we would have lost the game.
ex.zh: 若不是你幫忙，我們早就輸掉比賽了。

steps: 先判斷是現在還是過去：現在用 If it were not for，過去用 If it had not been for。
for 後面接名詞或名詞片語，說明「沒有什麼」，例如 the map、her kindness。
主要子句：現在用 would + 原形；過去用 would have + p.p.。
完成例句：If it had not been for the map, we would have gotten lost.（若不是有地圖，我們就會迷路了。）

compare.a: If it were not for your help, I would fail.
compare.b: If it had not been for your help, I would have failed.
compare.note: 前句指現在；後句指過去。

compare.a: If it were not for water, we could not live.
compare.b: Without water, we could not live.
compare.note: 兩句意思相近，Without 後面也接名詞。

compare.a: If it were not for his help, I would fail.
compare.b: If it were not for he helped me, I would fail.
compare.note: for 後面要接名詞片語，不能直接接完整子句。

mistakes.wrong: If it were not for he helped me, I would fail.
mistakes.right: If it were not for his help, I would fail.
mistakes.why: for 是介系詞，後面接名詞，不接子句。

mistakes.wrong: If it had not been for her kindness, I would feel lonely then.
mistakes.right: If it had not been for her kindness, I would have felt lonely.
mistakes.why: 過去假設，主要子句要用 would have + p.p.。

mistakes.wrong: If it had not been her kindness, I would have felt lonely.
mistakes.right: If it had not been for her kindness, I would have felt lonely.
mistakes.why: 不能漏掉 for。

qs.s: If it ______ for the nurse's quick action, the patient would be in danger now.
qs.ex: 現在的假設用 If it were not for，故選 were not。
qs.hint: now 表示現在的情況，要選與現在事實相反的 If it ___ for 形式。

qs.s: If it ______ for your help last week, I would have failed the project.
qs.ex: 表示過去事實相反，用 If it had not been for，故選 had not been。
qs.hint: last week 表示過去，要選與過去事實相反的 If it ___ for 形式。

qs.s: If it were not for the sun, all plants ______ to grow.
qs.ex: If it were not for 為現在假設，主要子句用 would + 原形，故選 would fail。
qs.hint: If it were not for 是現在假設，主要子句助動詞用 would 加原形。

qs.s: If it had not been for the map, we ______ lost in the forest.
qs.ex: If it had not been for 後主要子句用 would have + p.p.，故選 would have gotten。
qs.hint: If it had not been for 是過去假設，主要子句用 would have + p.p.，注意 get 的過去分詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If it were not for music, my life would be dull.
If it is not for music, my life would be dull.
If it were not for music, my life will be dull.
If it were not for music is my life, it would be dull.
qs.ex: If it were not for + 名詞，主要子句用 would + 原形。其他選項時態、助動詞或句構錯誤。
qs.hint: If it were not for 後接名詞，主要子句用 would + 原形，不用 will。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: If it had not been for her kindness, I would feel lonely then.
If it had not been for her kindness, I would have felt lonely.
If it were not for her kindness, I would have felt lonely.
If it had not been her kindness, I would have felt lonely.
qs.ex: 過去假設為 had not been for 搭配 would have + p.p.。其他選項時態不符或漏了 for。
