qs.hint: 過去假設要搭配過去完成式與 would have + p.p.，且不能漏掉 for。

title: Only + 副詞片語／子句 置於句首的倒裝
formula: Only + 副詞（片語／子句）+ 助動詞／be + S + V…
intro: 老師說「只有認真複習，你才會進步」，想把「只有……才……」講得很有力，英文就把 Only 搬到句首。這時後面的句子會像疑問句一樣倒裝，聽起來更強調、更正式。學測的單選和改錯很愛考：Only + 副詞成分開頭，後面到底要不要倒裝。
rhyme: Only 加副詞站句首，助動詞先跑到主詞前

points.t: Only 後面接「副詞、介系詞片語或子句」放在句首，表示「唯有這樣才……」，後面的主要子句要倒裝。

ex.en: Only by working together can we finish this project on time.
ex.zh: 只有一起努力，我們才能準時完成這個專案。

points.t: 倒裝方法：有 be 動詞或助動詞就把它移到主詞前；只有一般動詞時，借用 do / does / did，動詞變回原形。

ex.en: Only after the test did Amy feel relaxed.
ex.zh: 直到考試結束後，艾咪才覺得放鬆。

points.t: Only when 引導的子句放句首時，子句本身照常寫，倒裝的是後面的主要子句。

ex.en: Only when you ask politely will the clerk help you.
ex.zh: 只有在你客氣詢問時，店員才會幫你。

points.t: 常見開頭還有 Only then、Only in this way、Only later，一看到它們在句首就要提醒自己倒裝。

ex.en: Only in this way can students learn from their mistakes.
ex.zh: 只有這樣，學生才能從錯誤中學習。

ex.en: Only then did I understand the teacher's words.
ex.zh: 直到那時，我才明白老師的話。

points.t: Only 如果是修飾主詞（Only Tom、Only students），整句不倒裝，因為主詞本來就在最前面。

ex.en: Only Tom knows the answer to this question.
ex.zh: 只有湯姆知道這題的答案。

steps: 步驟 1：先寫出普通句，例如 We can solve the problem in this way.
步驟 2：把表示「唯有……」的副詞成分（in this way）加上 Only 搬到句首。
步驟 3：把後面主要子句的助動詞或 be 動詞移到主詞前；若是一般動詞就加 do / does / did，動詞改原形。
完成句：Only in this way can we solve the problem.

compare.a: Only then did I understand the teacher.
compare.b: Only then I understood the teacher.
compare.note: Only then 在句首，後面必須倒裝，不能照一般語序。

compare.a: Only Tom knows the answer.
compare.b: Only does Tom know the answer.
compare.note: Only 只修飾主詞時不倒裝，倒裝只用在 Only + 副詞成分開頭時。

mistakes.wrong: Only then I realized the mistake.
mistakes.right: Only then did I realize the mistake.
mistakes.why: Only then 在句首，主要子句要倒裝，用 did + 主詞 + 原形。

mistakes.wrong: Only then did I realized the mistake.
mistakes.right: Only then did I realize the mistake.
mistakes.why: did 已經帶有過去式，後面的動詞要用原形。

mistakes.wrong: Only when is it quiet can I study well.
mistakes.right: Only when it is quiet can I study well.
mistakes.why: only when 子句本身不倒裝，倒裝的是後面的主要子句。

qs.s: Only in this way ______ solve the problem.
qs.ex: only + 副詞片語在句首，後面倒裝，助動詞 can 放主詞 we 前，故選 can we。
qs.hint: 看句首是 only + 副詞片語，後面的主要子句要倒裝，想想助動詞要放在主詞前還是後。

qs.s: Only after dinner last night ______ my brother finish his homework.
qs.ex: Only + 時間副詞置句首要倒裝；last night 是過去，句中動詞 finish 為原形，故用助動詞 did。
qs.hint: 句首 Only + 時間副詞，主要子句倒裝；注意 last night 的時態，且動詞 finish 是原形。

qs.s: Only when the teacher came in ______ quiet.
qs.ex: only when 子句在句首，主要子句倒裝，故為 did the students become。
qs.hint: only when 子句在句首，主要子句要倒裝；注意一般動詞要借助 do 系列助動詞，後面動詞用原形。

qs.s: Only by reading every day ______ improve your English.
qs.ex: only by + V-ing 在句首，後面倒裝為 can you + 原形。
qs.hint: Only by + V-ing 在句首，後面像疑問句，助動詞先於主詞，再接原形動詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Only then I realized the mistake.
Only then did I realized the mistake.
Only then did I realize the mistake.
Only then realized I the mistake.
qs.ex: only then 在句首，後面用 did + 主詞 + 原形，故為 did I realize。其他選項未倒裝，或助動詞後誤用過去式。
qs.hint: 找 Only then 之後有沒有倒裝，同時檢查助動詞後面的動詞是不是原形。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Only when it is quiet I can study well.
Only when it is quiet can study I well.
Only when is it quiet can I study well.
Only when it is quiet can I study well.
qs.ex: only when 子句本身不倒裝，主要子句才倒裝為 can I study。其他選項未倒裝，或誤倒裝子句。
qs.hint: only when 子句不倒裝，倒裝的是主要子句；先分清楚哪一段是子句再檢查語序。

title: must have p.p.（對過去的肯定推測）
formula: S + must have + p.p.
intro: 走進教室發現燈關了、桌上沒有書包，你會猜「大家一定已經回家了」。像這種對「過去已經發生的事」做很有把握的推測，英文就用 must have p.p.。學測常考它的形式，也常和 should have p.p.、can't have p.p. 混在一起考。
rhyme: 過去很肯定，must have p.p.

points.t: must have + p.p. 表示「對過去的事做肯定的推測」，意思是「一定是……了」，把握度很高。

ex.en: The lights are off, so everyone must have gone home already.
ex.zh: 燈都關了，所以大家一定已經回家了。

points.t: 說話時看到的是「現在的結果」，推測的是「過去的原因」，例如電話沒接，推測她已經睡著了。

ex.en: Jenny didn't answer the phone. She must have fallen asleep.
ex.zh: 珍妮沒接電話，她一定是睡著了。

points.t: must 後面接 have，have 後面一定是過去分詞，不可寫 must has、must have leave 或 must be fallen。

ex.en: The window is broken. Someone must have hit it with a ball.
ex.zh: 窗戶破了，一定是有人用球打到它。

points.t: 推測「現在」的事用 must + 原形；推測「過去」的事才用 must have + p.p.，要看時間線索。

ex.en: Tom must be tired because he ran all morning.
ex.zh: 湯姆一定很累，因為他整個早上都在跑步。

ex.en: Tom got full marks. He must have studied hard.
ex.zh: 湯姆考滿分，他一定很用功念書。

points.t: 否定的肯定推測用 can't have + p.p.（不可能已經……），不用 mustn't have；「早該做卻沒做」則是 should have + p.p.。

ex.en: Amy can't have finished the book in one hour.
ex.zh: 艾咪不可能在一小時內讀完那本書。

steps: 步驟 1：確認你是在「推測」已發生的事，而且很有把握，才選 must have。
步驟 2：寫出主詞，後面接 must have。
步驟 3：把想推測的動作改成過去分詞（p.p.），例如 go → gone、eat → eaten。
完成句：The road is blocked, so there must have been an accident.

compare.a: She must have left her wallet on the bus.
compare.b: She should have left her wallet on the bus.
compare.note: must have p.p. 是推測「一定是」；should have p.p. 是「早該」，兩者意思不同。

compare.a: He must have forgotten the key.
compare.b: He can't have forgotten the key.
compare.note: must have 是肯定推測，can't have 是否定推測「不可能」。

compare.a: He must be at home now.
compare.b: He must have been at home last night.
compare.note: 推測現在用 must + 原形，推測過去用 must have + p.p.。

mistakes.wrong: She must has left her wallet on the bus.
mistakes.right: She must have left her wallet on the bus.
mistakes.why: must 是情態助動詞，後面接 have，不可用 has。

mistakes.wrong: She must have leave her wallet on the bus.
mistakes.right: She must have left her wallet on the bus.
mistakes.why: have 後面要用過去分詞 left，不是原形。

mistakes.wrong: Jenny mustn't have heard the phone.
mistakes.right: Jenny can't have heard the phone.
mistakes.why: 否定推測「不可能已經」用 can't have p.p.，不用 mustn't have。

qs.s: The lights are off, so everyone ______ home already.
qs.ex: 根據線索推測過去已經發生的事，用 must have + p.p.，故選 must have gone。
qs.hint: 看 lights are off 這個現在線索，推測的是過去已發生的事，想想情態助動詞後面接什麼形式。

qs.s: Jenny didn't answer the phone. She ______ asleep.
qs.ex: 對過去事實的肯定推測用 must have + p.p.；fall 的過去分詞為 fallen。
qs.hint: 句子在推測珍妮過去沒接電話的原因，注意 have 後面要接的動詞形式（過去分詞）。

qs.s: The window is broken. Someone ______ it with a ball.
qs.ex: 對過去事實的推測，用 must have + p.p.，故選 must have hit。
qs.hint: 推測的是窗戶破掉之前的動作，要用「情態助動詞 + have + 過去分詞」，並且 hit 的過去分詞和原形同形。

qs.s: Tom got full marks on the test. He ______ hard.
qs.ex: 根據他得到滿分的事實推測，用 must have + p.p.，故選 must have studied。
qs.hint: 滿分是現在的結果，推測的是過去的努力，且「一定」是有把握的推測，不是勸告。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The road is blocked, so there must have been an accident.
The road is blocked, so there must have an accident.
The road is blocked, so there must be had an accident.
The road is blocked, so there must been an accident.
qs.ex: 推測過去有事故用 must have been；其他選項漏掉 been 或助動詞形式錯誤。
qs.hint: 檢查 must 後面接的是不是 have，且 have 後面是不是過去分詞。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She must has left her wallet on the bus.
She must have left her wallet on the bus.
She must have leave her wallet on the bus.
She must have leaving her wallet on the bus.
qs.ex: must 後要接 have，再接過去分詞 left。其他選項誤用 has、原形或 V-ing。
qs.hint: 檢查 must 後面該接 have 還是 has，以及 left 這個動詞形式有沒有放對。

title: 複合關係代名詞 whatever / whoever
formula: whatever / whoever / whichever + (S) + V ...
intro: 餐廳老闆說「想吃什麼就點什麼」，社團老師說「想參加的人都歡迎」，這種「不管是什麼、不管是誰」的說法，英文用 whatever / whoever / whichever，一個字就同時當名詞和子句的連接詞。學測常考它們的選擇與動詞搭配。
rhyme: whatever 自帶先行詞，不必再加 anything／that

points.t: whoever = anyone who，意思是「任何……的人」，在子句中當主詞，後面直接接動詞。

ex.en: Whoever wants to join the hiking club should sign up before Friday.
ex.zh: 任何想加入登山社的人都應該在星期五前報名。

points.t: whatever = anything that，意思是「任何……的事物」，在子句中當受詞或主詞。

ex.en: The cafeteria lets us eat whatever we like, as long as we finish it.
ex.zh: 只要吃完，餐廳讓我們吃任何喜歡的東西。

points.t: whichever 表示「在有限範圍內，不管哪一個」，常接名詞，用在選擇有範圍時。

ex.en: You may take whichever seat is empty.
ex.zh: 你可以坐任何一個空位。

points.t: 複合關代自己就帶有先行詞，所以前面不可再加 anything、that，否則會重複。

ex.en: Whatever my sister cooks tastes delicious.
ex.zh: 不管我姊姊煮什麼都很好吃。

points.t: whoever 引導的名詞子句當主詞時，動詞要和子句內的單數主詞一致；即使前面有介系詞，子句主詞仍用 whoever。

ex.en: Our class will give a small gift to whoever gets the highest score.
ex.zh: 我們班會送小禮物給得分最高的人。

steps: 步驟 1：先想要說的是「人」（whoever）、「事物」（whatever），還是「範圍內的哪一個」（whichever）。
步驟 2：把它放在名詞子句的開頭，不要再加 anything、that 或 the one。
步驟 3：後面接子句（主詞 + 動詞），並檢查子句動詞和主詞一致。
完成句：Whoever is late for class must tell the teacher why.

compare.a: Whatever he says is true.
compare.b: Anything whatever he says is true.
compare.note: whatever 已含先行詞 anything，不可再重複加上。

compare.a: You may take whichever seat you like.
compare.b: You may take whatever seat you like.
compare.note: 有明確範圍的選擇用 whichever，範圍不限才用 whatever。

compare.a: Whoever is late must tell the teacher.
compare.b: Whomever is late must tell the teacher.
compare.note: 在子句中當主詞要用 whoever，不是 whomever。

mistakes.wrong: Whatever that my sister cooks tastes delicious.
mistakes.right: Whatever my sister cooks tastes delicious.
mistakes.why: whatever 本身已是連接詞兼代名詞，不可再加 that。

mistakes.wrong: Whoever are late for class must tell the teacher why.
mistakes.right: Whoever is late for class must tell the teacher why.
mistakes.why: whoever 子句的主詞視為單數，動詞用 is。

mistakes.wrong: Anything whatever he says is true.
mistakes.right: Whatever he says is true.
mistakes.why: anything 與 whatever 重複，只要保留 whatever。

qs.s: ______ wants to join the hiking club should sign up before Friday.
qs.ex: 空格後缺主詞，指人且作 wants 的主詞，用 Whoever。Whatever 指事物，不合。
qs.hint: 空格後直接接動詞 wants，所以要找在子句中當主詞、指「人」的字。

qs.s: The cafeteria lets us eat ______ we like, as long as we finish it.
qs.ex: eat 的受詞為「任何我們喜歡的東西」，用 whatever 即可，不能再加 what that 或 anything what。
qs.hint: 空格後面有完整子句 we like，缺少的是受詞，指「事物」，且前面不需再加其他詞。

qs.s: You may take ______ seat is empty; no one has reserved any of them.
qs.ex: 後接名詞 seat，表示「任何一個」，用 whichever + 名詞；whoever 指人，不能修飾 seat。
qs.hint: 句尾說明「沒有人預約」，座位是有限範圍中的任何一個，且後面接名詞 seat。

qs.s: Our class will give a small gift to ______ gets the highest score in the contest.
qs.ex: gets 前缺主詞，雖然前面有介系詞 to，仍由子句內的角色決定，主詞用 whoever，而非 whomever。
qs.hint: 介系詞 to 後面接的是名詞子句，子句中缺主詞 gets，要選指「人」且當主詞的形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Whatever that my sister cooks tastes delicious.
Whatever my sister cooks tastes delicious.
Anything whatever my sister cooks tastes delicious.
Whatever my sister cooks taste delicious.
qs.ex: whatever 已含先行詞與關代，不可再加 that，也不可前面再放 anything；整個子句為單數，動詞用 tastes。
qs.hint: 檢查複合關代前面有沒有多餘的 that 或 anything，還有動詞形式是否對。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Whoever are late for class must tell the teacher why.
Whoever is late for class must to tell the teacher why.
Whoever is late for class must tell the teacher why.
Whomever is late for class must tell the teacher why.
qs.ex: Whoever 子句視為單數，用 is；must 後接原形動詞，不加 to；late 前缺主詞，應用 whoever 而非 whomever。
qs.hint: 檢查動詞 is 和 are 的單複數，以及 must 後面不該多接 to 的錯誤用法。

title: for fear that 以免、唯恐
formula: S + V + for fear that + S + would / should / might + V原形
intro: 你把腳踏車上了鎖，是因為「怕被偷」；你走路很小聲，是「怕吵醒嬰兒」。這種「為了避免擔心的事發生」的原因，英文可以用 for fear that 來表達。學測喜歡考後面子句的助動詞，特別是 would / should / might 的選擇。
rhyme: for fear that，後面 would / might，不加 not

points.t: for fear that = 以免、唯恐，說明「做這件事是因為怕某個壞結果發生」，主要子句通常是做的動作。

ex.en: He locked the bike for fear that someone would steal it.
ex.zh: 他把腳踏車上鎖，以免有人偷走。
hl: for fear that someone would steal

points.t: that 後面的子句要用 would / should / might + 原形動詞，表示「萬一可能發生」的擔心。

ex.en: We stayed quiet for fear that the baby might wake up.
ex.zh: 我們保持安靜，唯恐吵醒嬰兒。
hl: for fear that the baby might wake

points.t: 子句本身已有「害怕」的否定概念，不可再加 not；想說的是怕發生的事，不是怕沒發生。

ex.en: She took notes carefully for fear that she would forget the homework.
ex.zh: 她仔細做筆記，以免忘記功課。
hl: for fear that she would forget

points.t: that 有時可以省略，意思不變；不可改寫成 for the fear 或 because of fear 這類不同句型。

ex.en: I left early for fear I would miss the train.
ex.zh: 我提早出門，以免錯過火車。

points.t: 子句中的助動詞用 should 時，也表示「萬一」的擔心，意思和 would / might 相近。

ex.en: Mike didn't tell Amy the news for fear that she should be worried.
ex.zh: 邁克沒告訴艾咪這個消息，以免她擔心。
hl: for fear that she should be worried

steps: 步驟 1：先寫出主要子句，也就是你做的事，例如 He locked the bike。
步驟 2：想一想你怕什麼壞事發生，例如有人偷車。
步驟 3：接上 for fear that，再加子句：主詞 + would / might / should + 原形動詞。
完成句：She spoke softly for fear that the teacher might hear her.

compare.a: I left early for fear that I would miss the train.
compare.b: I left early so that I would not miss the train.
compare.note: for fear that 本身帶否定概念，so that 才需要加 not。

compare.a: He ran for fear that he might be late.
compare.b: He ran in case he is late.
compare.note: in case 後面常用現在式，for fear that 後面用 would / might 等情態。

compare.a: She hid the cake for fear that her brother would eat it.
compare.b: She hid the cake because of fear.
compare.note: because of fear 缺少子句，不能取代 for fear that。

mistakes.wrong: Run for fear that you will not miss the bus.
mistakes.right: Run for fear that you might miss the bus.
mistakes.why: for fear that 後不可再加 not，也不用 will。

mistakes.wrong: She spoke softly for fear that the teacher can hear her.
mistakes.right: She spoke softly for fear that the teacher might hear her.
mistakes.why: 子句要用 would / might / should，不用 can 或現在式。

mistakes.wrong: I left early for fear that I missing the train.
mistakes.right: I left early for fear that I would miss the train.
mistakes.why: that 後是完整子句，要有助動詞加原形，不能用 V-ing。

qs.s: He locked the bike for fear that someone ______ it.
qs.ex: for fear that 後接 would / should / might + 原形，would steal 正確；will 與單純現在式 steals 不合。
qs.hint: for fear that 之後的子句要用過去形的情態助動詞，表示可能發生的擔心。

qs.s: We stayed quiet for fear that the baby ______ up.
qs.ex: for fear that 子句用 might + 原形，might wake 正確；其他選項沒有助動詞，或多出否定。
qs.hint: 需要表達「萬一可能發生」的情態助動詞加原形，而且動詞 wake 後面還要接 up。

qs.s: She took notes carefully for fear that she ______ the homework.
qs.ex: for fear that 本身含否定意味，用 would forget，不再加 not，也不用 will。
qs.hint: 想想 forget 這個動詞要接怎樣的情態助動詞，並且這裡不能出現 not。

qs.s: Mike didn't tell the news to Amy ______ she should be worried.
qs.ex: 後面接完整子句 she should be worried，連接詞用 for fear that；in fear of 後面要接名詞或動名詞。
qs.hint: 句意是「不告訴她，以免她擔心」，要選表示「為了避免」的固定片語，後面接完整子句。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: I left early for fear that I would miss the train.
I left early for fear that I will miss the train.
I left early for fear that I would not miss the train.
I left early for fear that I missing the train.
qs.ex: for fear that 後接 would + 原形；will 不合，加 not 會變成相反的意思，missing 不是完整動詞形式。
qs.hint: 檢查 for fear that 後面是否出現 will、not 或 V-ing 這類不適合的形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She spoke softly for fear that the teacher can hear her.
She spoke softly for fear that the teacher hears her.
She spoke softly for fear that the teacher might hear her.
She spoke softly for fear the teacher to hear her.
qs.ex: for fear that 之後要用 would / should / might + 原形，might hear 正確；can hear、hears 與 to hear 都不合。
qs.hint: 檢查子句裡有沒有適合的情態助動詞，並注意 that 之後要有完整子句。

title: 倍數比較句型
formula: 倍數 + the + 名詞(size/length/amount...) + of + N；倍數 + as + adj + as
intro: 「這棟教學大樓是舊體育館的三倍大」、「這支手機是那支的兩倍貴」，要表達「幾倍」，英文有兩種很常用的寫法：倍數 + the + 名詞 + of，以及倍數 + as + 形容詞 + as。學測常考你選對 the size of 還是 as large as。
rhyme: 倍數站前面，the 名詞 of，或 as 形 as

points.t: 倍數 + the + 名詞 + of + 比較對象：名詞常是 size、length、height、weight、amount 等。

ex.en: The school library is three times the size of the classroom.
ex.zh: 學校圖書館是教室的三倍大。

points.t: 倍數 + as + 原級形容詞／副詞 + as + 比較對象，中間用原級，不能用比較級。

ex.en: This lake is twice as deep as that pond.
ex.zh: 這個湖的深度是那個池塘的兩倍。

points.t: half、twice、three times 等倍數詞一律放在 the 或 as 的前面；兩倍可用 twice，不一定要說 two times。

ex.en: My backpack is only half the weight of my brother's.
ex.zh: 我的背包重量只有我哥哥的一半。

points.t: the 後面要接名詞（size、height 等），不能直接接形容詞，也不要寫成 the + 形容詞。

ex.en: The tower is two times the height of that tree.
ex.zh: 那座塔的高度是那棵樹的兩倍。

points.t: 表示價格、數量時常用 as much as / as many as，一樣是倍數放在最前面。

ex.en: Tom's phone cost four times as much as mine.
ex.zh: 湯姆的手機價格是我的四倍。

steps: 步驟 1：先決定要比較的兩個東西，例如新體育館和舊體育館。
步驟 2：想一想倍數（twice、three times、half），把它放在最前面。
步驟 3：選一種句型：倍數 + as + 形容詞 + as，或倍數 + the + 名詞 + of。
完成句：Our new gym is five times as large as the old one.

compare.a: The tower is twice the height of that tree.
compare.b: The tower is twice higher than that tree.
compare.note: 倍數句型不用 -er than，要用 the + 名詞 + of 或 as...as。

compare.a: It is twice as large as mine.
compare.b: It is twice the size of mine.
compare.note: 兩種句型意思相同，差在 as 後接形容詞，the 後接名詞。

compare.a: It is half the size of mine.
compare.b: It is the half size of mine.
compare.note: 倍數詞（half）要放在 the 前面，不能放在後面。

mistakes.wrong: It is twice the large of mine.
mistakes.right: It is twice the size of mine.
mistakes.why: the 後面要接名詞 size，不是形容詞 large。

mistakes.wrong: Our new gym is five times as larger as the old one.
mistakes.right: Our new gym is five times as large as the old one.
mistakes.why: as...as 中間要用原級，不能用比較級。

mistakes.wrong: The tower is two times the height than that tree.
mistakes.right: The tower is two times the height of that tree.
mistakes.why: 倍數句型用 of，不是 than。

qs.s: The school library is three times ______ the classroom.
qs.ex: 倍數 + the + 名詞 + of，three times the size of 正確；其他選項結構錯誤。
qs.hint: 空格前有倍數詞 three times，後面是 the + 名詞 + of 的結構，要選合適的名詞。

qs.s: My backpack is only half ______ my brother's, so it is much lighter.
qs.ex: half the weight of 表「是…重量的一半」，the 不可省略。
qs.hint: half 後面接 the，再接名詞，最後用 of，不能只放形容詞。

qs.s: This lake is twice as ______ as that pond.
qs.ex: as ... as 之間用形容詞或副詞原級，用 deep。
qs.hint: as...as 中間要放形容詞原級，不是比較級或最高級。

qs.s: Tom's phone cost four times ______ mine.
qs.ex: four times as much as 表「是…的四倍價錢」；as much as 用來比較金額，其他選項結構錯誤。
qs.hint: four times 後面可接 as...as，想想價格這種量要怎麼表示。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: The tower is two times the height than that tree.
The tower is two times height of that tree.
The tower is two times higher the height of that tree.
The tower is two times the height of that tree.
qs.ex: 正確結構為倍數 + the + height + of；其餘選項多了 than、漏 the，或重複使用比較級。
qs.hint: 檢查句子有沒有誤用 than，或 the 與名詞的位置，還有 of 有沒有使用。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Our new gym is five times as large as the old one.
Our new gym is five times as larger as the old one.
Our new gym is as five times large as the old one.
Our new gym is five times so large as the old one.
qs.ex: 倍數放在第一個 as 之前，as 之間用原級；larger 是比較級，as five times 位置顛倒，so 不可取代 as。
qs.hint: 檢查倍數詞的位置，以及 as...as 中間的形容詞是不是原級。

title: 複合形容詞
formula: 名詞/形容詞/副詞 + 現在分詞或過去分詞；數字 + 單數名詞
intro: 你住過「五星級飯店」、坐過「兩小時的車程」，這些「數字 + 名詞」放在名詞前面形容它的詞，就是複合形容詞。像 five-star hotel、well-known writer，用連字號把兩個字連成一個形容詞。學測常考「名詞不可加 s」和「分詞要用哪一種」。
rhyme: 數字加單數，連字號一起當形容詞

points.t: 數字 + 單數名詞：中間用連字號，名詞一律用單數，不能加 s，因為整個詞是形容詞。

ex.en: We stayed at a five-star hotel near the beach.
ex.zh: 我們住在海邊附近的五星級飯店。

points.t: 這類複合形容詞放在名詞前面當修飾語，所以時間、距離、頁數等單位名詞都保持單數。

ex.en: It took us a two-hour ride to get to the museum.
ex.zh: 我們花了兩小時的車程才到達博物館。

points.t: 名詞 + 現在分詞（V-ing）：表示「主動」的意思，如 sweet-smelling（散發甜香的）。

ex.en: The park is full of sweet-smelling flowers in spring.
ex.zh: 公園在春天滿是香氣甜美的花。

points.t: 副詞／形容詞 + 過去分詞（p.p.）：表示「被……」的意思，如 well-known（著名的）。

ex.en: He is a well-known writer in our town.
ex.zh: 他是我們鎮上的知名作家。

points.t: 形容詞 + 名詞-ed：用來描述人的特質，如 kind-hearted（心地善良的），-ed 是固定的形式。

ex.en: Mr. Lin is a kind-hearted teacher, so every student likes him.
ex.zh: 林老師心地善良，所以每個學生都喜歡他。

steps: 步驟 1：先想要形容的東西，例如一封三頁的信。
步驟 2：把修飾的詞組放在名詞前，數字 + 單數名詞，中間用連字號。
步驟 3：確認連字號後面的名詞沒有加 s，並且整個詞放在被修飾名詞的前面。
完成句：She gave me a three-page letter.

compare.a: a three-page letter
compare.b: a letter of three pages
compare.note: 前者用複合形容詞，名詞單數；後者用 of 片語，名詞要加 s。

compare.a: a well-known writer
compare.b: a well-knowing writer
compare.note: well-known 的 known 是過去分詞，表示「被知道」，不能寫成 knowing。

compare.a: a five-star hotel
compare.b: a five stars hotel
compare.note: 複合形容詞中的名詞不可加 s。

mistakes.wrong: She gave me a three-pages letter.
mistakes.right: She gave me a three-page letter.
mistakes.why: 數字複合形容詞的名詞不加 s。

mistakes.wrong: He is a well-knowing writer in our town.
mistakes.right: He is a well-known writer in our town.
mistakes.why: 這裡要表示「被人熟知」，用過去分詞 known。

mistakes.wrong: We stayed at a five stars hotel.
mistakes.right: We stayed at a five-star hotel.
mistakes.why: 數字 + 名詞當形容詞，中間要有連字號，名詞用單數。

qs.s: We stayed at a ______ hotel near the beach.
qs.ex: 數字 + 單數名詞作形容詞，連字號相連，star 不加 s。
qs.hint: 數字 + 名詞要組成形容詞，注意中間有沒有連字號，以及名詞要不要加 s。

qs.s: Mr. Lin is a ______ teacher, so every student likes him.
qs.ex: 形容詞 + 名詞-ed 構成複合形容詞 kind-hearted，意思為「好心腸的」，要用連字號。
qs.hint: 形容人的特質，常見形式是「形容詞 + 名詞-ed」，要連在一起。

qs.s: It took us a ______ ride to get to the museum.
qs.ex: two-hour ride 是常見的複合形容詞，hour 用單數。
qs.hint: 整個詞是放在 ride 前的形容詞，單位名詞不加 s，並且要用連字號相連。

qs.s: The park is full of ______ flowers in spring.
qs.ex: 花會散發香味，表主動，用現在分詞 smelling，構成 sweet-smelling。
qs.hint: flowers 是主動散發香氣的，分詞要選表示「主動」的 V-ing 形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He is a well-knowing writer in our town.
He is a well-known writer in our town.
He is a known-well writer in our town.
He is a well-known-ly writer in our town.
qs.ex: 「著名的」用 well-known（副詞 + 過去分詞），其他組合不是正確的英文複合形容詞。
qs.hint: 想想作家是「被人知道」還是「主動知道」，並且找連字號與詞序正確的選項。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She gave me a three-pages letter.
She gave me a three pages letter.
She gave me a pages-three letter.
She gave me a three-page letter.
qs.ex: 數字 + 單數名詞構成複合形容詞，且要加連字號，page 不加 s。
qs.hint: 數字複合形容詞中的名詞不能加 s，也不能顛倒順序。

title: as if 引導的假設語氣
formula: as if + S + 過去式 / were（與現在事實相反）；as if + S + had + p.p.（與過去事實相反）
intro: 朋友明明沒看過電影，卻講得好像他看過一樣；弟弟明明不是大人，卻擺出大人的樣子。這種「好像……似的，但其實不是」的語氣，英文用 as if（或 as though）加上假設語氣。學測常考你選 were、過去式還是 had p.p.。
rhyme: as if 像但不是，現在用過去，過去用 had p.p.

points.t: as if + S + 過去式：表示「與現在事實相反」，描述現在其實不是那樣，卻看起來好像是。

ex.en: Tina acts as if she knew everything about the new teacher.
ex.zh: 蒂娜表現得好像她對新老師了如指掌一樣。

points.t: as if 子句中 be 動詞一律用 were（不分人稱），這是假設語氣的慣用法。

ex.en: He looks at me as if I were a stranger.
ex.zh: 他看著我的樣子好像我是陌生人一樣。

points.t: as if + S + had + p.p.：表示「與過去事實相反」，描述過去其實沒發生，卻說得好像發生了。

ex.en: The room was a mess, as if a storm had passed through it last night.
ex.zh: 房間一團亂，好像昨晚有暴風雨經過一樣。
hl: as if a storm had passed

points.t: 主要子句的時態不影響 as if 子句：主要子句用現在或過去，as if 子句都看「事實」是現在還是過去。

ex.en: The kids looked at me as if they knew the answer, but they didn't.
ex.zh: 孩子們看著我，好像他們知道答案，但其實不知道。

points.t: 若 as if 描述的是真的可能的事（不是與事實相反），可以用直說法；與事實相反時才用假設語氣。

ex.en: It looks as if it will rain this afternoon.
ex.zh: 看起來下午好像會下雨。

steps: 步驟 1：先寫主要子句，例如 She treats me.
步驟 2：判斷事實，是現在不是那樣，還是過去不是那樣。
步驟 3：加上 as if；現在事實相反用過去式（be 用 were），過去事實相反用 had + p.p.。
完成句：She treats me as if I were her little sister.

compare.a: He acts as if he were a child.
compare.b: He acts as if he is a child.
compare.note: 事實上他不是小孩，所以要用 were，不是 is。

compare.a: He spoke as if he had seen the movie.
compare.b: He spoke as if he saw the movie.
compare.note: 其實他沒看過電影，描述過去事實相反要用 had p.p.。

compare.a: It looks as if it will rain.
compare.b: It looks as if it had rained.
compare.note: 前者可能性真實，直說；後者與過去事實相反。

mistakes.wrong: She treats me as if I am her little sister.
mistakes.right: She treats me as if I were her little sister.
mistakes.why: 與現在事實相反，be 動詞用 were。

mistakes.wrong: He spoke as if he has seen the movie, but he hadn't.
mistakes.right: He spoke as if he had seen the movie, but he hadn't.
mistakes.why: 與過去事實相反，要用 had + p.p.。

mistakes.wrong: She treats me as if I being her little sister.
mistakes.right: She treats me as if I were her little sister.
mistakes.why: as if 後面是完整子句，要有適當的 be 動詞。

qs.s: Tina acts as if she ______ everything about the new teacher, but she has never met him.
qs.ex: 與現在事實相反，as if 後用過去式 knew。
qs.hint: but she has never met him 說明事實與說法相反，想想 as if 後面要用什麼時態。

qs.s: The kids looked at me as if they ______ the answer, but they didn't.
qs.ex: but they didn't 說明與當時事實相反，as if 子句用過去式 knew 表示「彷彿知道」。
qs.hint: 孩子們其實不知道答案，這是與現在事實相反，動詞要用過去式形式。

qs.s: He looks at me as if I ______ a stranger, though we have been friends for years.
qs.ex: 與現在事實相反，as if 子句中的 be 動詞用 were。
qs.hint: 事實上我不是陌生人，as if 子句中的 be 動詞有固定形式，不分人稱。

qs.s: The room was a mess, as if a storm ______ through it last night.
qs.ex: 表示與過去事實相反，用 had + p.p.；had passed 正確。
qs.hint: last night 是過去時間，事實上沒有暴風雨，要用與過去事實相反的形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: She treats me as if I am being her little sister.
She treats me as if I being her little sister.
She treats me as if I were her little sister.
She treats me as if I be her little sister.
qs.ex: 與現在事實相反（我不是她妹妹），as if 子句的 be 動詞用 were。
qs.hint: 檢查 as if 後的 be 動詞，是不是假設語氣用法，且沒有多餘的 being。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: He spoke as if he has seen the movie, but he hadn't.
He spoke as if he had seen the movie, but he hadn't.
He spoke as if he will see the movie, but he hadn't.
He spoke as if he sees the movie, but he hadn't.
qs.ex: 說話者其實沒看過，與過去事實相反，as if 後用 had seen。
qs.hint: 句尾 but he hadn't 說明他其實沒看過，as if 子句要用與過去事實相反的時態。

title: 省略 if 的倒裝假設句（過去式）
formula: Had + S + p.p., S + would/could/might + have + p.p.
intro: 「要是當時有早點出門，就不會遲到了」，這是對過去的後悔。正式一點的說法，可以把 if 省略，直接把助動詞放到句首：像 Had I left earlier, I would not have been late。這種倒裝句很常在學測的單選與改錯出現。
rhyme: 省 if 把 Had 提前，過去相反 would have p.p.

points.t: 與過去事實相反的條件句：If + S + had + p.p., S + would / could / might + have + p.p.。

ex.en: If the bus had been on time, we wouldn't have been late for school.
ex.zh: 如果公車準時，我們就不會上學遲到了。
hl: If the bus had been on time

points.t: 省略 if 時，把 had 移到句首，主詞放在 had 後面，也就是 Had + S + p.p.。

ex.en: Had the bus been on time, we wouldn't have been late for school.
ex.zh: 如果公車準時，我們就不會上學遲到了。

points.t: 省略 if 後不能再保留 if，否則句子重複；整個條件子句只用 Had + S + p.p.。

ex.en: Had Peter received the invitation, he would have come to the party.
ex.zh: 如果彼得有收到邀請，他就會來參加派對了。

points.t: 否定寫法：在主詞後面加 not，變成 Had + S + not + p.p.，不用縮寫放在句首。

ex.en: Had they not fixed the road, the trip would have been much more difficult.
ex.zh: 如果他們沒修路，旅程會困難許多。

points.t: 主要子句用 would / could / might + have + p.p.，和原本的 if 句型一樣，表示過去的結果。

ex.en: Had I known about the rain, I would have brought an umbrella.
ex.zh: 如果我知道會下雨，我就會帶傘了。

steps: 步驟 1：先寫出完整的 if 句：If I had known his number, I would have called him.
步驟 2：確認是與過去事實相反，條件子句用 had + p.p.。
步驟 3：把 if 去掉，把 had 放到句首，主詞接在後面，否定時 not 放在主詞後面。
完成句：Had I known his number, I would have called him.

compare.a: Had I known, I would have called him.
compare.b: If I had known, I would have called him.
compare.note: 兩句意思相同，前者省略 if 並倒裝，語氣較正式。

compare.a: Had the teacher not helped me, I would have failed.
compare.b: Hadn't the teacher helped me, I would have failed.
compare.note: 省略 if 的否定句要把 not 放在主詞後，不能把縮寫放句首。

compare.a: Had I known, I would have called.
compare.b: Were I there, I would call him.
compare.note: 前者與過去相反用 Had；後者與現在相反用 Were。

mistakes.wrong: If had I known his number, I would have called him.
mistakes.right: Had I known his number, I would have called him.
mistakes.why: 倒裝後不能再保留 if。

mistakes.wrong: Hadn't the teacher helped me, I would have failed.
mistakes.right: Had the teacher not helped me, I would have failed.
mistakes.why: 否定時 not 放在主詞後，不用 Hadn't 放句首。

mistakes.wrong: Had I know his number, I would have called him.
mistakes.right: Had I known his number, I would have called him.
mistakes.why: Had 後面要接過去分詞，不是原形。

qs.s: ______ the bus been on time, we wouldn't have been late for school.
qs.ex: 省略 if 的過去假設倒裝，把 had 移到句首，Had the bus been ...。
qs.hint: 與過去事實相反，省略 if 後，句首應該是什麼助動詞？想想完成式的第一個字。

qs.s: Had Peter ______ the invitation, he would have come to the party.
qs.ex: Had + S + p.p. 的結構，空格需過去分詞 received。
qs.hint: 空格前已有主詞，後面的動詞要用過去分詞。

qs.s: ______ I known about the rain, I would have brought an umbrella.
qs.ex: 後面是 would have brought，表示與過去事實相反，倒裝開頭用 Had。
qs.hint: 句子是過去的後悔，想想倒裝的助動詞要與哪種完成式搭配。

qs.s: Had they not fixed the road, the trip ______ much more difficult.
qs.ex: 與過去事實相反，主要子句用 would have + p.p.，would have been 正確。
qs.hint: 主要子句描述過去結果，與過去事實相反，要用「情態動詞 + have + 過去分詞」的完整形式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Had I known his number, I would have called him.
If had I known his number, I would have called him.
Did I know his number, I would have called him.
Have I known his number, I would have called him.
qs.ex: 省略 if 時，倒裝為 Had + S + p.p.，且不可保留 if。
qs.hint: 找句首是否有倒裝，且沒有多餘的 if，動詞也是完成式。

qs.s: 選出文法正確的句子。
o: Hadn't the teacher helped me, I would have failed.
Had the teacher not helped me, I would have failed.
Had not the teacher helped, I will fail.
Had the teacher not help me, I would have failed.
qs.ex: 否定句要寫成 Had + S + not + p.p.，不用 Hadn't 倒裝；動詞也要用過去分詞 helped，主要子句用 would have failed。
qs.hint: 否定時 not 要放在主詞後面，不能使用縮寫放句首，也要檢查動詞形式。
